items.title: 陸上＝競歩の池田、ドーピング違反処分取り消し　競技復帰可能に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２３日　ロイター］ - スポーツ仲裁裁判所（ＣＡＳ）は２３日、陸上男子２０キロ競歩で２０２１年東京五輪銀メダリストの池田向希（２８）に科されていた４年間の資格停止処分を取り消すと発表した。ドーピング違反が立証されなかったとして池田の不服申し立てを認め、ただちに競技復帰が可能となった。

池田は選手の血液データを蓄積する「生体パスポート」の数値に異常が見られたことからドーピングを疑われ、２４年１１月に暫定的な資格停止処分を受けた。２５年２月には世界陸連から４年間の資格停止処分を科された。

一貫してドーピングを否定してきた池田は同年３月にＣＡＳへ不服を申し立て、今年５月にスイスのローザンヌで聴聞会が開かれた。

ＣＡＳは生体パスポートの複数の数値に異常があったことを認めた一方、ドーピング以外の合理的な説明が可能と判断。池田側が提出した医学的証拠や専門家の意見により、世界陸連の裁定機関による審理時よりも幅広い事実関係が明らかになったとし、違反は立証されていないと結論付けた。

池田は２２年世界選手権でも銀メダルを獲得し、２４年パリ五輪では７位だった。今回の裁定により、２８年ロサンゼルス五輪への出場にも道が開けた。

items.title: ゴルフ＝バミューダ選手権、首位浮上の平田「久しぶりの優勝争い」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２３日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフのバミューダ選手権は２３日、英領バミューダ、サウサンプトンのポートロイヤルＧＣ（パー７１）で第２ラウンドを行い、平田憲聖が首位に浮上した。

前日１１位の平田は７バーディー、ノーボギーの６４をマークし、通算１３アンダーの１２９でトップに立った。「久しぶりの優勝争いなので、週末はいろいろな感情が湧いてくると思うが、これまでの６勝が助けになると思う」とコメント。同選手は日本ツアーで６勝を挙げている。

１１位スタートの米沢蓮は３アンダーの６８で回り、通算９アンダーの１３３で１３位に後退。初日は６バーディー、ノーボギーの６５を記録していた。金谷拓実は６３位。

前日首位のチャンドラー・ブランシェ（米国）は最終１８番でバーディーを奪うなど、４アンダーの６７をマークし、平田と並ぶ首位を維持した。

items.title: Boeing supplier dispute has halted 777 freighter production for two months, sources say
items.author: Dan Catchpole
items.creator: Dan Catchpole
items.summary: Boeing's dispute with a small Florida-based supplier has halted production of its 777 freighter for nearly two months and disrupted output of the 767, including freighters and KC-46 aerial refueling tankers, according to Boeing workers and court filings.
items.body:
Boeing's (BA.N) dispute with a small Florida-based supplier has halted production of its 777 freighter for nearly two months and disrupted output of the 767, including freighters and KC-46 aerial refueling tankers, according to Boeing workers and court filings.
Boeing filed a complaint in August alleging supplier Vaero had stopped delivering a critical wing component known as the trailing-edge rib kit, stalling work at the Everett, Washington, wing-production facility that supports the 777 freighter and 767 programs, according to a copy of the complaint reviewed by Reuters. The disruption was costing Boeing as much as $6.5 million a day, the complaint said.
Boeing said in the complaint that the trailing-edge rib kit was an "indispensable" part and Vaero was the sole supplier.
Although the companies reached a settlement in late September, production of the 777 freighter has yet to resume, according to three Boeing workers familiar with the matter. They declined to be named because they were not authorized to speak publicly.
The dispute also disrupted production of the 767, a widebody cargo and military aircraft, the people said. Since the settlement, Boeing has received some parts for the 767 line, according to one of the workers.
The prolonged disruption highlights the fragility of aerospace supply chains, showing how a dispute involving a single supplier can halt production of aircraft that remain in strong demand.
The lawsuit was first reported by Law.com in August, but the nearly two-month production disruption has not previously been reported.
Boeing declined to comment. Vaero did not respond to requests for comment.
BRINGING PRODUCTION IN-HOUSE Boeing is trying to bring production of the trailing-edge rib kit in-house, according to two of the people. The component is used in wing assembly for the 767 and current-generation 777 freighter. Boeing's 777X, which uses composite wings, has not been affected.
Without the Vaero parts, Boeing removed two partially assembled 777 freighters from its final assembly line, according to one Boeing worker.
Using data from aviation consultancy IBA, Reuters identified one of the aircraft as destined for FedEx (FDX.N) .
FedEx did not respond to a request for comment.
Boeing has delivered 21 777 freighters so far this year, company data show. It also has a handful of freighters whose wings were assembled before the dispute and could still be delivered before year-end, according to two of the Boeing workers.

items.title: Hartnett, de BofA, advierte que la aversión al riesgo persistirá hasta mediados de noviembre
items.author: Levin Stamm
items.summary: Michael Hartnett, estratega de Bank of America, prevé una tendencia a la baja en las acciones, los rendimientos y el dólar estadounidense, mientras persisten los temores por una burbuja de la IA y las ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Es probable que la actitud de aversión al riesgo de los inversores se mantenga hasta bien entrado noviembre, según Michael Hartnett, de Bank of America Corp. ( BAC ), lo que constituye otra señal de cómo la agitación alredor del sector de la IA y a las elecciones estadounidenses de mitad de legislatura ha frenado los mercados bursátiles. “Nos mantenemos tácticamente reacios al riesgo hasta mediados de noviembre”, escribió el estratega en una nota dirigida a sus clientes este viernes. “Esperamos una tendencia a la baja en los rendimientos, en las acciones y en el dólar estadounidense”. Hartnett señaló que el mercado todavía tiene que descontar plenamente una victoria demócrata tanto en la Cámara de Representantes como en el Senado, lo que resultaría negativo para el crecimiento de las ganancias, ya que supondría el fin del actual régimen de bajos impuestos y escasa regulación. Según el estratega, otro factor que daría señales de una reactivación del apetito por el riesgo sería la intervención del BCE o del Gobierno francés para frenar la caída de los rendimientos de la deuda francesa. Ver más: Los países de América Latina más preparados para la inteligencia artificial, según ranking de Cepal Añadió que un repunte de los diferenciales de deuda de las grandes compañías de inteligencia artificial, que han generado inquietud en los mercados últimamente, también podría deberse a recortes en el gasto de capital o al “anuncio de una emisión accionarial extrema”. Los inversionistas siguen acudiendo en masa a los sectores relacionados con la IA. Los datos de EPFR Global citados por el banco mostraron las mayores entradas semanales en acciones tecnológicas desde julio. Una encuesta de Bank of America de este mes también reveló que los inversionistas globales están más expuestos al sector tecnológico desde agosto de 2020. Ver más: Ya no es solo el petróleo o la Fed: la IA ahora mueve al dólar y los bonos No obstante, en los últimos días también han adoptado una postura defensiva, buscando refugio frente a una serie de riesgos que van desde la subida de los precios del petróleo y el encarecimiento de los costes de financiación, hasta la preocupación de que el sector de la inteligencia artificial esté comenzando a mostrar signos de burbuja. El multimillonario Ken Griffin advirtió esta semana de que los inversionistas se encuentran “casi con toda seguridad” en medio de una burbuja de la IA. Una versión ponderada por igual del índice S&P 500, un indicador de la amplitud del mercado, registró este jueves su mejor jornada desde 2024 en comparación con el S&P 500 ponderado por capitalización bursátil. Por su parte, los valores defensivos de productos básicos de consumo van camino de registrar su mejor mes desde 1998. Lea más en bloomberg.com

items.author: CNA

France boosts police presence, hoping to prevent repeat of riots

Anger over living costs and strained public services has drawn students, workers and unions onto the streets in recent weeks.

Workers remove graffiti from the pedestal of the equestrian statue of Louis XIV at the Place Bellecour in Lyon, ahead of nationwide protests against the cost of living and rising fuel prices in France, Oct 23, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Lisi Niesner)

PARIS: France will deploy 70,000 police at nationwide protests on Saturday (Oct 24), Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said on Friday, looking to prevent a repeat of the violence and looting that shocked the country last weekend.
Elite security teams and heavily armed mobile squads will be mobilised alongside regular units in a show of force aimed at dispelling fears the government has lost control of the streets.
"We will be uncompromising with rioters, looters and all those who commit acts of violence," Nunez told reporters, adding that "ultra-left" groups had been urging activists online to target public buildings and unleash more lawlessness.
"We are not talking about a nice, friendly demonstration," Nunez said. "We are ready for tomorrow. We will be extremely vigilant, extremely firm, and we will let absolutely nothing pass."

Anger over living costs and strained public services has drawn students, workers and unions onto the streets in recent weeks, but authorities say radical militants and bands of young looters have taken advantage of the dispute to sow chaos.
Some far-right politicians have blamed migrants and radical Islam for the turmoil. President Emmanuel Macron has dismissed such accusations.
Ratcheting up the tensions, a man opened fire from a car west of Paris on Friday, killing one person and wounding four others, including a 12-year-old girl.
"(It was) objectively a racist attack," said local mayor Ali Rabeh, blaming far-right rhetoric for inflaming tensions.
Police have authorised only one union demonstration in Paris on Saturday, rejecting requests for rallies lodged by France's main student union, UNEF, and the Yellow Vest movement, an anti-establishment force that first emerged in 2018.

Demonstrators sit on the roadway in front of officers of the French CRS riot police during a protest organised by student collectives and trade unions in Paris, France, Oct 22, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Abdul Saboor)

Many French cities beyond Paris have also banned protests, but the second-largest city, Marseille, rescinded an earlier restriction order and said it would allow a union demonstration.
UNEF said its rallies, which grew from high school protests last month against teacher shortages and shabby facilities, would go ahead regardless.
Marylise Leon, the general secretary of the CFDT, one of the nation's largest trade unions, criticised Macron for not sanctioning more demonstrations.
"It's counterproductive because there is a lot of anger, a lot of anger and a demand to be considered and to be listened to," she told French broadcaster TF1. 
"It's not for the president to decide who can legitimately request to protest."

Related:

'We don't really want to cancel': Singaporeans weigh France travel plans amid violent protests

Commentary: French students are showing us what protest looks like in the age of viral spectacle

FAR-RIGHT CONGRESS A POSSIBLE FLASHPOINT Nunez said 10,000 more police would be on the streets than a week ago, while mounted police, helicopters, drones and anti-drone systems would be deployed across the country.
Armoured vehicles and water cannon vehicles would also be available, while curfews imposed in some sensitive areas this past week would remain in force.
Authorities are also concerned that the annual congress of Marine Le Pen's far-right National Rally in Orleans this weekend could become a flashpoint, with left-wing and anti-racist groups announcing counter-demonstrations.
The upsurge of violence has boosted poll ratings for Le Pen, who is the frontrunner for next year's presidential election. She has portrayed the unrest as evidence of a collapse in state authority.
Fears of renewed turmoil prompted several of Paris' best-known cultural institutions, including the Louvre, the Musée d'Orsay and the Opera House, to close all day on Saturday.
Paris St Germain's home Ligue 1 football match with Olympique Lyonnais was shifted from Sunday to Monday over security concerns. However, an NFL regular-season game between the Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints is still scheduled to be played in Paris on Sunday, although US President Donald Trump suggested it should be cancelled.
Business groups also urged shops to stay shut after some 3,000 stores and businesses were ransacked last weekend.
Alain Di Crescenzo, the president of France's chamber of commerce, said some shopkeepers were arming themselves with baseball bats, crowbars and shotguns to protect their properties. But he urged them not to turn to violence.
"It’s extremely worrying," he told Europe 1 radio. "It's not their job to do that. It would add suffering onto suffering."
The social turbulence has intensified scrutiny of France's economic outlook and ratings agency Moody's is widely expected to cut the French credit rating on Friday, underscoring concern that the government had not reined in public spending.

Source: Reuters/gs

items.title: Moderna y Merck enfrentan dudas de inversionistas pese a los avances de su vacuna contra el melanoma
items.author: Michelle Fay Cortez, Robert Langreth
items.summary: La vacuna personalizada redujo un 42% el riesgo de recurrencia del melanoma y un 38% el de diseminación a distancia. Sin embargo, los datos filtrados generaron dudas entre los inversionistas sobre su ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Los datos filtrados del tan esperado ensayo clínico de la vacuna contra el melanoma de Moderna Inc. ( MRNA ) y Merck & Co. ( MRK ) han generado una inusual discrepancia entre los médicos, que celebraron sus resultados, y Wall Street, donde se produjo una venta masiva de acciones. Normalmente, los resultados de este tipo de ensayos clínicos decisivos son binarios: médicos, pacientes e inversores descubren si un nuevo medicamento marcará una diferencia significativa en la vida de las personas y llegan a la misma conclusión. En cambio, a medida que se filtraban en las redes sociales informes sobre los resultados de la vacuna contra el melanoma, días antes de la presentación cuidadosamente preparada que tenía previsto ofrecer ante miles de oncólogos reunidos en Madrid con motivo del congreso de la Sociedad Europea de Oncología Médica, esas realidades divergieron. Ver más: Moderna cae un récord de 26% tras filtrarse datos de su vacuna contra el melanoma con Merck La vacuna personalizada contra el cáncer desarrollada por Moderna y Merck ayudó claramente a los pacientes, reduciendo en un 42% la probabilidad de que sus tumores reaparecieran tras su extirpación quirúrgica y previniendo su diseminación a distancia en un 38%. Sin embargo, las acciones de ambas farmacéuticas cayeron, y la caída de Moderna alcanzó niveles récord durante la sesión bursátil de este jueves. Los resultados suponen un gran avance para el melanoma, uno de los tipos de cáncer más comunes, y podrían constituir una nueva y potente herramienta para tratar numerosas formas operables de la enfermedad. La vacuna podría ayudar a muchos miles de personas con melanoma que presentan un alto riesgo de recidiva. Este tipo de resultados suelen sentar las bases para la aprobación de nuevos medicamentos, y los médicos acogieron con satisfacción los hallazgos. “Estoy bastante impresionado”, aseguró Michael Postow, especialista en melanoma del Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center y uno de los investigadores. Los beneficios podrían incrementar con el tiempo, señaló. “Es probable que, hasta ahora, no hayamos visto el efecto terapéutico completo de todo esto”. Incluso tras la caída de este jueves, las acciones de Moderna siguen estando muy por encima del nivel en el que se encontraban antes de que la compañías anunciara en agosto que la vacuna era eficaz, sin presentar el conjunto completo de datos. Wall Street, no obstante, ha revisado a la baja algunas de sus expectativas más optimistas respecto a la empresa biotecnológica tras la publicación de esta semana. Había descontado la idea de que la vacuna fuera el punto de partida de una línea oncológica más amplia que Moderna ha estado tratando de desarrollar, y que algún día podría incluir tratamientos similares para el cáncer de pulmón, de vejiga y otros tipos de cáncer. Los datos limitados han suscitado ciertas dudas sobre lo difícil que resultaría ello, al mostrar que la capacidad para prevenir la diseminación a distancia podría no ser tan sólida como se esperaba. La información disponible no ha infundido confianza en algunos inversionistas de Moderna, que apostaban por el giro de la empresa tras la Covid-19 para convertirse en una importante empresa dedicada al cáncer. “Aunque la aprobación parece probable, el éxito comercial es mucho menos seguro”, escribió Trung Huynh, analista de RBC Capital Markets, en una nota dirigida a los inversionistas. Los datos plantean “cuestiones fundamentales” sobre la propuesta de valor de la vacuna en comparación con el tratamiento de referencia actual, que ofrece beneficios similares a un coste potencialmente mucho menor, señaló. Ver más: Moderna se dispara 160% y deja millonarias pérdidas a quienes apostaban por su caída El éxito de la vacuna contra el melanoma también someterá a Moderna y Merck a la presión de completar los ensayos en otros tipos de cáncer, incluso cuando surgen dudas sobre las ventas a corto plazo y el mercado potencialmente más amplio para dicha tecnología. “Se trata de una forma extraordinariamente compleja y potencialmente costosa de fabricar fármacos”, afirmó Lennard Lee, profesor asociado de la Universidad de Oxford. “La logística podría hacer que Amazon pareciera sencilla”. Todos los pacientes del estudio recibieron además Keytruda, el fármaco oncológico más vendido de Merck, lo que convierte a las vacunas personalizadas diseñadas para cada paciente en una terapia complementaria. Los beneficios adicionales, junto con la ausencia de efectos secundarios graves, podrían convencer a más pacientes de optar por este tratamiento, señaló Sekwon Jang, director de investigación y terapias contra el melanoma e investigador clínico del Inova Schar Cancer Institute, en el norte de Virginia. Ver más: FDA aprueba medicamento contra cáncer de piel avanzado para pacientes sin respuesta a inmunoterapia “Con esta combinación, creo que la relación riesgo-beneficio es, de hecho, mucho más favorable”, explicó Jang. “Espero que más pacientes míos opten por recibir este tratamiento combinado”, agregó, si finalmente se aprueba. No obstante, los inversionistas ya esperaban resultados sólidos después de que las empresas emitieran un comunicado de prensa en agosto en el que se indicaba que el estudio había tenido éxito, y algo más. Esa noticia avivó las expectativas respecto al uso de la tecnología de ARNm de Moderna, diseñada para permitir a los médicos preparar el sistema inmunitario para detectar y destruir invasores extraños y otras amenazas, incluidas las células tumorales. Luego de décadas con resultados decepcionantes, estos hallazgos podrían suponer un real avance en el desarrollo de una vacuna contra el cáncer dirigida a los tumores sólidos. Aun así, los detalles de los resultados del estudio todavía no se han presentado en su totalidad a los médicos ni a los inversionistas, y se necesitan para evaluar su potencial y validar sus expectativas. Los resultados serán presentados este sábado en Madrid, donde un grupo más amplio de oncólogos evaluará los hallazgos. -Con la colaboración de Madison Muller. Lea más en Bloomberg

items.title: Amazon cloud capacity sold out through 2027, CEO Jassy says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said on Friday that Amazon Web Services' cloud computing capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with significant commitments extending into 2028, on growing demand for AI infrastructure.
items.body:
Amazon (AMZN.O) CEO Andy Jassy said on Friday that Amazon Web Services' cloud computing capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with significant commitments extending into 2028, on growing demand for AI infrastructure.
In a video podcast with Andreessen Horowitz co-founder Ben Horowitz and general partner Erik Torenberg, Jassy said Amazon is struggling to keep pace with the insatiable demand from AI labs and enterprises.
Earlier this year, Amazon had said it would spend [USN:L4N43X10O TEXT:"about $220 billion"] in capital expenditure for 2026
Jassy said the company "could invest a lot more and it wouldn't be a bad use of capital," considering cloud-computing capacity for 2026 is already sold out
"2027 is largely sold out. We always leave a certain amount for on demand and our inference service bedrock, or EC2, but largely sold out all the big chunks. A good chunk of 2028 is sold out," he said
EC2 is an AWS service that provides cloud servers for running applications, while Bedrock gives customers access to AI models to build generative AI applications
Amazon is scheduled to report third quarter results on October 29

items.title: Bulls storm back from early deficit to beat Bucks
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Norman Powell scored 25 points and rookie Caleb Wilson added 21 on Friday to help the visiting Chicago Bulls earn a 132-125 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks.
items.body:
Norman Powell scored 25 points and rookie Caleb Wilson added 21 on Friday to help the visiting Chicago Bulls earn a 132-125 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks.
Leonard Miller had 19 points, while Jalen Smith chipped in 14 points and 13 rebounds for Chicago, which rebounded after suffering a 43-point loss to the Toronto Raptors on Wednesday. Buddy Hield scored 13, Isaac Okoro had 12 and Tre Jones tallied 11 points and eight assists for the Bulls, who trailed by 15 points after the first quarter.
Tyler Herro led Milwaukee with 34 points, followed by Jaime Jaquez Jr.'s 19 points and 11 boards. Kyle Kuzma scored 14 and Myles Turner had 12, while Ryan Rollins, AJ Green and Kel'el Ware scored 11 apiece for the Bucks, who lost their second straight to open the season.
Rookie Brayden Burries made a 3-pointer and Ware scored around the rim to give the Bucks a five-point lead with 2:55 left in the third quarter. Smith beat the third-quarter buzzer with a dunk that cut the Bulls' deficit to 104-102 entering the fourth.
Chicago scored the first six points of the final quarter and grabbed a 108-104 lead on Wilson's slam. The Bulls pushed the lead to eight on Hield's trey with 7:19 remaining.
With Milwaukee trailing by five, Herro connected on back-to-back 3-pointers, returning the lead to the Bucks.
Wilson made two free throws to put the Bulls ahead 124-123 with 1:16 left.
After Jones picked off Rollins' pass, Wilson made another pair from the foul line to push the lead to three. A missed 3-pointer by Herro and two more free throws from Powell gave the Bulls a five-point cushion with 20 seconds left.
Wilson's steal and Jones' subsequent two foul shots sealed Chicago's victory.
Milwaukee jumped out to a 19-6 lead on Herro's first triple less than five minutes in. Green sank a 3-pointer in the closing seconds of the first quarter to give the Bucks a 32-17 advantage.
Matas Buzelis' slam pulled the Bulls within seven, but Kasparas Jakucionis and Rollins hit consecutive treys to build the margin to 44-31 with 8:35 left in the first half.
Chicago answered again and took a 55-51 lead on Hield's 3-pointer, which stamped a 16-0 run.
Kuzma made a layup with three seconds left in the first half to give the Bucks a 62-61 halftime edge.
--Field Level Media

items.title: UK government sets out $800 million of AI security funding
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Britain's government set out around £600 million ($800 million)of funding on Saturday largely geared towards defending against health and security threats from artificial intelligence.
items.body:
Britain's government set out around £600 million ($800 million)of funding on Saturday largely geared towards defending against health and security threats from artificial intelligence.
The biggest chunk of funding will go to a new biosecurity initiative, including £100 million for a laboratory using AI to detect biological threats and £65 million to develop countermeasures against pathogens.
AI minister Kanishka Narayan said the aim was for the AI Biosecurity Lab to become a major global institution "bringing together world-leading scientific expertise to protect people from emerging biological threats".
Tech companies OpenAI and Anthropic will offer up to £200 million of model credits to the biosecurity initiative
Google Deepmind (GOOGL.O) and London-based AI life sciences startup Basecamp Research will offer other assistance
Britain's government will give its existing [USN:L8N45E18S TEXT:"AI Security Institute"] an extra £120 million
£130 million will go towards new projects to improve cyber defences for critical infrastructure and the wider economy, known as the National Cyber Shield and the National Exposure and Real-Time Vulnerability Centre
£60 million will go towards a fund that will invest in British companies using AI to advance robotics, autonomous systems and manufacturing
£60 million will be used for AI research and procurement contracts
An extra £23 million will go to research on the economic impact of AI
£18 million will go to a new chip design academy
£15 million will fund a prize for AI solutions to public policy problems, initially focused on healthcare
£30 million will go to regional mayors to support local AI work
Britain's [USN:L8N42P1O5 TEXT:"National Cyber Security Centre"] will receive an unspecified sum to expand in Manchester
Anthropic alone racked up [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"more than $12 billion in operating expenses"] last year
($1 = 0.7472 pounds)

items.title: Thailand welcomes US-Myanmar engagement, expects ASEAN talks on country's future - Reuters
items.summary: Thailand welcomes US-Myanmar engagement, expects ASEAN talks on country's future    Reuters
items.raw_description: Thailand welcomes US-Myanmar engagement, expects ASEAN talks on country's future    Reuters

items.title: Thailand welcomes US-Myanmar engagement, expects ASEAN talks on country's future
items.author: Sergio Goncalves, Miguel Pereira
items.creator: Sergio Goncalves, Miguel Pereira
items.summary: Thailand welcomes US engagement with Myanmar and expects discussions at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations' November summit in Manila on how to proceed with the member barred since the 2021 coup, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow told Reuters on Friday.
items.body:
Thailand welcomes US engagement with Myanmar and expects discussions at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations' November summit in Manila on how to proceed with the member barred since the 2021 coup, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow told Reuters on Friday.
The United States and Myanmar's military-backed government held [USN:L6N46300W TEXT:"talks in Tokyo"] two weeks ago, their second meeting in a month as Washington steps up re-engagement with the generals it shunned after the coup.
"We don't want to see Myanmar isolated, we don't want Myanmar to be an arena for geopolitical rivalry ... so the US engagement is something that we welcome," he said.
Engagement "does not mean legitimizing the regime," but aims to encourage peaceful conflict resolution and reconciliation with the opposition, Sihasak, who is also deputy prime minister, added.
He said there was "some shift in ASEAN's position," citing Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing's recent visits to Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, Thailand and Malaysia, but said it was unclear whether the Manila summit would address restoring Myanmar's full representation.
"It's good that we're going to have a very substantive, very extensive, and very in-depth discussion on how to proceed on Myanmar," he said.
He also said Thailand and Cambodia could resolve their longstanding land and maritime boundary disputes within 12 to 18 months despite limited progress.
"It is possible, everything is possible," he said, cautioning that confidence-building and addressing security concerns along the land border, where clashes have occurred, must come first.
Cambodia launched a conciliation process under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea in June to resolve the maritime boundary dispute, after Thailand terminated a 2001 joint development framework in May following deadly border clashes. The first meeting was held about a month ago.
"Right now, we haven't achieved, to be very frank, much progress," he said.
The maritime dispute centers on overlapping claims to about 26,000 sq km in the Gulf of Thailand, believed to hold oil and gas reserves worth around $300 billion. Thailand wants the boundary defined before discussing resource-sharing, he said.
Thailand-EU free-trade talks are in their final stage and could conclude by year-end if there is mutual political will, he added.

items.author: Amy Tennery
items.creator: Amy Tennery
items.summary: Canada are entering a critical rebuilding phase ahead of next month's ice hockey Women's World Championship, retired US great Angela Ruggiero told Reuters, after falling to the US in the Milano Cortina Olympic gold medal game.
items.body:
Canada are entering a critical rebuilding phase ahead of next month's ice hockey Women's World Championship, retired US great Angela Ruggiero told Reuters, after falling to the US in the Milano Cortina Olympic gold medal game.
Canada have often had the upper hand in the countries' rivalry, with five Olympic golds to three for the US. But US youth conquered Canadian experience in Milano Cortina, as an American roster loaded with [USN:L8N3Z02EC TEXT:"collegiate talent"] held off the veterans from the north in a spine-tingling finale.
Eight months later, Canada announced a World Championship roster with seven tournament debutants at the worlds, with an eye towards replicating US success in developing young up-and-comers.
"They're going with a very young team, an inexperienced team that could really work in their favour," said Ruggiero, speaking to Reuters at the Women's Sports Foundation annual gala this week. "They're building for four years from now. So it was a strategic decision."
The Hall of Famer helped propel the US to four world golds and made her Olympic debut at 18 years old, when the Americans took the first-ever women's ice hockey gold at the 1998 Games.
She said Canada's youth corps should not be underestimated.
"I think back to the 2008 World Championship team. We were a very, very young team. And we believed in ourselves. We were able to win those World Championships because of the psychology in the locker room, even though on the ice we weren't the best team," said Ruggiero.
"If I were Canada's GM, I think it's the smartest thing to do. Reset the clock, figure out chemistry."
The World Championship begins on November 6 after a memorable Milano Cortina Olympics, with the advent of the Professional Women's Hockey League in North America bringing the game into [USN:L8N3ZC0ZU TEXT:"a new era"].
"It was probably all around the most elite, highest skilled, fastest, best brand of women's hockey I have ever seen," said Meghan Duggan, Ruggiero's 2010 Olympic teammate who also appeared at the WSF gala in support of women's sports.
"That shows what the professional league is doing to elevate the game."

items.title: Fever GM Amber Cox follows team president out of Indy
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Fever general manager Amber Cox followed team president Kelly Krauskopf out the door in a major shakeup of the front office on Friday.
items.body:
Fever general manager Amber Cox followed team president Kelly Krauskopf out the door in a major shakeup of the front office on Friday.
Kraskopf resigned earlier in the day and Cox was let go hours later, with the Fever saying the franchise was announcing "the departure of Amber Cox."
The franchise wrapped up its best regular season in team history with 26 wins and went to the conference semifinals in Cox's first season in the GM role.
Indiana had three players named WNBA All-Stars and two of the league's top three scorers in Kelsey Mitchell (second) and Caitlin Clark. Mitchell is a pending free agent and said she will shop around to find the best fit for her and her family this offseason.
Mel Raines, president and CEO of Pacers Sports & Entertainment, said a national search is underway to fill the front-office spots.
"Through her two seasons with the Fever, Amber has helped us navigate the seismic growth of the WNBA and our franchise," Raines said. "We're grateful for her contributions and wish her the very best moving forward."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Ronaldinho voltará aos gramados pelo italiano Ravenna
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O craque brasileiro Ronaldinho Gaúcho voltará ao futebol competitivo no próximo mês, quando jogará pelo Ravenna, time da terceira divisão italiana, contra o rival local Forlì, no dia 15 de novembro, anunciou o clube da Série C nesta sexta-feira.
items.body:
O craque brasileiro Ronaldinho Gaúcho voltará ao futebol competitivo no próximo mês, quando jogará pelo Ravenna, time da terceira divisão italiana, contra o rival local Forlì, no dia 15 de novembro, anunciou o clube da Série C nesta sexta-feira.
O ex-atacante do Barcelona e do Milan, de 46 anos, que conquistou a Copa do Mundo de 2002 com o Brasil e a Bola de Ouro em 2005, jogou pela última vez em competições oficiais pelo Fluminense, em 2015. Ele se aposentou oficialmente em 2018.
O Ravenna contratou Ronaldinho em junho e, posteriormente, ele adquiriu uma participação no clube, que é de propriedade de seu amigo Ignazio Cipriani.
Cipriani disse que a iniciativa tinha como objetivo “aproximar toda a cidade do time”.
Ronaldinho Gaúcho não chegou a confirmar que jogaria quando chegou à Itália em agosto, embora tenha deixado em aberto a possibilidade de marcar o 300º gol de sua carreira.
“Estou aqui para ajudar”, disse ele na ocasião.
O clássico contra o Forì será disputado no Stadio Bruno Benelli, em Ravenna. O Ravenna ocupa a segunda colocação do Grupo B da Série C, com 20 pontos em 10 partidas, oito pontos atrás do líder, o Spezia.

items.title: Oregon State breakout WR Jesse Legree re-signs with school for 2027
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Oregon State star freshman receiver Jesse Legree announced Friday that he has re-signed with the Beavers for the 2027 season.
items.body:
Oregon State star freshman receiver Jesse Legree announced Friday that he has re-signed with the Beavers for the 2027 season.
Legree made the announcement at his former high school, Saint Frances Academy in Baltimore, partly because he was lightly recruited and didn't have a signing day a year ago.
"We've built a great culture and it's only going to get bigger from here," Legree told ESPN. "This is going to be the start of a national powerhouse."
The 5-foot-10, 172-pound Legree was only a three-star recruit but has exploded onto the scene in Corvallis. He leads the nation with 1,040 receiving yards and 14 touchdown receptions. He is two touchdown catches away from matching the school record held by longtime NFL receiver Brandin Cooks (16 in 2013).
Legree has topped 100 yards receiving in all seven games for Oregon State (5-2, 3-0 Pac-12). His top outing was 240 yards - second-most in school history -- against then-No. 13 Texas Tech on Sept. 12.
He has caught three touchdown passes twice and grabbed two on three other occasions. He has at least one touchdown catch in each game.
His season high for receptions is 10 against San Diego State. He had 191 yards and three scores in the Beavers' 66-14 trouncing of the Aztecs. Legree is averaging 22.6 yards on 46 receptions.
Legree has recently been mentioned as a Heisman Trophy candidate. He said he belongs at the top of the conversation.
"Never seen a freshman do what I'm doing week in and week out, and I feel like I'm going to continue to do that," Legree said. "And I feel like everybody who doesn't feel like I should be in that conversation will notice by the end of the season that I deserve that, or should at least be in the top-three conversation."
Oregon State is averaging 51 points per game during a five-game winning streak in JaMarcus Shepherd's first season as head coach.
Legree also held the event during Oregon State's bye week to help attract media attention to the program in hopes of landing athletes for the program.
Oregon State also has a quarterback on the rise in Mercer transfer Branden Atkinson, who won the Jerry Rice Award last season as the top freshman in the FCS. Atkinson leads the nation in passing yardage (2,604 yards) and touchdown passes (24) and has thrown just two interceptions for Oregon State.
The Beavers return to action on Oct. 31 at Fresno State (4-3, 1-2).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Caso de Ebola na Nigéria está ligado ao vírus encontrado no primeiro caso do Quênia, diz ministro da Saúde
items.author: Camillus Eboh, George Obulutsa
items.creator: Camillus Eboh, George Obulutsa
items.summary: Uma análise genômica do único caso confirmado de Ebola na Nigéria mostra que o vírus está estreitamente relacionado à cepa detectada no primeiro caso registrado no Quênia, disse nesta sexta-feira o ministro da Saúde nigeriano, Muhammad Ali Pate, fornecendo a primeira ligação genética entre os surtos.
items.body:
Uma análise genômica do único caso confirmado de Ebola na Nigéria mostra que o vírus está estreitamente relacionado à cepa detectada no primeiro caso registrado no Quênia, disse nesta sexta-feira o ministro da Saúde nigeriano, Muhammad Ali Pate, fornecendo a primeira ligação genética entre os surtos.
As autoridades nigerianas afirmaram que não há evidências de que o caso do Quênia tenha viajado para a Nigéria ou tenha tido uma conexão direta com o caso nigeriano.
Pate disse que os contatos ligados ao caso estão sendo rastreados, colocados em quarentena e testados, com alguns resultados negativos e outros ainda pendentes
A Nigéria registrou apenas um caso confirmado de Ebola, de um viajante que havia visitado Uganda
Uganda, que faz fronteira com a República Democrática do Congo (RDC) e já enfrentou surtos de Ebola anteriormente, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que continuava livre do Ebola, mas estava reforçando as precauções
O Ministério da Saúde de Uganda informou que os formulários de localização de viajantes foram restabelecidos para todos os que chegam ao país, independentemente do país de origem
Uganda informou que viajantes com histórico de viagem à RDC, onde o surto teve início, não terão permissão para transitar pelo país

Brazil great Ronaldinho will return to competitive football next month when he plays for Italian third-tier side Ravenna against local rivals Forli on November 15, the Serie C club announced on Friday.
The 46-year-old former Barcelona and AC Milan forward, who won the 2002 World Cup with Brazil and the Ballon d'Or in 2005, last played competitively for Brazilian club Fluminense in 2015. He officially retired in 2018.
Ravenna signed Ronaldinho in June and he later acquired a stake in the club, which is owned by his friend Ignazio Cipriani.
Cipriani said the move was intended "to bring the whole city closer to the team".
[USN:L8N44H1KF TEXT:"Ronaldinho"] stopped short of confirming he would play when he arrived in Italy in August, although he left open the prospect of scoring the 300th goal of his career.
"I'm here to help," he said at the time.
The derby against Forli will take place at Ravenna's Stadio Bruno Benelli. Ravenna sit second in Serie C Group B with 20 points from 10 games, eight behind leaders Spezia.

items.title: Acuerdo de El Salvador con el FMI alivia la deuda de pensiones, pero persiste riesgo fiscal: Moody’s
items.author: Fátima Romero
items.summary: El acuerdo sobre pensiones entre El Salvador y el FMI reduce el riesgo de tensiones de liquidez en 2027, pero Moody’s advierte que la deuda pública superará el 90% del PIB ese año.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Moody’s Ratings consideró que el acuerdo alcanzado entre El Salvador y el Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) sobre la deuda de pensiones “reducirá sustancialmente el riesgo de que esta obligación se convierta en un evento disruptivo de liquidez” en 2027. Ver más: FMI aprueba US$139 millones para El Salvador tras exención por incumplimiento sobre bitcoin En un comentario publicado esta semana, la agencia, que mantiene al país en B3 con perspectiva positiva, advirtió que ese alivio no sustituye el mantenimiento de una postura fiscal estricta para garantizar la sostenibilidad de la deuda. La evaluación se apoya en la decisión del FMI del 1 de octubre de completar la segunda y tercera revisión del programa de Servicio Ampliado del FMI (EFF). La culminación de las revisiones habilitó un desembolso inmediato de unos US$138 millones y, según Moody’s, aporta mayor claridad sobre uno de los riesgos de mediano plazo más discutidos: una obligación cercana a los US$2.300 millones contraída con las administradoras de fondos de pensiones privados, equivalente al 5,5% del PIB. Ese monto corresponde a intereses y transferencias previsionales no pagados que se devengaron durante el periodo de gracia de cuatro años establecido por la reforma de pensiones de 2022, que aplazó los pasivos previsionales y suspendió el pago de capital e intereses de una porción importante de esa deuda hasta abril de 2027. Durante ese lapso los intereses siguen acumulándose, y la cercanía del vencimiento se ha convertido en una fuente potencial de presión financiera y de volatilidad de mercado. Para atenderla, el FMI describe un marco en el que la mayor parte del monto podría capitalizarse en nuevos certificados de pensiones de largo plazo, con amortización extendida y servicio mediante pagos regulares de capital e intereses a partir de finales de 2027. “La operación ya se ha incorporado a las proyecciones de referencia del FMI y forma parte de una estrategia más amplia de reforma de las pensiones destinada a mejorar tanto la liquidez del sistema de pensiones como su sostenibilidad a largo plazo”, dijo Moody’s. Desde la perspectiva crediticia, la agencia califica el avance como positivo en la medida en que permite la continuidad del programa con el FMI, demuestra la cooperación sostenida entre las autoridades y el organismo, y reduce la incertidumbre en torno a un pasivo importante que representaba una fuente de riesgo de incumplimiento. La operación, sin embargo, no elimina el reto subyacente que supone la carga de la deuda de El Salvador, que sigue siendo elevada y que, según estimaciones de Moody’s, aumentará hasta superar el 90% del PIB en 2027, cuando se lleve a cabo la operación. Ver más: El bitcoin pierde espacio en El Salvador mientras el FMI pone la reforma de pensiones en el centro Cerca de 30 puntos porcentuales del PIB salvadoreño están asociados a obligaciones de pensiones de largo plazo, aunque las implicaciones para el flujo de caja son considerablemente más manejables que lo que sugiere la cifra total. En sus proyecciones, el FMI sitúa la deuda bruta del sector público no financiero en 89,2% del PIB para 2027, frente al 85,0% proyectado para 2026, un nivel que ya incorpora el reconocimiento de los US$2.300 millones. Por eso, la agencia sostiene que la operación resuelve una importante incertidumbre de liquidez, pero no modifica de manera sustancial la necesidad de mantener superávits primarios sostenidos y avanzar en una mayor consolidación fiscal en los próximos años. “La consideración clave para el perfil crediticio de El Salvador sigue siendo si el Gobierno puede mantener la disciplina fiscal necesaria para situar la deuda en una trayectoria descendente sostenida tras el aumento puntual de la deuda declarada asociado al reconocimiento de las pensiones”, señaló la agencia. Desde la aprobación del programa con el FMI, en febrero de 2025, con acceso a financiamiento por unos US$1.400 millones, la posición de financiamiento de El Salvador ha mejorado de forma sustancial y el crecimiento económico se ha fortalecido. Ver más: ¿Cuánta deuda pública le corresponde a cada persona? Estos son los países con mayor deuda per cápita en Latinoamérica La consolidación fiscal ha avanzado, los colchones de liquidez del Gobierno se han reforzado y los diferenciales soberanos han caído desde los niveles de distrés de 2022 hasta niveles moderados que reflejan un acceso consistente al mercado. La última revisión del FMI también destacó los esfuerzos para reconstruir los depósitos gubernamentales y mejorar las prácticas de gestión de deuda de cara a 2027. La economía salvadoreña creció 5,06% en el segundo trimestre, lo que podría convertirse en un crecimiento de 4,5% y 5% al cierre de 2026, según el Banco Central de Reserva (BCR).

items.title: Moody's maintient la note souveraine de la France à "Aa3"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'agence de notation Moody's a décidé vendredi de maintenir la note de crédit de la France à "Aa3", assortie d'une perspective négative, alors que la plupart des analystes s'attendaient à une dégradation à "A1".
items.body:
L'agence de notation Moody's a décidé vendredi de maintenir la note de crédit de la France à "Aa3", assortie d'une perspective négative, alors que la plupart des analystes s'attendaient à une dégradation à "A1".
"La notation Aa3 repose sur l'hypothèse qu'un budget réduisant le déficit sera adopté pour 2027, tandis que les coûts de financement et les tensions sociales s'atténueront quelque peu au cours des prochains mois", indique Moody's dans un communiqué.
"Cette annonce déjoue les pronostics déclinistes de nombreux 'experts' et de ceux qui spéculent sur la dette française", a réagi le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu sur son compte X.
"Le gouvernement a proposé au Parlement un budget sérieux avec une réduction du déficit permis par des efforts partagés", a poursuivi le Premier ministre, saluant l'action des forces politiques qui, sans majorité, ont accepté d'ouvrir le débat sur le budget dans un calendrier normal.
"Ce signal montre à nos prêteurs qu'il existe un chemin. Il nous appartient de le poursuivre pour donner à la France un budget d'ici la fin de l'année, conforme à l'objectif de 5% de déficit", écrit encore Sébastien Lecornu.
Le ministre de l'Economie, Roland Lescure, a dit pour sa part prendre acte de la décision de Moody's, qui devrait alléger la pression sur le gouvernement dans un contexte de finances mises à rude épreuve et de troubles sociaux.
"Cette décision est la reconnaissance de la solidité de notre économie et de la crédibilité du budget présenté par le gouvernement dans le projet de loi de finances pour 2027, qui vise à poursuivre le rétablissement des comptes publics", a écrit Roland Lescure sur le réseau social Bluesky et dans un communiqué publié par le ministère français des Finances.
Une dégradation par Moody's de la note de la France aurait aligné celle-ci sur les décisions prises en 2025 par [USN:L5N3VY1MP TEXT:"Standard & Poor's"] et [USN:L5N3UZ1HN TEXT:"Fitch"].
La France peine cependant à maîtriser ses finances publiques avec une situation qui s'est aggravée depuis que les élections législatives anticipées de 2024 ont abouti à un Parlement divisé en trois grands blocs, sans majorité, provoquant ainsi une quasi paralysie politique.
Selon le projet de loi de finances, la France table sur un déficit budgétaire à 5,4% du produit intérieur brut (PIB) pour cette année et le gouvernement prévoit de ramener ce déficit à 5,0% en 2027.
La dette publique, quant à elle, devrait atteindre 119,3% du PIB cette année et pourrait grimper à 121,7% en 2027, alors que ce ratio était de 115,7% en 2025.
Une baisse à l'avenir de la note de la France pourrait réduire le nombre d'investisseurs capables ou disposés à détenir des obligations françaises ou à les accepter en garantie.
Les coûts d'emprunt de la France dépassent déjà ceux de pays moins bien notés comme l'Italie, les investisseurs s'inquiétant du niveau du déficit budgétaire – l'un des plus importants de la zone euro – et à l'incertitude liée à l'approche de l'élection présidentielle, prévue les 18 avril et 2 mai.
Les sondages laissent entrevoir une possible victoire de Marine Le Pen, candidate du parti d'extrême droite Rassemblement national (RN), contre Jean-Luc Mélenchon, leader de La France Insoumise (LFI), perçu comme une formation d'extrême gauche.
items.raw_description: L'agence de notation Moody's a décidé vendredi de maintenir la note de crédit de la France à "Aa3", assortie d'une perspective négative, alors que la plupart des analystes s'attendaient à une dégradation à "A1".

items.title: Francia se libra de la rebaja de la calificación de Moody's mientras se enfrenta a los disturbios
items.author: Leigh Thomas, Dhara Ranasinghe
items.creator: Leigh Thomas, Dhara Ranasinghe
items.summary: Moody's evitó el viernes una rebaja de la calificación crediticia de Francia, lo que alivió la presión sobre un Gobierno que lucha por contener el malestar social y reforzar sus maltrechas finanzas.
items.body:
Moody's evitó el viernes una rebaja de la calificación crediticia de Francia, lo que alivió la presión sobre un Gobierno que lucha por contener el malestar social y reforzar sus maltrechas finanzas.
Moody's afirmó que había concluido una revisión periódica de su calificación, manteniéndola en Aa3, con perspectiva negativa desde el pasado mes de octubre.
Los mercados de bonos ya habían descontado una rebaja, lo que habría alineado a Moody's con Standard & Poor's y Fitch, que ya habían tomado medidas mientras Francia luchaba por controlar sus finanzas públicas tras unas elecciones anticipadas de 2024 que dieron lugar a un parlamento sin mayoría y a una parálisis política.
El Ministerio de Hacienda francés señaló en un comunicado que el hecho de que Moody's mantuviera inalterada su calificación reflejaba la "credibilidad del presupuesto que el Gobierno ha presentado en el proyecto de ley de presupuestos para 2027, diseñado para mantener nuestras finanzas públicas en la senda de la recuperación".
El Gobierno está teniendo dificultades para aprobar el proyecto de ley en el Parlamento, donde los partidos de la oposición podrían negarse a llegar a un acuerdo, rechazar la legislación y derrocarlo mediante un voto de censura.
"La calificación Aa3 parte de la base de que se aprobará un presupuesto de reducción del déficit para 2027, mientras que los costos de financiación y las tensiones sociales remitirán en cierta medida en los próximos meses", señaló Moody's en un comunicado.
Los costos de financiación de Francia ya superan a los de países con calificaciones más bajas, como Italia.
Los inversionistas se muestran preocupados por el déficit presupuestario —uno de los mayores de la zona del euro— y por las elecciones presidenciales del 18 de abril y el 2 de mayo del próximo año, en las que las encuestas sugieren que la extrema derecha podría ganar.
Las imágenes televisivas de las protestas del fin de semana, que degeneraron en disturbios y saqueos, ponen de relieve la dificultad política que supone sacar adelante los recortes presupuestarios.
Esto contribuyó a que, el jueves, la prima de riesgo de la deuda pública francesa frente a los bonos alemanes —considerados un valor refugio— alcanzara su nivel más alto en 15 años, mientras que el rendimiento del bono de referencia francés a 10 años se situó en el 5,14%, su nivel más alto desde julio de 2002.
Moody's afirmó a principios de este mes que la capacidad del Gobierno francés para superar la "fragmentación en el Parlamento" sería el factor clave para su próxima decisión sobre la calificación.
Esa tarea parece más difícil después de que las violentas protestas por la falta de financiación de las escuelas se intensificaran el fin de semana hasta convertirse en disturbios durante las manifestaciones masivas contra el costo de la vida.
El Gobierno se ha negado a destinar más fondos a la educación o a aumentar el salario mínimo, y están previstas nuevas protestas el sábado.
En el Parlamento, la Cámara Baja ha rechazado algunas medidas de ahorro clave del presupuesto para 2027, que prevé un déficit del 5% del PIB frente al 5,4% de este año.

items.title: Judge approves defunct talc supplier's $535 million settlement with Berkshire affiliate
items.author: Dietrich Knauth
items.creator: Dietrich Knauth
items.summary: A US bankruptcy judge has approved a $535 million settlement between a defunct talc supplier and Berkshire Hathaway’s insurance unit, overruling objections that the deal would provide too little money to resolve lawsuits alleging the company’s talc contained asbestos and caused cancer.
items.body:
A US bankruptcy judge has approved a $535 million settlement between a defunct talc supplier and Berkshire Hathaway’s insurance unit, overruling objections that the deal would provide too little money to resolve lawsuits alleging the company’s talc contained asbestos and caused cancer.
US bankruptcy judge Michael Kaplan in New Jersey on Thursday ruled that Whittaker Clark & Daniels' settlement was fair and reasonable, based on his evaluation of the talc litigation claims and the claimants' ability to win judgments against the company's former corporate parents. The settlement aims to resolve liabilities of Berkshire's National Indemnity Co., which purchased Whittaker Clark & Daniels and assumed its liabilities in 2007, and other former corporate affiliates like chemical distributor Brenntag.
Whittaker filed for bankruptcy in 2023, citing a “deluge” of lawsuits from roughly 2,700 people who alleged the company supplied asbestos-contaminated talc to makers of cosmetics, chemicals and other products, causing cancer.
Talc claimants argued that the settlement was an insider deal between the defunct Whittaker and its corporate owners and affiliates, which resolved those companies' liabilities without any input from talc claimants. The deal was designed to shield well-heeled companies that could be liable for billions of dollars in talc claims, like National Indemnity Co., Berkshire Hathaway, former corporate affiliate Brenntag, and others with a shared corporate history, according to talc claimants.
The talc claimants had asked the court for permission to sue Brenntag, National Indemnity Co., and other potential corporate successors for a higher contribution, but Kaplan denied that request. Kaplan ruled that Whittaker was responsible for suing those companies for indemnification and contribution to the bankruptcy, and that other plaintiffs could not usurp legal claims that were property of the debtor.
Suzanne Ratcliffe, an attorney who represents asbestos claimants in the bankruptcy, said that the ruling was "wrong" and that she planned to appeal.
"This order blesses a greed-fueled insider 'settlement' between Whittaker and multi-billionaires — including Berkshire Hathaway affiliates — a settlement which no victim wants or asked for,” Ratcliffe said in a statement.
The talc claimants have filed a petition with the US Supreme Court to challenge an earlier ruling in the case, saying that debtors should not be able to use bankruptcy to block plaintiffs who want to sue a bankrupt company's non-bankrupt owners. The Supreme Court has not acted on that petition.
Whittaker operated one of the largest talc and industrial compound supply and distribution businesses in the US in the 1970s and 1980s, but it ceased operations in 2004. Its corporate existence since then has largely been devoted to resolving a growing wave of legal claims related to its decades-long production of talc and industrial chemicals.
Brenntag acquired Whittaker's operating assets in 2004, while leaving the asbestos liabilities with Whittaker. National Indemnity Co. later bought Whittaker and assumed its remaining assets and liabilities. Brenntag has denied being responsible for the defunct company's talc liabilities.
The case is Whittaker Clark & Daniels Inc. et al., US Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey, 23-1357
For Whittaker Clark & Daniels: Chad Husnick and Joshua Sussberg of Kirkland & Ellis LLP, Michael Sirota and Felice Yudkin of Cole Schotz P.C., among others.
For the official committee of talc claimants: Arthur Abramowitz of Sherman Silverstein, among others
For talc claimant Juliet Gray: Suzanne Ratcliffe and Clay Thompson of Maune Raichle Hartley French

items.title: Fiscal general Costa Rica dice nuevas operaciones conjuntas con la DEA se enfocarán en políticos y empresarios
items.author: Alvaro Murillo
items.creator: Alvaro Murillo
items.summary: Costa Rica intensificará su cooperación con la Administración para el Control de Drogas (DEA) de Estados Unidos para perseguir delincuentes que el fiscal general del país, recientemente reelecto, denomina "narcotraficantes invisibles", incluyendo empresarios y políticos que ocultan sus presuntos vínculos con el tráfico de drogas tras una imagen pública respetable.
items.body:
Costa Rica intensificará su cooperación con la Administración para el Control de Drogas (DEA) de Estados Unidos para perseguir delincuentes que el fiscal general del país, recientemente reelecto, denomina "narcotraficantes invisibles", incluyendo empresarios y políticos que ocultan sus presuntos vínculos con el tráfico de drogas tras una imagen pública respetable.
El fiscal general Carlo Díaz, que se ha enfrentado en repetidas ocasiones al Gobierno de la presidenta Laura Fernández, fue reelecto el lunes por el Poder Judicial para un nuevo mandato de cuatro años. En una entrevista concedida a Reuters el jueves, afirmó que los investigadores no mostrarían clemencia alguna si los implicados ocupaban puestos de alto nivel.
“Esta segunda etapa va enfocada a objetivos que hemos denominado ‘narcotraficantes invisibles’, declaró Díaz, tras una fase inicial de misiones conjuntas dirigidas contra miembros de organizaciones criminales.
“Son personas empresarias, a veces profesionales, a veces políticos, que son exitosos en la sociedad o personas muy visibles. Sin embargo, detrás de esa fachada está la vinculación directa con ese tipo de actividades”, añadió.
Díaz también elogió la capacidad de Costa Rica para extraditar a sus propios ciudadanos a Estados Unidos como un hito en la lucha contra la delincuencia transnacional y señaló que se había extraditado a seis personas y que había otros 25 procedimientos de extradición en curso.
La oficina de la DEA no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.
El Gobierno de Costa Rica ya ha colaborado anteriormente con la DEA para detener a decenas de narcotraficantes, a quienes las autoridades costarricenses consideran responsables del aumento de las tasas de homicidios en los últimos años en esta nación centroamericana, que durante mucho tiempo había gozado de paz.
Las autoridades estadounidenses han señalado que Costa Rica actúa como un corredor clave para el traslado de narcóticos desde Sudamérica hacia Estados Unidos.
Fernández, una aliada conservadora del presidente Donald Trump, ha alineado estrechamente a Costa Rica con Washington en materia de seguridad, sumándose a la iniciativa[USN:L6N45E101 TEXT:" "Escudo de las Américas""] del presidente estadounidense contra el narcotráfico y el crimen organizado.
DIVISIONES POLÍTICAS Díaz afirmó que los responsables de la DEA le habían expresado directamente su preocupación por las divisiones políticas e institucionales en Costa Rica, que, según él, están obstaculizando la lucha contra el crimen organizado. Se ha enfrentado en repetidas ocasiones con Fernández y con su predecesor, Rodrigo Chaves, acusando al Gobierno de intentar debilitar al poder judicial.
A pesar de respaldar una cooperación más estrecha con la DEA, Díaz rechazó la sugerencia de Fernández del mes pasado de que Costa Rica podría beneficiarse de la presencia de [USN:L6N44W128 TEXT:"fuerzas estadounidenses"] operando en su territorio.
“Si nos enfocamos en dar los recursos que necesita la Fuerza Pública, esta podría tomar el control territorial sin necesidad de traer fuerzas armadas de otros países”, afirmó.
El gobierno de Fernández ha construido una prisión con capacidad para 5.100 reclusos siguiendo el modelo de la campaña de seguridad de El Salvador, un enfoque que Díaz ha cuestionado en el marco de sus enfrentamientos con el Gobierno. Afirmó que la prisión podría aliviar el hacinamiento, pero que por sí sola no frenaría el crimen organizado y subrayó que el panorama delictivo de Costa Rica difiere notablemente de el de El Salvador.
La tasa de homicidios en Costa Rica, considerada durante mucho tiempo uno de los países más seguros de la región, alcanzó su máximo en 2023 con 17,2 por cada 100.000 habitantes, lo que supone 906 asesinatos, con una ligera disminución en 2024 y 2025.
"Este es uno de los momentos más complejos de nuestra historia", afirmó Díaz. "(La DEA) está muy consciente de la situación".

items.title: Morocco expects stable fiscal deficit despite tax cuts in 2027
items.author: Ahmed Eljechtimi
items.creator: Ahmed Eljechtimi
items.summary: Morocco expects a steady fiscal deficit at 3% of GDP despite higher spending on social programmes and tax cuts, newly appointed finance and economy minister Fouzi Lekjaa said on Friday.
items.body:
Morocco expects a steady fiscal deficit at 3% of GDP despite higher spending on social programmes and tax cuts, newly appointed finance and economy minister Fouzi Lekjaa said on Friday.
The economy is expected to grow 3.7% in 2027, down from a forecast of 4.7% this year, assuming an average crop year, Lekjaa told members of parliament while presenting the 2027 draft budget.
Morocco announced a [USN:S8N3UN004 TEXT:"new government coalition"] last week following [USN:S8N3SV012 TEXT:"September 23 elections"], placing priority on purchasing power, social services and youth employment, one year after [USN:L2N3VI14N TEXT:"GenZ protests"] and the [USN:L6N4410N7 TEXT:"Ceuta migration crisis"] in July.
The government's social policies in previous years have been weakened by an [USN:L6N3VN095 TEXT:"economic model"] that prioritised market forces over regulation, fostering monopolistic practices, rent-seeking and quick profits, Lekjaa said.
"Savage capitalism and neo-liberalism" have been at the heart of social tension, he said, urging a stronger role for the state in combating corruption, conflicts of interest and monopolies, while safeguarding food and energy sovereignty.
In total, the government plans to spend 62 billion dirhams ($6.3 billion) next year on measures aimed at improving social services, boosting purchasing power and reducing inequalities, Lekjaa said.
The measures include reforming distribution channels for basic goods, promoting youth employment and exempting salaries of less than 10,000 dirhams a month, which would account for 87% of all employees, from income tax, he said.
The package also includes pension increases, higher financial aid for needy families and electricity subsidies.
The health budget would rise 7% to 45.5 billion dirhams, while education spending would increase 4.6% to 121 billion dirhams, according to the draft budget.
The draft also authorises defence expenditure commitments of up to 190.5 billion dirhams.
Public debt is forecast to decline to 66.9% of GDP in 2027 from 67.5% this year, the budget document showed.
The government proposes raising to 40% the tax rate on profits above 100 million dirhams earned by fuel distribution companies, a sector previously sanctioned by competition authorities for anti-competitive practices.
The draft budget increases excise taxes on soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, cigarettes and e-cigarettes.
The government's financing requirement is expected to fall 7.4% to 159 billion dirhams in 2027 as it seeks to balance domestic and external borrowing "depending on market conditions," according to the draft budget.

Oct 23 : Australia's reigning world champion Molly Picklum won the Portugal Pro in thumping tubes on Friday, claiming her first victory of the year and jumping to the top of the rankings with just two events of surfing's world tour remaining.
California's Griffin Colapinto scored a near-perfect barrel to come from behind and claim the win over Brazil's Gabriel Medina in the men's final, notching up his third victory at the powerful Portuguese beach break of Supertubos.
Picklum has had a strong if not spectacular season after winning her first world title in Fiji last year, but had made only one final and set her sights on securing a win in Portugal ahead of the season finale in Hawaii in December.
"It was a dream of mine to win here," the 23-year-old said. "Portugal is like the cross between the Brazilian energy and Pipeline. Those are two of my favourite things.

"I’m really happy to hit my stride at the right time. We work so hard and not many people get to win, but I’m so stoked to get my win this year.”
Up against California's 2024 world champion Caitlin Simmers in the final, Picklum slipped behind in the early exchanges before locking into a deep, overhead tube on her backhand that scored 7.83 out of 10 and gave her the lead. Simmers threaded some nice tubes of her own but ended with a two-wave total of 12.84 to Picklum's 13.33.
Colapinto, 28, has developed a special relationship with the powerful, punchy tubes around the seaside town of Peniche, securing event wins in 2022, 2024 and now 2026.
He started strongly in the final, hustling Medina for the first wave, pulling into a deep barrel on his forehand and finishing it strongly. He scored an excellent 8.17 and backed it up quickly with a similar wave to pile the pressure on Medina. 
But Brazil's three-time world champion responded with an incredible barrel of his own on his backhand, squeezing out when all hope seemed lost, then took the lead with another long tube.
Needing something special, Colapinto found a gem on his backhand, disappearing behind the curtain for the entire wave and emerging near the packed crowd on the beach for a 9.43 out of a possible 10 and a lead he held until the clock ran out.
“That’s the dream. How good were the waves out there?” said Colapinto, who climbed to third in the rankings after his win. “The battle with Gabriel was unreal ... Portugal has a big place in my heart."
The tour heads next to a new stop in the Philippines before the last event of the year at Pipeline, where 1.5 times points will be on offer.

items.body:
O Banco Central aprovou três resoluções sobre as responsabilidades de instituições financeiras na oferta e concessão de crédito, com novas salvaguardas contra ofertas inadequadas ou abusivas e maior transparência antes da contratação, segundo nota divulgada nesta sexta-feira.
A primeira delas estabelece que as instituições deverão oferecer mecanismo claro para o bloqueio de propagandas e ofertas ativas.
A segunda diz que as empresas deverão oferecer aos clientes o Painel de Dívidas Consolidadas, "que reunirá informações sobre suas operações de crédito e ampliará a transparência sobre o nível de endividamento e o comprometimento da capacidade de pagamento".
Além disso, as instituições deverão disponibilizar informações e ferramentas como simulador de crédito e ambiente para consulta das operações contratadas.
O BC estabeleceu ainda novas regras para a oferta de crédito durante a iniciação de transações Pix, "com maior proteção e transparência para os usuários".
As novas normas entram em vigor entre março e julho de 2027, disse o Banco Central.

items.title: Reigning champion Picklum takes first win of the season in Portugal tubefest
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Australia's reigning world champion Molly Picklum won the Portugal Pro in thumping tubes on Friday, claiming her first victory of the year and jumping to the top of the rankings with just two events of surfing's world tour remaining.
items.body:
Australia's reigning world champion Molly Picklum won the Portugal Pro in thumping tubes on Friday, claiming her first victory of the year and jumping to the top of the rankings with just two events of surfing's world tour remaining.
California's Griffin Colapinto scored a near-perfect barrel to come from behind and claim the win over Brazil's Gabriel Medina in the men's final, notching up his third victory at the powerful Portuguese beach break of Supertubos.
Picklum has had a strong if not spectacular season after winning her first [USN:L4N3UI1HG TEXT:"world title in Fiji"] last year, but had made only one final and set her sights on securing a win in Portugal ahead of the season finale in Hawaii in December.
"It was a dream of mine to win here," the 23-year-old said. "Portugal is like the cross between the Brazilian energy and Pipeline. Those are two of my favourite things.
"I’m really happy to hit my stride at the right time. We work so hard and not many people get to win, but I’m so stoked to get my win this year.”
Up against California's 2024 world champion Caitlin Simmers in the final, Picklum slipped behind in the early exchanges before locking into a deep, overhead tube on her backhand that scored 7.83 out of 10 and gave her the lead. Simmers threaded some nice tubes of her own but ended with a two-wave total of 12.84 to Picklum's 13.33.
Colapinto, 28, has developed a special relationship with the powerful, punchy tubes around the seaside town of Peniche, securing event wins in 2022, 2024 and now 2026.
He started strongly in the final, hustling Medina for the first wave, pulling into a deep barrel on his forehand and finishing it strongly. He scored an excellent 8.17 and backed it up quickly with a similar wave to pile the pressure on Medina.
But Brazil's three-time world champion responded with an incredible barrel of his own on his backhand, squeezing out when all hope seemed lost, then took the lead with another long tube.
Needing something special, Colapinto found a gem on his backhand, disappearing behind the curtain for the entire wave and emerging near the packed crowd on the beach for a 9.43 out of a possible 10 and a lead he held until the clock ran out.
“That’s the dream. How good were the waves out there?” said Colapinto, who climbed to third in the rankings after his win. “The battle with Gabriel was unreal ... Portugal has a big place in my heart."
The tour heads next to a new stop in the Philippines before the last event of the year at Pipeline, where 1.5 times points will be on offer.

items.title: USDA corrige los datos sobre el maíz de septiembre debido a un "error de procesamiento"
items.author: Tom Polansek
items.creator: Tom Polansek
items.summary: El Departamento de Agricultura de EEUU (USDA) informó el viernes que ha corregido los datos sobre el maíz que publicó en septiembre después de que un "error de procesamiento" afectara a las previsiones de rendimiento y producción del país.
items.body:
El Departamento de Agricultura de EEUU (USDA) informó el viernes que ha corregido los datos sobre el maíz que publicó en septiembre después de que un "error de procesamiento" afectara a las previsiones de rendimiento y producción del país.
El USDA se ha visto sometido al escrutinio de los comerciantes de cereales, analistas y economistas en cuanto a la fiabilidad de sus estimaciones de cosechas debido a una serie de errores en los datos.
La agencia, considerada desde hace tiempo como la referencia por excelencia en materia de información sobre el mercado agrícola mundial, había afirmado anteriormente que estaba tratando de mejorar las estimaciones de cosechas.
El Servicio Nacional de Estadísticas Agrícolas (NASS) del USDA descubrió el error tras surgir inquietudes sobre un informe de cosechas de este mes que preveía que los agricultores estadounidenses cosecharían más bushels de maíz de lo esperado inicialmente, según el comunicado.
La previsión de cosecha, superior a lo esperado, provocó una caída de los futuros del maíz estadounidense.
"El NASS detectó un error de procesamiento que afectó a las densidades de siembra de maíz de septiembre, al recuento de mazorcas, a los rendimientos y a la producción en Kansas y Nebraska", sostuvo el comunicado.
"El error también afectó a los promedios de 10 estados correspondientes a septiembre en cuanto a densidades de plantación y recuento de mazorcas, así como a las previsiones de rendimiento y producción de maíz en EEUU".
Un informe corregido que el USDA publicó en su página web mostraba un rendimiento del maíz en septiembre de 178,8 bushels por acre. El mes pasado, el USDA indicó que su estimación del rendimiento para septiembre era de 178,5 bushels por acre.
El USDA revisó su estimación de producción de septiembre a 15.828 millones de bushels, frente a la estimación original de septiembre de 15.800 millones.
Las previsiones de cosechas para octubre se revisaron, se validaron y no han variado, informó el USDA.

items.title: PHP Foundation 'under-funded' with one full-time staff member, director says
items.author: Toby Sterling
items.creator: Toby Sterling
items.summary: The discovery of two serious flaws in PHP this week set off a global scramble to keep websites safe from hackers, showing just how critical the three-decade-old open-source programming language is to the internet.
items.body:
The discovery of two serious flaws in PHP this week set off a global scramble to keep websites [USN:L1N468095 TEXT:"safe from hackers, "]showing just how critical the three-decade-old open-source programming language is to the internet.
Yet the nonprofit foundation that supports PHP, which may underpin up to 70% of sites globally, operates on a shoestring budget.
“We have one full-time staff member (that's me) and 14 mostly part-time contractors,” Executive Director Elizabeth Barron of the PHP Foundation said via email in an interview on Friday. Board members are unpaid volunteers, and funding comes from donations and grants.
The foundation works with outside researchers and companies, including OpenAI and cybersecurity firms Wiz and Calif, to investigate security flaws and coordinate fixes, including Wednesday's patches.
While Web security company Cloudflare has reported millions of hacking attempts, Barron said the foundation had no evidence hackers were able to exploit the vulnerabilities before they were disclosed, or on sites that have been patched.
"We received no further indication from OpenAI, Wiz or Calif, with whom we're working closely on this issue, regarding any issues on patched systems,” she said.
Artificial intelligence has proved both a help and a burden to the foundation. It helped researchers find the flaws, which had been present for a decade, and Barron said it made programmers more efficient.
However, it is also increasing maintainers' workloads. The PHP project is receiving nearly twice as many proposed code changes as a year ago, “yet the number of contributors hasn't doubled,” she said. Reviewing contributions and bug reports requires “a massive amount of human input and experience.”
Recent events have shown how heavily companies and governments rely on PHP, Barron said.
“Given that reliance, it is clear that PHP is incredibly under-funded.”

items.title: Líder norcoreano Kim aboga por una "revolución militar", pide que se refuercen las unidades del ejército
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El líder norcoreano Kim Jong Un instó a que las compañías del ejército del país se conviertan en unidades de combate de élite y autosuficientes durante una reunión de dos días de los comandantes de compañía celebrada en Pyongyang, informó el sábado la agencia estatal de noticias KCNA.
items.body:
El líder norcoreano Kim Jong Un instó a que las compañías del ejército del país se conviertan en unidades de combate de élite y autosuficientes durante una reunión de dos días de los comandantes de compañía celebrada en Pyongyang, informó el sábado la agencia estatal de noticias KCNA.
El evento puso de relieve la prioridad política constante de Kim de fortalecer el ejército.
En un discurso en una conferencia de comandantes de compañía del Ejército el 22 y 23 de octubre —que, según KCNA, fue la primera de todo el ejército desde el IX Congreso del partido gobernante de Corea del Norte celebrado en febrero—, Kim instó a todas las compañías a prepararse a fondo para que se pueda alcanzar "el objetivo del refuerzo militar de la nueva era".
"Construyamos el ejército más fuerte y aceleremos una revolución militar a nuestra manera", afirmó Kim.
Durante el IX Congreso del partido gobernante de Corea del Norte de febrero, en el que se estableció la dirección del país para los próximos cinco años, Kim abogó por unas fuerzas armadas convencionales más fuertes, al tiempo que reafirmó los esfuerzos para desarrollar armas nucleares y misiles.
