items.title: Alguns parisienses compram spray de pimenta e gás lacrimogêneo, alegando legítima defesa antes de protestos
items.author: Elizabeth Howcroft, Ardee Napolitano
items.creator: Elizabeth Howcroft, Ardee Napolitano
items.summary: Os parisienses estão comprando cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo e sprays de pimenta para se defenderem e protegerem seus bens durante os protestos, que devem continuar ao longo do fim de semana, disse à Reuters o proprietário de uma loja de armas na capital francesa.
items.body:
Os parisienses estão comprando cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo e sprays de pimenta para se defenderem e protegerem seus bens durante os protestos, que devem continuar ao longo do fim de semana, disse à Reuters o proprietário de uma loja de armas na capital francesa.
A França foi atingida pelo pior levante social dos últimos anos no último fim de semana, quando protestos em todo o país contra os altos preços e a deterioração dos serviços públicos se transformaram em tumultos. Uma prefeitura foi incendiada, lojas foram saqueadas e prédios cobertos de pichações, enquanto grupos violentos entraram em confronto com a polícia em cidades por todo o país.
A polícia autorizou apenas uma manifestação sindical em Paris no sábado, rejeitando os pedidos de manifestações apresentados pela principal união estudantil da França, a Unef, e pelo movimento antissistema dos Coletes Amarelos.
Na loja de armas Armurerie de la Bourse, no centro de Paris, o proprietário Yves Gollety disse à Reuters que observou um grande aumento nas vendas de armas não letais desde o fim de semana. Lojas a apenas 30 metros de distância foram saqueadas, com suas persianas arrancadas, disse ele.
“É a primeira vez que vemos um aumento desse tipo, e em todos os segmentos da população”, disse Gollety, acrescentando que entre seus clientes estão lojistas, donos de restaurantes e pessoas físicas.
“As pessoas ficaram traumatizadas fisicamente e estão com medo”, disse ele.
Os produtos mais vendidos são sprays de pimenta e cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo, que, segundo Gollety, só podem ser usados em legítima defesa. Gollety, que também é presidente da associação nacional de armeiros, disse ao jornal francês Le Parisien que os pedidos aumentaram dez vezes.
O público em geral só tem permissão para comprar pequenos recipientes com menos de 100 mililitros, disse Gollety. A Reuters não encontrou evidências de que as pessoas em Paris estivessem comprando outros tipos de armas em resposta aos protestos.
Alain Di Crescenzo, presidente da Câmara de Comércio da França, pediu aos lojistas que se abstivessem de usar armas para defender seus negócios. Em entrevista à emissora de rádio Europe 1 nesta sexta-feira, ele disse ter visto pessoalmente lojistas se armando com tacos de beisebol, pés-de-cabra e espingardas. A Reuters não conseguiu verificar essa informação de forma independente.
“É extremamente preocupante”, disse ele. “Não é função deles fazer isso... Isso só aumentaria o sofrimento.”
“A polícia deve ter liberdade para fazer seu trabalho, e recomendo a máxima cautela”, acrescentou.
“É PRECISO ESTAR PREPARADO” Um lojista que vende motos e scooters no 15º arrondissement de Paris disse à Reuters que comprou três grandes cartuchos de gás lacrimogêneo, além de outro menor, para proteger sua loja.
“Você pode ser pego de surpresa, com pessoas chegando sem qualquer aviso prévio. Por isso, é preciso estar preparado”, disse o lojista, que pediu para não ser identificado.
O governo francês prometeu reforçar a segurança e mobilizará 70 mil policiais, apoiados por unidades especializadas, para os protestos de sábado, mas o aumento no número de pessoas pensando em como se defender ilustra os temores dos parisienses à medida que o fim de semana se aproxima.
Um homem que visitava a loja de Gollety, um funcionário do setor financeiro de 58 anos que não quis se identificar, disse que havia pesquisado opções de autodefesa, embora, no fim das contas, não tivesse comprado nada nessa ocasião.
“Considerando o que aconteceu na semana passada e o risco de isso se repetir no próximo fim de semana, prefiro ser sensato e me proteger”, disse ele, acrescentando que há muito tempo tem uma sensação de insegurança.
“Venho pensando nisso há muito tempo e acho que vou tomar algumas medidas”, disse ele.
Em outra parte de Paris, Yvan Weiss, dono de uma empresa de consultoria financeira, disse à Reuters que estava tomando medidas para evitar que as vitrines de sua empresa fossem quebradas.
Questionado se considerava adquirir spray de pimenta ou outro equipamento de defesa, ele disse que havia pensado nisso, mas que, no fim, decidiu instalar persianas metálicas automáticas na fachada de sua loja.

items.title: Allegiant exercises options for six Boeing 737 MAX jets worth over $720 million
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Allegiant Air said on Friday it had exercised options to buy six Boeing 737-8 aircraft under a 2021 purchase agreement with the planemaker.
items.body:
Allegiant Air (ALGT.O) said on Friday it had exercised options to buy six Boeing (BA.N) 737-8 aircraft under a 2021 purchase agreement with the planemaker.
The jets, scheduled for delivery in 2028, have a combined list price of more than $720 million, the company said.
Allegiant has 56 firm aircraft under the agreement, including 22 already delivered, while purchase options remain for another 74 jets.
Based on delivery year, the estimated market value of the planes is about $351 million, according to aviation analytics consultancy firm IBA.

items.title: North Korea's Kim calls for 'military revolution' as he urges stronger army units
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for the country's army companies to be turned into elite, self-sufficient combat units during a two-day meeting of company commanders in Pyongyang, state media KCNA said on Saturday.
items.body:
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for the country's army companies to be turned into elite, self-sufficient combat units during a two-day meeting of company commanders in Pyongyang, state media KCNA said on Saturday.
The event underscored Kim's consistent policy priority of strengthening the military.
In a speech at a conference of company commanders for North Korea's Army on October 22-23, which KCNA said was the first military-wide gathering since the Ninth Congress of North Korea's ruling party in February, Kim called for every company to fully prepare so that "the goal of the new-era military build-up" can be achieved.
"Let us build the strongest army and speed up a military revolution in our style", Kim said.
During the [USN:L1N3ZL1I9 TEXT:"Ninth Congress"] of North Korea's ruling party in February, which sets the country's direction for the next five years, Kim called for stronger conventional armed forces as well as reaffirming efforts to develop nuclear weapons and missiles.

items.title: Pentagon designates Confucius Institutes in US a national security threat
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Defense Department has designated Chinese-funded cultural centers on university campuses known as Confucius Institutes as a threat to US national security, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Friday.
items.body:
The US Defense Department has designated Chinese-funded cultural centers on university campuses known as Confucius Institutes as a threat to US national security, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Friday.
Washington has long accused Confucius Institutes of being Chinese propaganda tools and has taken steps to crack down on them.
Hegseth, in a video posted on social media, alleged that Confucius Institutes were operating under disguise at US universities and that the Pentagon had added them to its list of institutions that threaten US national security.
"It turns out that 80 new propaganda cells across 30 universities had popped up using different names and different charters, but with the same mission: to steal intellectual property and to infiltrate the minds of American students," Hegseth said.
The Defense Department over the past two months has "systematically dismantled every single one of these organizations," he said.
The Chinese embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

items.title: Nigeria Ebola case linked to virus found in Kenya index case, health minister says
items.author: Camillus Eboh, George Obulutsa
items.creator: Camillus Eboh, George Obulutsa
items.summary: Genomic analysis of Nigeria's only confirmed Ebola case shows the virus is closely related to the strain detected in Kenya's index case, Nigeria's health minister Muhammad Ali Pate said on Friday, offering the first genetic link between the outbreaks.
items.body:
Genomic analysis of Nigeria's only confirmed Ebola case shows the virus is closely related to the strain detected in Kenya's index case, Nigeria's health minister Muhammad Ali Pate said on Friday, offering the first genetic link between the outbreaks.
Nigerian authorities said there is no evidence that the Kenya index case traveled to Nigeria or had a direct connection to the Nigerian case.
Pate said contacts linked to the case are being traced, quarantined and tested, with some results negative and others still pending
Nigeria has recorded only one confirmed Ebola case from a traveller who had visited Uganda
Uganda, which borders the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and has previously battled Ebola outbreaks, said on Friday it remained Ebola-free but was tightening precautions
Uganda's health ministry said traveller locator forms had been reinstated for all arrivals, regardless of country of origin
Uganda said travellers with a history of travel to the DRC, where the outbreak began, will not be permitted to transit the country

items.title: Colombia canjea deuda interna por 3.234 millones de dólares
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que realizó un canje de títulos de deuda pública interna por 10,3 billones de pesos (3.234 millones de dólares), para extender los vencimientos y reducir la presión de pagos a corto plazo ante las dificultades fiscales del país.
items.body:
El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que realizó un canje de títulos de deuda pública interna por 10,3 billones de pesos (3.234 millones de dólares), para extender los vencimientos y reducir la presión de pagos a corto plazo ante las dificultades fiscales del país.
En la operación, el Gobierno recogió títulos de deuda pública interna TES con vencimiento entre noviembre de 2026 y noviembre de 2027, y a cambio entregó papeles con plazos entre 2029 y 2062, precisó el Ministerio en un comunicado.
Se trata del segundo de tres canjes de deuda pública local que el Gobierno planea realizar antes de finalizar el año.
En el anterior canje, realizado a inicios de octubre, el Gobierno intercambió títulos por 19,8 billones de pesos (6.217 millones de dólares).
Los TES son la segunda fuente de financiación interna del gasto público, después del recaudo de impuestos.
Según el Ministerio de Hacienda, el tercer canje se realizará el 19 de noviembre.
"Con esta operación el Gobierno Nacional alcanza un monto total canjeado de 30,1 billones de pesos, lo que representa una disminución del 50% en los vencimientos de 2026 y de 19% para los vencimientos en 2027, logrando una reducción de amortizaciones de 3,9 billones de pesos este año y de 26,2 billones el próximo", explicó el Ministerio de Hacienda.
El Gobierno del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella anunció en agosto cambios en el presupuesto de gastos de 2026, que establecen un endeudamiento adicional de 35 billones de pesos (10.989 millones de dólares) este año, para cubrir el pronóstico del déficit fiscal, que aumentó a un 7,2% del PIB desde una meta previa de 5,3%.
(1 dólar = 3.185,01 pesos)

items.title: In Florida, Trump vows to deal with Cuba after Iran gets settled
items.author: Bo Erickson, Maria Cardona, Steve Holland
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Maria Cardona, Steve Holland
items.summary: US President Donald Trump on Friday used a campaign rally in Florida, where Cuban Americans are a potent voting bloc, to vow to address his concerns about Cuba once the Iran war is settled.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump on Friday used a campaign rally in Florida, where Cuban Americans are a potent voting bloc, to vow to address his concerns about Cuba once the Iran war is settled.
In a 90-minute speech in Fort Myers, Trump repeated more military action against Iran may lie ahead as he tries to address the causes of a spike in oil prices that has put Republicans on the defensive ahead of the November 3 midterm elections .
With an eye toward the senior Americans who live in Florida, Trump said he planned to spend $250 million to hire at least 5,000 new nurses in elder care facilities all across America.
While the Iran war has no end in sight, Trump talked tough about Cuba, part of a pattern of putting pressure on the communist government there after ousting the leader of Venezuela early this year.
Trump, who won 68% of the Cuban American vote in Florida in the 2024 election, said American naval forces from Iran will stop at Cuba on the way home.
"We'll have one of them stop about 50 yards off the coast. They'll raise up their hands, and then we're going to send Marco Rubio in to finish up the deal," he said.
Secretary of State Rubio, a former US senator from Florida, has been handling much of the Cuba-related policy for Trump.
"To those who seek to create positive change in Cuba - now is the time," Rubio said on X on Friday, urging those disappointed by Cuba's government "to create the change you desire through a discrete partnership with the CIA." His post did not elaborate.
Trump's rally was intended to boost the electoral prospects of Florida Republican Representative Byron Donalds, who is running for governor against Democrat David Jolly.
His speech, the latest in a near-daily blitz of campaign rallies in largely friendly areas, rambled from topic to topic such as the size of his crowds and his White House renovations.
Trump has increased pressure on Cuba in his second term. In September, he labeled Cuba a "failed state" at the UN General Assembly and said, "Freedom will be coming to Cuba," prompting a walkout by the Cuban delegation.
Trump has openly stated that his goal is to fundamentally change Cuba's government. A US-imposed oil blockade has put the country under severe strain as it contends with fuel shortages and blackouts exacerbated by failing infrastructure.
UN human rights experts have condemned the oil blockade as a violation of international law while rights advocates say the Trump administration's threats have echoed an [USN:L4N3YE036 TEXT:"imperialist approach"].

items.title: トルコ、フーシ派との戦闘「想定せず」　サウジとの防衛協定下でも＝国防相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [アンカラ　２３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[アンカラ　２３日　ロイター] - トルコのギュレル国防相は２３日、サウジアラビアおよびパキスタンとの防衛協定に基づいて自国軍がイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派との戦闘に加わることは想定していないとの考えを示した。 

ギュレル氏はスターテレビに対し「われわれはフーシ派とのいかなる衝突も想定していない」と述べ、サウジへのトルコの軍事支援は、カタールの場合と同様、主に抑止力の強化を目的とするものになると語った。

ギュレル氏は、トルコは議会が協定を批准した後、必要な法的手続きと議会の承認に従って、サウジからの軍事支援要請を評価し、支援の範囲を決定すると説明した。

８月に署名され、今週、批准に向けてトルコ議会に提出された「メッカ共同防衛協定」は、トルコ、サウジ、パキスタンの３カ国のいずれか１カ国への武力攻撃を全３カ国への攻撃と見なすことを定めている。

items.title: Russia, Ukraine agree on ceasefire in embattled town, to hold peace talks next month
items.author: Steve Holland, Yuliia Dysa
items.creator: Steve Holland, Yuliia Dysa
items.summary: Ukraine and Russia said on Friday they had agreed on a ceasefire in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, brokered through US first lady Melania Trump, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said peace negotiators would meet next month for new talks.
items.body:
Ukraine and Russia said on Friday they had agreed on a [USN:L1N4690MZ TEXT:"ceasefire"] in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, brokered through US first lady Melania Trump, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said [USN:L1N4690TJ TEXT:"peace negotiators"] would meet next month for new talks.
The two sides said the ceasefire would go into effect on October 27, allowing the delivery of aid and the evacuation of residents through humanitarian corridors.
Amid a US push to organise new talks aimed at ending the 4-1/2-year-old war, Zelenskiy said negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States had agreed to technical-level meetings in the first half of November in Abu Dhabi. A US official later said the three countries may hold their next talks in a couple weeks in Abu Dhabi or Switzerland.
Zelenskiy said he hoped a meeting of the countries' leaders would follow.
The peace efforts follow a rift between Washington and Kyiv in recent weeks and a series of moves by US President Donald Trump seen as favouring Russia.
A major source of friction was limitations placed on the Starlink communication system that Ukraine uses to protect against incoming attacks. Trump [USN:L6N4690ZQ TEXT:"said on Friday"] that if Ukraine still faced a problem accessing the system, he would straighten it out and, if necessary, speak about the matter to SpaceX (SPCX.O) CEO Elon Musk.
In the town of Oleshky, occupied by Russian forces since February 2022, residents have reported that they faced a deepening food crisis.
"Both nations agreed to temporarily stop all military action in Oleshky to allow for humanitarian aid to enter and to prepare a civilian evacuation through a designated safe passageway," the White House said in a statement.
The chief of staff of Russian forces, Valery Gerasimov, said on the Defence Ministry's Telegram channel that Russian troops would halt fire from 4 a.m. local time (0100 GMT) on October 27 to allow for the humanitarian operation to start.
Ukraine's human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets also [USN:S8N4390AW TEXT:"said"] the ceasefire would go into effect on October 27 and told Reuters the operation would involve demining roads to the town, deliveries of food and evacuations of civilians.
MELANIA TRUMP'S DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS Both sides said Melania Trump played an important role in coordinating the agreement. The first lady has been active in trying to get Ukrainian children seized by Russia during the war returned to their families.
"Oleshky is a front-line war city on the brink of disaster," she said in a statement.
"Oleshky's remaining population is comprised primarily of elderly residents who urgently need medical attention, medicine, food and clean water."
Pope Leo had spoken in the past week both to Zelenskiy and to Russian President Vladimir Putin about the situation in the town.
The White House said Oleshky, located across the Dnipro River from the Ukrainian-held city of Kherson, had 1,700 to 2,000 residents remaining, down from 24,000 before the war.
US ENVOYS Zelenskiy's comments on resuming peace talks followed a meeting with US presidential envoy Steve Witkoff in Norway early this week and a subsequent meeting between Witkoff and Putin in St Petersburg.
Zelenskiy said he spoke on Friday with Witkoff and US envoy Jared Kushner. He said any peace agreement would need strong security guarantees for Ukraine and funding for 10 years to maintain the Ukrainian army.
"The plan is to meet in the first half of November, and as early as possible, of course," Zelenskiy told the Hudson Institute think tank via a video link. He said much would depend on Russia, noting that a similar meeting expected this month had not materialised.
Zelenskiy stressed the importance of continued diplomatic efforts to reach a ceasefire and end the war, now in its fifth year, adding that Europe should also be involved in the talks.
Ukrainian officials said on Friday that speed restrictions on Starlink systems in Ukraine remained in place, despite Trump's previous statement that the services had been fully restored.
Trump told reporters at the White House on Friday that he had not spoken to Musk about the restrictions but would do so if required.
"If there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out," he said. The caps have been in place since October 13.
Ukraine and Russia on Friday also swapped 270 servicemen each in a prisoner exchange, the Russian Defence Ministry said. Zelenskiy described the swap, the first since August, as a "very important result."
Ukraine's acting prosecutor Anton Kovalskyi, writing on Telegram, said more than 19,000 [USN:S8N44Z032 TEXT:"Ukrainian civilians"], including 762 children, had been killed since Russia launched its full-scale war more than four years ago.
In 2026 alone, Ukrainian prosecutors confirmed the deaths of 2,960 civilians, including 668 children, Kovalskyi said.

items.title: BOURSE Wall Street finit dans le rouge une semaine mouvementée autour de l'IA
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La Bourse de New York a fini en baisse vendredi, au terme d'une semaine mouvementée pour le secteur de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) alors que les investisseurs ont désormais les yeux rivés sur de nouveaux résultats d'entreprises et la décision prochaine de politique monétaire de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed).
items.body:
La Bourse de New York a fini en baisse vendredi, au terme d'une semaine mouvementée pour le secteur de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) alors que les investisseurs ont désormais les yeux rivés sur de nouveaux résultats d'entreprises et la décision prochaine de politique monétaire de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed).
L'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) a cédé 652,82 points, soit 1,23%, à 52.215,16.
Le S&P-500 (.SPX) , plus large, a perdu 39,75 points, soit 0,51%, à 7.623,68.
Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) , riche en valeurs technologiques, a reculé de 53,51 points, soit 0,20%, à 25.955,34, affichant ainsi une certaine stabilité au lendemain de sa plus forte baisse quotidienne enregistrée depuis juin.
Le Nasdaq a pâti cette semaine des inquiétudes concernant les coûts de financement nécessaires pour soutenir les dépenses d'investissement massives dans l'IA.
La plupart des secteurs du S&P 500 ont terminé la séance dans le rouge, les biens de consommation courante et les groupes financiers accusant les plus fortes baisses. A contrario, l'indice Philadelphia Semiconductor (.SOX) a rebondi de 0,44%, au lendemain d'un important repli. Le secteur technologique sur le S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) a, lui, progressé de 0,35%.
Sur l'ensemble de la semaine, le S&P 500 et le Nasdaq ont reflué respectivement de 0,47% et 0,71%, tandis que l'indice Dow Jones a grappillé 0,41%, soutenu notamment par les valeurs défensives.
La semaine prochaine, environ un tiers des entreprises du S&P 500 publieront leurs résultats trimestriels, notamment Alphabet (GOOGL.O) (-1,23%), Microsoft (MSFT.O) (+0,65%) et Amazon (AMZN.O) (-0,95%), trois géants de l'IA dont les prévisions de dépenses d'investissement seront suivies de près à Wall Street.
"Les remous liés aux interrogations sur le secteur de l'IA se font encore sentir", a souligné Kristina Hooper, cheffe stratège marchés chez Man Group.
"Il est tout à fait possible que les investissements dans la construction de centres de données dédiés à l'IA soient l'année prochaine inférieurs aux prévisions. Je pense donc que cela donne matière à réflexion", a-t-elle dit.
LE SECTEUR TÉLÉCOMS BOUSCULÉ PAR SPACEX Aux valeurs, les groupes télécoms ont reculé après une information selon laquelle SpaceX (SPCX.O) est à la recherche de milliers de sites de téléphonie mobile.
AT&T (T.N) , Verizon (VZ.N) et T-Mobile (TMUS.O) ont cédé respectivement 7,95%, 1,26% et 7,71%, tandis que SpaceX a progressé de 1,89%. Les opérateurs de gestion des infrastructures mobiles comme Crown Castle (CCI.N) et American Tower (AMT.N) ont bondi respectivement de 9,13% et 4,07%.
Le secteur de l'énergie (.SPNY) a pris 2,51%, touchant en séance un niveau record à 1.071,51 points alors que le baril de pétrole Brent a grimpé dans les échanges à un sommet depuis fin avril, à 117,45 dollars, à la suite des attaques des Houthis en Arabie saoudite. Cela a ravivé les craintes d'une nouvelle perturbation des approvisionnements énergétiques en provenance du Moyen-Orient.
Sur le marché obligataire, le rendement deq bons du Trésor à dix ans a pris 4,7 points de base, à 5,00%, au lendemain de sa plus forte baisse quotidienne depuis près de quatre ans, en lien avec les inquiétudes concernant le caractère durable du redressement des actions liées à l'IA.
Aux changes, le dollar (.DXY) affiche une hausse de 0,19% face à un panier de devises de référence alors que les investisseurs sont à l'affût d'indices quant à l'orientation future de la politique monétaire de la Fed.
Les contrats à terme sur les fonds fédéraux montrent que les opérateurs ont réduit leurs paris sur une hausse des taux directeurs en décembre après la chute jeudi des marchés boursiers, mais ils évaluent toujours à 81% la probabilité d'une telle mesure, selon les données de LSEG.

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（23日）ドル堅調、利回り上昇　主要3指数軒並み下落
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ＜為替＞　ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。来週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀が金融政策決定会合を開く。いずれも政策金利の据え置きが予想されているが、今後の金融政策の方向性の手がかりを示すか注目されている。    終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．１％安の１５６．９円。ただ、週間ベースでは円は対ドルで約０．７％上昇。９月中旬以来の大幅な上昇となる。ＭＵＦＧのシニア通貨アナリスト、リー・ハードマン氏は「リスク回避姿勢が強まる中、円買いが続いている」と述べた。    ユーロに対してはフランスの債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に拡大したことなどが重しになっており、ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１９１ドル。週初からは０．４３％下落した。
items.body:
＜為替＞　ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。来週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀が金融政策決定会合を開く。いずれも政策金利の据え置きが予想されているが、今後の金融政策の方向性の手がかりを示すか注目されている。    終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．１％安の１５６．９円。ただ、週間ベースでは円は対ドルで約０．７％上昇。９月中旬以来の大幅な上昇となる。ＭＵＦＧのシニア通貨アナリスト、リー・ハードマン氏は「リスク回避姿勢が強まる中、円買いが続いている」と述べた。    ユーロに対してはフランスの債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に拡大したことなどが重しになっており、ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１９１ドル。週初からは０．４３％下落した。    ユーロは対円でより大きく下落し、一時１７５．０８円と、２０２５年１０月以来の安値を更新。週初からは約１．１％下落した。    フランスでは１７日の抗議デモが過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展してから１週間が経過し、ヌニェス内相は暴力行為や略奪の再発防止に向け、２４日に全国で予定される抗議活動に７万人の警察官を動員すると発表。パリのルーブル美術館、オルセー美術館、オペラ座などの主要文化施設の一部が臨時休館となるほか、治安上の懸念からパリで予定されているサッカーフランス１部リーグの試合が２５日から２６日に延期されるなどの影響が出ている。    終盤の取引で、主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％高の１０１．８２。    ＦＲＢの金融政策を巡っては、前日の株式相場急落を受け、１２月の会合での利上げ観測がやや後退したことがＬＳＥＧのデータで示された。ただ、ＦＦ金利先物市場では１２月利上げの確率はなお８１％と見込まれている。    ＥＣＢについては、１２月の理事会で利上げが決定される確率は６６％と織り込まれている。ラガルドＥＣＢ総裁が９月下旬にインフレに対し穏健な政策対応が適切との認識を示していることから、今後の金利見通しについて新たな示唆があるか注目されている。    日銀については、１２月の利上げの確率が６１％と織り込まれている。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　国債利回りが上昇した。ただそれでも、指標１０年債利回りは５％を下回る水準にとどまっている。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の上昇が持続するかどうかへの懸念がくすぶっていることが背景にある。    １０年債利回りは３．７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．９９％。週間では約１１ｂｐ低下しており、６月以来の長さとなる３週連続の低下に向かっている。    株式相場の強気局面を支えるＡＩ関連銘柄への投資の持続性を巡り、足元で懸念が浮上し、投資家は国債などの安全資産に資金を移している。    ３０年債利回りは２．９ｂｐ上昇の５．３１６％。ただ、週間では１３ｂｐ近く低下しており、こちらも３週連続の低下に向かっている。    経済指標が物価上昇圧力の強まりを示す一方、市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が来週の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げするとの見方が後退している。ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、少なくとも２５ｂｐの利上げが行われる確率は９．４％と、１週間前の１５．５％、１カ月前の７０．９％から低下した。    経済見通しを示す指標として注目される２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２９．６ｂｐだった。    ＦＲＢの金利見通しを反映しやすい２年債利回りは５．５ｂｐ上昇の４．６９％。週間では約５ｂｐ低下しており、２０２６年で最長となる４週連続の低下に向かっている。    物価連動国債（ＴＩＰＳ）と通常の国債の利回り差で、期待インフレを示すブレーク・イーブン・インフレ率（ＢＥＩ）は、５年物が２．４５６％、１０年物ＢＥＩは２．３４６％だった。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　主要株価３指数が軒並み下落して取引を終えた。一方、ハイテク株は持ち直し、市場をけん引してきた人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄にとって波乱の１週間を締めくくった。市場の関心は、来週予定される企業決算や連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）に移っている。

ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総合は小幅な下げにとどまった。前日は、巨額のＡＩ投資を支える資金調達コストへの懸念が強まり、１日として６月以来の大幅下落となっていた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の大半のセクターが軟調で、一般消費財や金融はいずれも１％を大きく超える下げとなった。一方、エネルギーセクターは２．５％上昇し、過去最高値を付けた。サウジアラビアでのイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃を受け、中東からのエネルギー供給が一段と混乱するとの懸念が高まり、北海ブレント原油はこの日、４月下旬以来の高値を付けた。

この日は通信関連銘柄が下落し、通信サービスセクターの重しとなった。宇宙開発企業スペースＸが全米で少なくとも８万カ所の携帯電話基地局の利用を確保するため、通信インフラ企業と協議していると報じられたことが材料となった。

ＡＴ＆ＴとＴモバイルはともに約８％下落し、ベライゾンは１．２％安。一方、スペースＸは１．９％上昇した。

items.body:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（23日）ドル堅調、利回り上昇　主要3指数軒並み下落
6:13 配信

＜為替＞　ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。来週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀が金融政策決定会合を開く。いずれも政策金利の据え置きが予想されているが、今後の金融政策の方向性の手がかりを示すか注目されている。    終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．１％安の１５６．９円。ただ、週間ベースでは円は対ドルで約０．７％上昇。９月中旬以来の大幅な上昇となる。ＭＵＦＧのシニア通貨アナリスト、リー・ハードマン氏は「リスク回避姿勢が強まる中、円買いが続いている」と述べた。    ユーロに対してはフランスの債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に拡大したことなどが重しになっており、ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１９１ドル。週初からは０．４３％下落した。    ユーロは対円でより大きく下落し、一時１７５．０８円と、２０２５年１０月以来の安値を更新。週初からは約１．１％下落した。    フランスでは１７日の抗議デモが過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展してから１週間が経過し、ヌニェス内相は暴力行為や略奪の再発防止に向け、２４日に全国で予定される抗議活動に７万人の警察官を動員すると発表。パリのルーブル美術館、オルセー美術館、オペラ座などの主要文化施設の一部が臨時休館となるほか、治安上の懸念からパリで予定されているサッカーフランス１部リーグの試合が２５日から２６日に延期されるなどの影響が出ている。    終盤の取引で、主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％高の１０１．８２。    ＦＲＢの金融政策を巡っては、前日の株式相場急落を受け、１２月の会合での利上げ観測がやや後退したことがＬＳＥＧのデータで示された。ただ、ＦＦ金利先物市場では１２月利上げの確率はなお８１％と見込まれている。    ＥＣＢについては、１２月の理事会で利上げが決定される確率は６６％と織り込まれている。ラガルドＥＣＢ総裁が９月下旬にインフレに対し穏健な政策対応が適切との認識を示していることから、今後の金利見通しについて新たな示唆があるか注目されている。    日銀については、１２月の利上げの確率が６１％と織り込まれている。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　国債利回りが上昇した。ただそれでも、指標１０年債利回りは５％を下回る水準にとどまっている。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の上昇が持続するかどうかへの懸念がくすぶっていることが背景にある。    １０年債利回りは３．７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．９９％。週間では約１１ｂｐ低下しており、６月以来の長さとなる３週連続の低下に向かっている。    株式相場の強気局面を支えるＡＩ関連銘柄への投資の持続性を巡り、足元で懸念が浮上し、投資家は国債などの安全資産に資金を移している。    ３０年債利回りは２．９ｂｐ上昇の５．３１６％。ただ、週間では１３ｂｐ近く低下しており、こちらも３週連続の低下に向かっている。    経済指標が物価上昇圧力の強まりを示す一方、市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が来週の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げするとの見方が後退している。ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、少なくとも２５ｂｐの利上げが行われる確率は９．４％と、１週間前の１５．５％、１カ月前の７０．９％から低下した。    経済見通しを示す指標として注目される２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２９．６ｂｐだった。    ＦＲＢの金利見通しを反映しやすい２年債利回りは５．５ｂｐ上昇の４．６９％。週間では約５ｂｐ低下しており、２０２６年で最長となる４週連続の低下に向かっている。    物価連動国債（ＴＩＰＳ）と通常の国債の利回り差で、期待インフレを示すブレーク・イーブン・インフレ率（ＢＥＩ）は、５年物が２．４５６％、１０年物ＢＥＩは２．３４６％だった。

items.title: Lula o Bolsonaro: ¿para quién va el voto en blanco en la segunda vuelta presidencial?
items.author: Fátima Romero
items.summary: Los brasileños elegirán entre Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro el domingo. ¿Qué diferencia hay entre votar en blanco y anular el sufragio?
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Los electores brasileños vuelven a las urnas este domingo 25 de octubre para la segunda vuelta, en la que se definirá la Presidencia de la República. Ver más: Dólar hoy: ¿cuánto puede subir o bajar el real brasileño si gana Lula o Bolsonaro? En Brasil, el voto es obligatorio para los mayores de 18 años y facultativo para los analfabetos, los mayores de 70 años y los jóvenes de 16 y 17 años, pero los electores no están obligados a elegir y pueden votar en blanco o anular el sufragio. Según el Tribunal Superior Electoral (TSE), los votos en blanco y nulos no se contabilizan como votos válidos, por lo que no se asignan a ninguna candidatura ni influyen directamente en el cómputo de los votos que define al ganador. La diferencia entre ambas está en la forma de registro. Para votar en blanco, el elector debe presionar la tecla ‘Branco’ y confirmar su elección. El voto nulo se registra cuando se introduce un número que no corresponde a ninguna candidatura válida y se confirma la operación. En el escrutinio, ambas opciones tienen el mismo efecto: quedan fuera del total de votos válidos. Los votos válidos son los emitidos a favor de un candidato o, en determinadas elecciones, a favor de un partido político mediante el llamado voto de lista. Ver más: Lula y Bolsonaro empatan con el 50% de los votos en encuesta a días de la segunda vuelta en Brasil En las elecciones mayoritarias, como las de presidente y gobernador, el resultado se calcula a partir de los votos válidos, de acuerdo con la Constitución brasileña. Al quedar excluidos del cómputo, los votos en blanco y nulos reducen el total que sirve de base para calcular los porcentajes, pero no representan votos adicionales para ninguna candidatura. Tampoco se transfieren al candidato más votado. El TSE aclara que estos sufragios no se registran a ningún candidato ni partido político, pero sí cuentan con fines estadísticos. La misma regla se aplica en la segunda vuelta, que constituye una nueva votación. Los votos emitidos en la primera no se trasladan al segundo turno y resultará electa la candidatura que obtenga la mayoría de los votos válidos en cada disputa. Tampoco es cierto que una mayoría de votos en blanco y nulos anule automáticamente una elección. Aunque estas opciones superen el 50% de los sufragios registrados, no se convoca una nueva votación por ese motivo. De cara al proceso del domingo, una encuesta del instituto de investigación Datafolha divulgada el jueves 22 de octubre reveló que el 5% de los electores pretende votar en blanco o nulo, mientras que el 2% aún no ha definido su voto. La contienda enfrenta al actual mandatario, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, del Partido de los Trabajadores, y al senador Flávio Bolsonaro, del Partido Liberal. En cinco estados y en el Distrito Federal, también habrá votación para gobernador. La investidura del presidente y el vicepresidente será el 5 de enero, mientras que los gobernadores y vicegobernadores tomarán posesión el día 6.

items.title: Dale Brown dies at 90; coach turned LSU into national power
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Dale Brown, who guided LSU men's basketball to two Final Fours in the 1980s and transformed the program into a national power during his 25-year coaching tenure in Baton Rouge, died Friday, the university announced. He was 90.
items.body:
Dale Brown, who guided LSU men's basketball to two Final Fours in the 1980s and transformed the program into a national power during his 25-year coaching tenure in Baton Rouge, died Friday, the university announced. He was 90.
Brown guided the Tigers to the national semifinals in 1981 and 1986. They lost to the eventual national champion both times: to Indiana in ‘81 and Louisville in ‘86. The Tigers made 13 NCAA Tournaments in all during Brown's time in charge.
LSU's most famous alums under Brown are Shaquille O'Neal and Mahmoud Abdul-Rauf (formerly Chris Jackson), who added their names to program lore alongside Pete Maravich. But the program's greatest team successes, the Final Fours, came with future NBA players such as Rudy Macklin, Howard Carter, John "Hot Plate" Williams and Nikita Wilson leading the way.
Brown came to Baton Rouge from Washington State in 1972. It was his first and, as it turned out, only head coaching job in the North Dakota native's career. He compiled a 448-301 record (.598 winning percentage) overall, and his teams went 238-200 in Southeastern Conference play. The Tigers won four SEC regular-season championships (1979, 1981, 1985, 1991) and one SEC Tournament title (1980) under Brown.
Brown's coaching ability, gift of gab and charisma made him a national figure, but the latter two also made him an enemy of the NCAA in the 1980s and ‘90s. Brown spoke out strongly against the association, branding its officials as hypocrites and, famously, the Gestapo, for its heavy-handedness regarding benefits to players. The NCAA took away two scholarships from the program in 1986 after it found LSU guilty of 16 violations.
Brown met his coaching end a decade later after another run-in with the NCAA. At the time, the association was investigating the program over a $5,000 payment made by an LSU booster to former player Lester Earl. The NCAA found no evidence that Brown was directly involved in the payment, but the program was placed on probation in 1998 nonetheless. Brown retired in 1997.
Those incidents did not tarnish Brown's legacy entirely. He was inducted into the Louisiana Sports Hall of Fame in 1999, the LSU Athletics Hall of Fame in 2013 and the National Collegiate Basketball Hall of Fame in 2014. This week, he was announced as the 2027 recipient of the John R. Wooden Legends of Coach Award.
--Field Level Media

items.title: ヨルダン南部の教会で銃撃、7人死亡　当局「過激派テロ」との見方
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [アル・ムシャイルフェ（ヨルダン）　２３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[アル・ムシャイルフェ（ヨルダン）　２３日　ロイター] - ヨルダン南部のカラク県にある教会で２３日、葬儀中に武装集団が発砲し、少なくとも７人が死亡、４０人が負傷した。ヨルダンの公安総局は、キリスト教徒少数派を狙った極めて異例の襲撃で、「過激派によるテロ行為」との見方を示している。武装グループは逃走中で、治安当局が行方を追っている。今のところ犯行声明を出した団体はない。

公安総局のアブドラ・マアイタ少将によると、銃撃事件が起きたのはカラク県のハムード教会。ファラヤ内相は、襲撃は「過激派」によるものとの見方を示した。ただ、ヨルダン国内外の組織との関係があるかについては、現段階で判断するのは尚早としている。

ヨルダンのアブドラ国王は事件発生から数時間後にカラク県を訪問。声明で「カラクでのテロ攻撃に最も厳しい報復で応じる。銃弾でヨルダン国民を分断できると思い込んでいる者に勝ち目はない。われわれは結束している」とし、犯行に及んだ者は「鉄拳で」処罰されるとした。

ハッサン首相は「テロリズムの思想と盲目的な過激主義の産物だ。われわれは社会がそのような道に進むことを許さない」とＸに投稿した。

国連のグテレス事務総長も今回の襲撃を非難。「民間人や礼拝施設を標的とした攻撃は容認できない」とＸに投稿した。

国営テレビ局アルマムラカが放映した映像で、３人の人物が歩道から教会に向けて発砲した後、樹木や低い塀の陰に身を隠し、その後、教会の入り口に向かって走る様子が確認できる。映像は教会の監視カメラで撮影されたものと見られ、ロイターは教会へ続く通路や周囲の塀などの特徴からこの映像の撮影場所を特定した。襲撃後に教会で撮影されたロイターの映像では、教会の入口付近の床に血痕が残されている様子が確認できる。

キリスト教徒はヨルダンで少数派。ただ、ヨルダンには聖書ゆかりの地が複数あり、世界各地からキリスト教の巡礼者が訪れている。米国のウォルツ国連大使はＸへの投稿で、今回の事件について「礼拝施設に対する卑劣で残忍な攻撃だ」と非難した。

items.title: Soja sobe em Chicago com vendas para exportação dos EUA e alta do petróleo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago subiram nesta sexta-feira, à medida que as vendas para exportação dos EUA compensaram o impacto da pressão da colheita, e o setor de energia também contribuiu para a alta.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago subiram nesta sexta-feira, à medida que as vendas para exportação dos EUA compensaram o impacto da pressão da colheita, e o setor de energia também contribuiu para a alta.
O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) informou que as vendas líquidas de soja dos EUA na semana encerrada em 15 de outubro totalizaram 2.841.200 toneladas métricas, um aumento significativo em relação à média das quatro semanas anteriores, mas em linha com as expectativas do mercado, que variavam entre 1,8 milhão e 3 milhões de toneladas.
O USDA informou na quinta-feira que os exportadores venderam 202.000 toneladas métricas de soja para a China com entrega prevista para a safra 2026/2027.
Os preços do petróleo subiram nesta sexta-feira, com o petróleo Brent atingindo seu maior nível desde o início de maio, depois que ataques dos houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram preocupações com novas interrupções no abastecimento do Oriente Médio, onde as autoridades dos Emirados Árabes Unidos também relataram um vazamento de petróleo.
Alguns agricultores dos EUA estavam concluindo a colheita de soja após um período de clima favorável no Meio-Oeste e passavam a colher milho, segundo analistas.
O contrato de soja novembro fechou com alta de 3,50 centavos, a US$12,565 por bushel.
Já o milho fechou em baixa com o avanço da colheita. O contrato dezembro encerrou em queda de 4,50 centavos, a US$4,56 o bushel.
O trigo terminou praticamente estável, a US$6,25 o bushel.
(Por Renee Hickman)

items.title: La IndyCar vuelve a Europa tras 20 años de ausencia con una carrera en casa para Palou
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La IndyCar volverá a competir en Europa por primera vez en 20 años con una prueba que se celebrará en julio de 2027 en el Circuito de Cataluña, en Barcelona, en el marco de un acuerdo plurianual anunciado el viernes.
items.body:
La IndyCar volverá a competir en Europa por primera vez en 20 años con una prueba que se celebrará en julio de 2027 en el Circuito de Cataluña, en Barcelona, en el marco de un acuerdo plurianual anunciado el viernes.
La carrera supondrá el regreso a casa del español Alex Palou, cinco veces campeón de la IndyCar, que nació cerca de Barcelona.
La última vez que la IndyCar compitió en Europa fue en el circuito de Assen, en Países Bajos, en 2007. El campeonato no ha disputado ninguna carrera fuera de Norteamérica desde 2013, cuando se celebró una prueba en Brasil.
Palou, de 29 años, ha ganado los últimos cuatro títulos de IndyCar y también se alzó con la victoria en las 500 Millas de Indianápolis en 2025.
El Circuito de Cataluña acogió este año una prueba de Fórmula 1, pero desaparece del calendario en 2027 y se alternará con Bélgica hasta 2032.
"Llevamos años siendo testigos de su extraordinario talento (el de Palou) y sabemos que sus seguidores en España están deseando verle competir en directo", dijo Mark Miles, director general de Penske Entertainment Corp., propietaria de IndyCar.
"Es una oportunidad increíble, y para mí significa mucho poder correr en casa, en Barcelona; es difícil expresarlo con palabras. Sé que a los aficionados les va a encantar, y creo que vamos a ofrecer un gran espectáculo", dijo Palou.
La carrera de 2027 se celebrará del 16 al 18 de julio.

items.title: Colombiano Ecopetrol estima utilidad neta de 4 a 5 billones de pesos en el tercer trimestre
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La utilidad neta del grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol se habría situado en un rango de 4 a 5 billones de pesos (1.255 a 1.569 millones de dólares) en el tercer trimestre, según estimaciones del conglomerado divulgadas el viernes.
items.body:
La utilidad neta del grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol se habría situado en un rango de 4 a 5 billones de pesos (1.255 a 1.569 millones de dólares) en el tercer trimestre, según estimaciones del conglomerado divulgadas el viernes.
En el segundo trimestre, Ecopetrol registró una ganancia neta de 6,06 billones de pesos (1.902 millones de dólares).
De acuerdo con la actualización operativa de la compañía publicada en su página de internet, los ingresos totales se habrían situado en un rango de 33 a 36 billones de pesos (10.361 a 11.302 millones de dólares) en el periodo de julio a septiembre.
Ecopetrol no suministró ninguna variación porcentual de las proyecciones.
Por su parte, la producción en el tercer trimestre habría alcanzado un rango de entre 740.000 y 750.000 barriles equivalentes de petróleo promedio día (bpd).
Las proyecciones de Ecopetrol supondrían un incremento en la producción frente a los 705.800 bpd del segundo trimestre de 2026.
Ecopetrol, controlada mayoritariamente por el Estado, es la empresa más grande de Colombia, produce la mayor parte del petróleo del país y posee las dos principales refinerías y gran parte de la red de oleoductos y poliductos.
(1 dólar = 3.185,01 pesos colombianos).

Co-Host of Odd Lots, Joe Weisenthal says it's important to the US Economy that tech companies fire on all cylinders. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Rusia dice que tres petroleros cargados con diésel se dirigen a Norteamérica
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Tres petroleros que transportan diésel ruso se dirigen a Norteamérica, dijo el viernes el vice primer ministro ruso, Alexander Novak.
items.body:
Tres petroleros que transportan diésel ruso se dirigen a Norteamérica, dijo el viernes el vice primer ministro ruso, Alexander Novak.
Novak, en unas declaraciones recogidas por las agencias de noticias rusas, señaló que los cargamentos formaban parte de un acuerdo para abastecer a los mercados estadounidense y mundial.
"Los tres primeros buques cisterna ya se dirigen hacia la costa oriental del océano Atlántico, con un importante apoyo del RDIF (Fondo Ruso de Inversión Directa)", dijo Novak.
Novak señaló que las empresas rusas podrían suministrar 500.000 toneladas métricas en octubre.
En virtud de un acuerdo anunciado este mes por el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, Rusia accedió a suministrar diésel a los mercados globales, en un esfuerzo por reducir los precios del combustible. El Gobierno de Trump suspendió temporalmente las sanciones estadounidenses sobre el combustible ruso, que tenían por objeto privar a Moscú de ingresos para su guerra contra Ucrania.
El acuerdo anunciado por Trump contemplaba 300.000 toneladas métricas en octubre y más posteriormente.
Una noticia exclusiva de Reuters publicada el viernes, que citaba datos de seguimiento de buques, indicaba que el primer cargamento de diésel ruso se encontraba a bordo de un petrolero con destino a Nueva York.

[フロリダ州フォートマイヤーズ ２３日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２３日、フロリダ州の集会で、イランへの対応を終えた後にキューバ問題に対処し、合意をまとめるためルビオ国務長官を派遣すると述べた。

トランプ氏は９月、米国とキューバは合意に達するとの見通しを示し、軍事行動は必要ないと考えていると述べていた。

米国が実施した石油封鎖は、キューバに深刻な打撃を与えている。同国は燃料不足や停電に直面しており、インフラの機能不全が状況を悪化させている。

米国は６０年以上にわたってキューバへの禁輸措置を維持している。

items.title: Swiss drug developer Windward Bio files for US IPO
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Windward Bio filed for a US initial public offering on Friday, becoming the latest drug developer seeking to capitalize on renewed investor interest in biotech listings.
items.body:
Windward Bio filed for a US initial public offering on Friday, becoming the latest drug developer seeking to capitalize on renewed investor interest in biotech listings.
Biotech has been one of the more active sectors in this year's fall IPO market, even as rising bond yields and concerns around the AI trade weigh on broader risk appetite.
Here are more details:
Basel, Switzerland-based Windward Bio is developing long-lasting antibody treatments for asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and inflammatory skin conditions, with the aim of reducing how frequently patients need injections
WIN378, the company's lead drug candidate, is an antibody designed to block thymic stromal lymphopoietin, or TSLP, which is a protein that triggers several inflammatory pathways involved in asthma and other respiratory diseases
Novo Holdings and funds managed by Blue Owl Capital have pre-IPO stakes of 14.5% and 5.9%, respectively, in the company
Windward has secured up to $365 million from investors including OrbiMed, Novo Holdings, Omega Funds and Blue Owl Healthcare Opportunities
The company plans to list its shares on Nasdaq under the symbol "WWB". Jefferies, TD Cowen, Piper Sandler and UBS Investment Bank are the underwriters for the offering

items.body:
Colombian state-run energy company Ecopetrol (ECOPETROL.CN) estimated its third-quarter net profit at 4 trillion to 5 trillion pesos ($1.26 billion to $1.57 billion), the company said on Friday, a decline from the 6.06 trillion pesos ($1.90 billion) it posted in the second quarter.
Total revenue for July-September quarter was estimated at 33 trillion to 36 trillion pesos ($10.36 billion to $11.30 billion), Ecopetrol said.
Third-quarter production is estimated to have reached between 740,000 to 750,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day (bpd), an increase from the 705,800 bpd the company reported in the second quarter.
In September Ecopetrol [USN:L1N45G0ZI TEXT:"appointed businessman Joaquin Gutierrez"] as its chief executive, giving one of the country's most important corporate jobs to a close presidential ally with no known background in the energy sector.
Colombia's right-wing President Abelardo De La Espriella, who took office in August, has promised to strengthen Ecopetrol, boost reserves and secure domestic oil and gas supply, including through fracking.
Ecopetrol is majority state-controlled and Colombia's largest company, generating most of the South American country's oil production.
The company owns the two main refineries and most of the country's oil and product pipeline network.
($1 = 3.185,01 pesos)

items.title: Wall Street mostly loses ground under pressure from rising oil prices
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: Futures are lower as oil prices reach levels not seen since May amid halting efforts to bring the U.S. and Iran back to the negotiation table.
items.body: NEW YORK — Stocks on Wall Street closed broadly lower Friday as oil prices climbed to their highest level in more than four years, ratcheting up pressure on the market. The S&P 500 fell 0.5 per cent, adding to its decline from a day before. The index posted its second-straight weekly loss. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 1.2 per cent, and the Nasdaq composite slipped 0.2 per cent after giving up a modest gain. Rising oil prices weighed heavily on the market, where nearly three out of every four stocks within the benchmark S&P 500 index fell. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil rose 3.1 per cent to settle at US$116.72. It has surged from less than US$97 at the start of October and is now at its highest level since June 2022. Several AI-related companies rallied, helping ease some of the impact from the broader market slide. Micron Technology rose 2.5 per cent, Intel gained 1.7 per cent, Microsoft added 0.7 per cent, and Advanced Micro Devices closed 1.7 per cent higher. The tech sector’s influence is also capable of quickly switching over to a heavy weight. Stocks that have benefited from the frenzy over AI have been swinging over rising worries about their path ahead. Investors are worried about whether their high prices are justified. Many of those companies have been borrowing to fund investments in AI technology and high interest rates are making those loans more expensive. “Investors appear increasingly focused on the economics of AI, particularly the substantial upfront costs required to build AI infrastructure and the uncertainty around the timing of returns on those investments,” said Angelo Kourkafas, senior global strategist at Edward Jones, in a research note. The latest round of corporate earnings are being closely watched to help get a better sense of whether those investments are paying off, or might pay off. Several influential AI-related companies report their latest financial results next week, including Google’s parent, Alphabet, along with Microsoft and Amazon. Industrial companies had some of the biggest losses. Caterpillar fell 2.4 per cent. American Express slumped 3.7 per cent, one of several financial stocks that lost ground, despite r eporting profits for its most recent quarter that beat analysts’ forecasts. The company did announce its first major job cuts in roughly a decade. JPMorgan Chase fell 1.5 per cent, Citigroup dropped 1.5 per cent and Capital One Financial slid 1 per cent. While higher oil prices weighed down much of the market, they helped boost energy companies. Chevron rose 2.9 per cent and ConocoPhillips gained 3.6 per cent. European markets closed mostly lower. France’s main index fell 0.4 per cent, though yields on French government bonds eased a bit. Treasury yields in the U.S. edged higher following sharp drops on Thursday. The yield on the 10-year Treasury edged up to 4.99 per cent from 4.96 per cent late Thursday. Yields have been rising globally, partly over worries about governments taking on too much debt. Inflation also remains a concern and is stubbornly well above 3 per cent in the U.S. That prompted the Federal Reserve to raise its benchmark interest rate at its last meeting in an effort to cool inflation. Wall Street expects the central bank to hold rates steady at its meeting next week, but is leaning heavily toward another rate hike in December. Wall Street will also get several big economic updates next week, including the Fed’s preferred measure of inflation. The personal consumption expenditures index, or PCE, is expected to show that inflation rose at a 3.7 per cent rate in September, sharply above the Fed’s 2 per cent target. The U.S. war with Iran has severely cut the world’s oil supply, driving energy prices higher and fueling a sharp jump in the cost of everything from gasoline to food and clothes. All told, the S&P 500 fell 39.75 points to 7,623.68. The Dow dropped 652.82 points to 52,215.16, and the Nasdaq gave up 53.52 points to close at 25,955.34. --- Damian J. Troise and Alex Veiga, The Associated Press

items.title: Costa Rica AG says new joint DEA ops will target politicians, businessmen
items.author: Alvaro Murillo
items.creator: Alvaro Murillo
items.summary: Costa Rica will deepen cooperation with the US Drug Enforcement Administration to target what the nation's newly re-elected attorney general calls "invisible drug traffickers," including business executives and politicians hiding alleged links to the drug trade behind respectable public profiles.
items.body:
Costa Rica will deepen cooperation with the US Drug Enforcement Administration to target what the nation's newly re-elected attorney general calls "invisible drug traffickers," including business executives and politicians hiding alleged links to the drug trade behind respectable public profiles.
Attorney General Carlo Diaz, who has repeatedly clashed with the government of President Laura Fernandez, was re-elected by the judiciary on Monday to another four-year term. In an interview with Reuters on Thursday, he said investigators would show no leniency if those implicated held senior positions.
"This second phase (of DEA cooperation) focuses on people we have termed 'invisible drug traffickers,'" Diaz said, after an initial phase of joint missions targeted members of criminal organizations.
"These are business people, sometimes professionals or politicians, who are successful or highly visible. But behind that facade lies a direct link with these kinds of activities."
Diaz also hailed Costa Rica's ability to extradite its own nationals to the US as a watershed in the fight against transnational crime, saying 6 people had been sent and another 25 extradition proceedings were underway.
The DEA's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Costa Rica's government has previously collaborated with the DEA to arrest dozens of [USN:L6N44A17E TEXT:"drug traffickers"], who Costa Rican authorities deem responsible for a surge in homicide rates over recent years in the long-peaceful Central American nation.
Officials have said the region serves as a key corridor shifting narcotics from South America to the US.
Fernandez, a conservative ally of President Donald Trump, has aligned Costa Rica closely with Washington on security, joining the US president’s [USN:L6N45E0S9 TEXT:"Shield of the Americas"] initiative against drug trafficking and organized crime.
POLITICAL DIVISIONS Diaz said DEA officials had directly expressed concern to him about political and institutional divisions in Costa Rica, which he said were hampering the fight against organized crime. He has repeatedly clashed with Fernandez and her predecessor Rodrigo Chaves, accusing the government of seeking to weaken the judiciary.
Despite backing deeper cooperation with the DEA, Diaz rejected Fernandez's suggestion last month that Costa Rica could benefit from [USN:S0N3ST094 TEXT:"US forces operating on its territory"].
"If we focus on providing the resources the security forces need, they could take control of the territory without needing to bring in armed forces from other countries," he said.
Fernandez’s government has built a 5,100-capacity prison modeled on El Salvador’s security crackdown, an approach Diaz has questioned amid his broader clashes with the government. He said the prison could ease overcrowding but would not itself curb organized crime, stressing that Costa Rica’s criminal landscape differs sharply from El Salvador’s.
The homicide rate in Costa Rica, long considered one of the region's safest countries, peaked at 17.2 per 100,000 people in 2023, or 906 killings.
"This is one of the most complex moments in our history," Diaz said. "(The DEA) is well aware of the situation."

items.title: USDA corrige dados de setembro do milho dos EUA devido a "erro de processamento"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) corrigiu os dados sobre o milho divulgados em setembro, após um "erro de processamento" afetar as previsões de rendimento e produção do país, informou a agência nesta sexta-feira.
items.body:
O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA) corrigiu os dados sobre o milho divulgados em setembro, após um "erro de processamento" afetar as previsões de rendimento e produção do país, informou a agência nesta sexta-feira.
O USDA tem enfrentado críticas de comerciantes de grãos, analistas e economistas quanto à confiabilidade de suas estimativas de safra devido a uma série de erros nos dados.
A agência, há muito considerada o padrão ouro em informações sobre o mercado agrícola global, havia afirmado anteriormente que buscava aprimorar suas estimativas de safra.
O Serviço Nacional de Estatísticas Agrícolas (NASS, na sigla em inglês) do USDA descobriu o erro após surgirem preocupações sobre um relatório de safra divulgado neste mês, que projetava que os agricultores dos EUA colheriam mais bushels de milho do que o esperado anteriormente, de acordo com o comunicado da agência.
A previsão de safra acima do esperado causou uma queda nos futuros de milho dos EUA.
"O NASS identificou um erro de processamento que afetou as populações de plantas de milho, a contagem de espigas, os rendimentos e a produção de setembro para o Kansas e o Nebraska", afirmou o comunicado.
"O erro também afetou as médias de 10 Estados para setembro em relação às populações de plantas e contagem de espigas, além das previsões de rendimento e produção de milho nos EUA."
Um relatório CORREÇÃO, publicado pelo USDA em seu site, apresentou um rendimento do milho em setembro de 178,8 bushels por acre. No mês passado, o USDA informou que sua estimativa de rendimento para setembro era de 178,5 bushels por acre.
O USDA revisou sua estimativa de produção para setembro para 15,828 bilhões de bushels, ante a estimativa original de 15,800 bilhões.
As previsões para a safra de outubro foram revisadas, validadas e não sofreram alterações, informou o USDA.
(Reportagem de Tom Polansek)

items.title: SoftBank-backed OPay eyes up to $4.4 billion US IPO valuation
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: OPay is targeting a valuation of up to $4.42 billion in its US initial public offering, the digital payments company said on Friday, seeking to capitalize on growing demand for digital financial services in emerging markets.
items.body:
OPay is targeting a valuation of up to $4.42 billion in its US initial public offering, the digital payments company said on Friday, seeking to capitalize on growing demand for digital financial services in emerging markets.
The Nigeria-focused firm is seeking up to $366 million by offering roughly 16 million American Depositary Shares between $19 and $21 apiece.
The offering comes as the United States IPO market faces renewed pressure from higher inflation and a selloff in AI-related stocks, weighing on investor appetite for new listings and prompting several companies to delay their listing plans.
Founded in 2018, OPay provides digital financial services, including payments, money transfers, savings and loans, and also operates in Indonesia, Egypt and Pakistan.
Nigeria, the world's sixth-most-populous country, has emerged as one of Africa's leading fintech markets, producing several fintech companies including Moniepoint, Flutterwave and Interswitch, according to Tracxn.
OPay was founded by Chinese billionaire Yahui Zhou, who also founded Beijing Kunlun Tech, a Chinese gaming company that previously owned dating app Grindr.
The company raised $400 million in 2021 at a valuation of $2 billion. It had about 50 million monthly active users as of July 31, according to its IPO prospectus.
SoftBank entities own a 6.6% stake in OPay before the offering, according to the filing.
Investors including Redwheel Group, Coronation Africa Frontiers Fund and other existing backers have indicated non-binding interest in buying up to $270 million worth of ADS. Stanbic Africa Holdings has separately agreed to invest as much as $200 million through a concurrent private placement.
OPay plans to use the proceeds from its IPO and concurrent private placement to invest in technology, expand its distribution network and markets, develop new products and pursue potential acquisitions and strategic investments.
Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Standard Bank and CICC are among the offering's underwriters.
OPay will list on the NYSE under the "OPAY" symbol.

items.body:
O presidente Donald Trump afirmou nesta sexta-feira que os Estados Unidos cuidariam de Cuba depois de lidarem com o Irã e que enviariam o secretário de Estado Marco Rubio para finalizar o acordo.
“Vamos cuidar de Cuba após o Irã... depois, vamos enviar Marco Rubio para finalizar o acordo”, disse Trump em um comício na Flórida.
Trump previu no mês passado que os EUA e Cuba chegariam a um acordo e que não acreditava que uma ação militar fosse necessária.
O governo Trump já havia declarado anteriormente que seu objetivo é mudar o governo comunista de Cuba.
Um bloqueio petrolífero imposto pelos EUA no início deste ano colocou Cuba sob forte pressão, já que o país enfrenta escassez de combustível e apagões agravados pela infraestrutura precária.
Washington mantém um embargo contra Cuba há mais de 60 anos, e o governo Trump vem intensificando a pressão sobre Havana depois que as Forças Armadas dos EUA capturaram, em janeiro, o então presidente venezuelano, Nicolás Maduro.
O ministro das Relações Exteriores de Cuba afirmou na Assembleia Geral da ONU, no mês passado, que Cuba estaria sempre aberta ao diálogo com Washington.

NAIROBI, Oct 23 (Reuters) – Kenya has recorded a second Ebola death, the health ministry said late on Friday, adding that the 65-year-old woman had developed symptoms during quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died of Ebola earlier this month.

The outbreak, which started in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has now been reported in four countries across eastern, central and western Africa, giving it the widest geographic spread of any Ebola outbreak on the continent to date.

Kenya’s first Ebola case was identified this month in a man who travelled from Congo to Nairobi and died at a Nairobi hospital on October 5.

Show Full Article

Since then, Kenyan authorities have traced 135 contacts, all of whom were placed in quarantine, with nine cases confirmed.

The Ebola victim who died on Friday evening was a direct contact of the index patient, the ministry said.

“This loss brings the number of deaths to two among the nine confirmed cases. The remaining seven patients continue to receive care in the two isolation facilities,” the ministry said, adding there was no evidence of community spread in the country.

Late on Monday, the US State Department advised Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya and raised its travel advisory level for the country because of health risks.

On Tuesday, Nigeria became the fourth African country to report an Ebola case, with officials scrambling to work out how and where the patient, who had not travelled to the Democratic Republic of Congo, contracted the disease.

Ebola has infected nearly 10,000 people and killed more than 4,600 in Congo. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. Only people with symptoms can transmit the virus.

The rare Ebola species behind the current outbreak has no approved treatment or vaccine.

(Reporting by Vincent Mumo Nzilani; writing by George Obulutsa; Editing by Daniel Wallis)

items.body:
El presidente Donald Trump dijo el viernes que Estados Unidos se ocuparía de Cuba una vez resuelto el asunto de Irán y que enviaría al secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio, para cerrar el acuerdo.
"Nos ocuparemos de Cuba a la vuelta de Irán... y luego enviaremos a Marco Rubio para que cierre el acuerdo", dijo Trump en un mitin celebrado en Florida.
Trump predijo el mes pasado que Estados Unidos y Cuba llegarían a un acuerdo y que no creía que fuese necesaria una acción militar.
La administración de Trump ha declarado anteriormente que su objetivo es cambiar el Gobierno comunista de Cuba.
El confinamiento petrolero impuesto por Estados Unidos a principios de este año ha sometido a Cuba a una grave crisis, ya que el país se enfrenta a la escasez de combustible y a cortes de electricidad, agravados por una infraestructura deficiente.
Washington lleva más de 60 años manteniendo un embargo contra Cuba y el Gobierno de Trump ha intensificado la presión sobre La Habana después de que, en enero, el ejército estadounidense capturara al entonces presidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro en una incursión mortal.
El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Cuba dijo el mes pasado ante la Asamblea General de la ONU que Cuba siempre estaría abierta al diálogo con Washington.

items.title: Açúcar bruto registra primeira alta na bolsa ICE em 6 pregões com força do petróleo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram pela primeira vez em seis sessões, à medida que os preços do petróleo se recuperaram e as preocupações climáticas relacionadas ao El Niño persistiram, enquanto o café registrou queda.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram pela primeira vez em seis sessões, à medida que os preços do petróleo se recuperaram e as preocupações climáticas relacionadas ao El Niño persistiram, enquanto o café registrou queda.
AÇÚCAR * O contrato de açúcar bruto fechou com alta de 0,11 centavo, ou 0,5%, a 20,24 centavos por libra-peso, após cair pela quinta sessão consecutiva na quinta-feira e fechar em queda de 1,6%. O mercado registrou perda de 3% na semana.
* Consumidores e operadores provavelmente entraram no mercado como compradores, vendo uma boa oportunidade após as recentes quedas, já que não faltam fatores de alta no mercado, disse o consultor Michael McDougall.
* Entre esses fatores estão o excesso de chuvas associadas ao El Niño no Brasil, principal produtor, e novos aumentos nos preços do petróleo , o que pode levar as usinas de cana a reduzir a produção de açúcar e intensificar a produção de etanol como combustível.
* Além disso, a Índia prorrogou o prazo para permitir a importação isenta de impostos de 1 milhão de toneladas métricas de açúcar bruto de 31 de outubro para 31 de dezembro, dando aos importadores mais tempo para trazer a commodity para o maior país consumidor de açúcar do mundo.
* Os preços do açúcar na Índia, que também é o segundo maior produtor mundial de açúcar, estão disparando, já que o país enfrenta chuvas de monção abaixo do normal devido ao fenômeno climático El Niño.
* O açúcar branco subiu 0,2%, para US$534,80 por tonelada métrica, embora tenha registrado uma perda semanal de 3,6%.
CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em queda de 5 centavos, ou 1,6%, a US$3,0745 por libra-peso, após ter atingido na quarta-feira uma máxima de seis semanas de US$3,1820. Ele registrou alta de 0,6% na semana.
* O café está sendo impulsionado por estoques da bolsa extremamente baixos e por um real forte , o que desestimula os exportadores do Brasil, principal produtor, a vender café cotado em dólares, uma vez que isso reduz os retornos em moeda local.
* Os estoques de arábica na ICE caíram novamente na sexta-feira para 227.978 sacas, perto do nível mais baixo em 27 anos.
* Os operadores estão acompanhando a eleição presidencial deste domingo no Brasil, que poderia consolidar novos ganhos para o real caso o candidato da oposição, Flávio Bolsonaro, vença, conforme indicam as pesquisas.
* O preço do café robusta caiu 1,8%, para US$3.242 a tonelada. O mercado de robusta registrou queda de 5% na semana.
CACAU * O cacau de Londres fechou com alta de 15 libras, ou 0,3%, a 4.311 libras por tonelada, após ter fechado com queda de 3,9% na quinta-feira.
* O cacau de Nova York ficou praticamente inalterado, a US$5.592 por tonelada.
* Ambos os mercados registraram uma queda semanal de 1%.
(Reportagem de May Angel e Marcelo Teixeira)

items.title: 米国株式市場＝主要3指数軒並み下落、ハイテク株は持ち直し
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lewis Krauskopf　Tharuniyaa Lakshmi　Ragini Mathur

[２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Lewis Krauskopf　Tharuniyaa Lakshmi　Ragini Mathur

[２３日 ロイター] - 米国株式市場は主要株価３指数が軒並み下落して取引を終えた。一方、ハイテク株は持ち直し、市場をけん引してきた人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄にとって波乱の１週間を締めくくった。市場の関心は、来週予定される企業決算や連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）に移っている。

ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総合は小幅な下げにとどまった。前日は、巨額のＡＩ投資を支える資金調達コストへの懸念が強まり、１日として６月以来の大幅下落となっていた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の大半のセクターが軟調で、一般消費財や金融はいずれも１％を大きく超える下げとなった。一方、エネルギーセクターは２．５％上昇し、過去最高値を付けた。サウジアラビアでのイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃を受け、中東からのエネルギー供給が一段と混乱するとの懸念が高まり、北海ブレント原油はこの日、４月下旬以来の高値を付けた。

この日は通信関連銘柄が下落し、通信サービスセクターの重しとなった。宇宙開発企業スペースＸが全米で少なくとも８万カ所の携帯電話基地局の利用を確保するため、通信インフラ企業と協議していると報じられたことが材料となった。

ＡＴ＆ＴとＴモバイルはともに約８％下落し、ベライゾンは１．２％安。一方、スペースＸは１．９％上昇した。

アメリカン・エキスプレスは３．７％下落し、ダウ工業株３０種の重しとなった。同社は、２０２６年通期の利益予想を市場予想を上回る水準に引き上げた。また、事業再編の一環として世界の従業員の５％に当たる約３５００人を削減する計画を発表した。 

来週は、アルファベット、マイクロソフト、アマゾン・ドット・コムのＡＩ「ハイパースケーラー」３社の四半期決算発表が予定されており、各社の設備投資見通しが市場の注目を集めそうだ。

マン・グループのチーフ・マーケット・ストラテジスト、クリスティナ・フーパー氏は「ＡＩ関連銘柄を疑問視する動きの余波は依然として残っている」と指摘。「来年、ＡＩデータセンター拡張への投資がこれまでの予想よりも少なくなる可能性は確かにある。だからこそ、市場に様子見姿勢が広がっているのだと思う」と述べた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．７２対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１５４億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億株。

items.title: African Champions League holders knocked out in second round
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Holders Mamelodi Sundowns of South Africa were bundled out of the African Champions League in the second preliminary round on Friday, beaten on the away goals rule by Wiliete from Angola.
items.body:
Holders Mamelodi Sundowns of South Africa were bundled out of the African Champions League in the second preliminary round on Friday, beaten on the away goals rule by Wiliete from Angola.
The second leg at Loftus Versfeld in Pretoria finished 1-1 five days after the two sides had played out a goalless draw in Lubango in the first leg last Sunday.
Sundowns went ahead after 11 minutes through Tashreeq Matthews but Angola international Mabululu equalised four minutes into the second half.
Wiliete then produced a stout rearguard action to reach the group phase for the first time.
The lineup for the next round, where 16 teams will be divided into four groups, will be decided on Sunday when the last of the preliminary round matches are played.
Sundowns qualified for the group phase in the previous 11 editions of the Champions League and their defeat ranks among the competition's biggest shocks.

items.title: Justicia argentina archiva investigación contra presidente Milei en escándalo de criptomoneda
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La investigación penal sobre el papel del presidente argentino Javier Milei y su hermana Karina en un escándalo relacionado con una criptomoneda viral fue archivada el viernes, según consta en registros judiciales.
items.body:
La investigación penal sobre el papel del presidente argentino Javier Milei y su hermana Karina en un escándalo relacionado con una criptomoneda viral fue archivada el viernes, según consta en registros judiciales.
Según el periódico local La Nación, el juez federal Marcelo Martínez de Giorgi dictó la orden luego de que el fiscal Eduardo Taiano solicitara el sobreseimiento.
En febrero de 2025 se designó a un juez para investigar el papel de Milei en la promoción de una criptomoneda que se desplomó.
Milei había recomendado la poco conocida criptomoneda $LIBRA en una publicación en su cuenta de X, lo que provocó un breve repunte. Posteriormente, eliminó la publicación y negó cualquier vínculo con la criptomoneda, cuyo precio pronto se desplomó.
La investigación había analizado un posible fraude relacionado con el lanzamiento de la criptomoneda.
En el momento del desplome de la moneda, Milei afirmó haber actuado "de buena fe" y acusó a sus rivales políticos de intentar aprovecharse de la situación.

items.title: Petrolera NABEP aumenta producción en el Lago de Maracaibo en Venezuela
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La petrolera North America Blue Energy Partners (NABEP) ha incrementado la extracción de crudo en su mayor proyecto activo, Petrozamora, hasta alcanzar los 115.000 barriles diarios (bpd), dijo el viernes su director ejecutivo, Alejandro Betancourt.
items.body:
La petrolera North America Blue Energy Partners (NABEP) ha incrementado la extracción de crudo en su mayor proyecto activo, Petrozamora, hasta alcanzar los 115.000 barriles diarios (bpd), dijo el viernes su director ejecutivo, Alejandro Betancourt.
La compañía, que en agosto firmó un acuerdo clave con Estados Unidos, planea incorporar al proyecto ubicado en el Lago de Maracaibo, al oeste de Venezuela, dos campos adicionales, Bachaquero 3 y Ceuta 4, en el transcurso de los próximos cuatro meses, añadió Betancourt durante un evento transmitido por la televisión estatal.
En julio, Petrozamora registraba una producción de unos 100.000 bpd,de acuerdo con cifras independientes consultadas por Reuters.

items.title: Trump says US will 'take care of Cuba' on its way back from Iran
items.author: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
items.summary: President Donald Trump said on Friday the United States would take care of Cuba after dealing with Iran and would send Secretary of State Marco Rubio to finish the deal.
items.body:
President Donald Trump said on Friday the United States would take care of Cuba after dealing with Iran and would send Secretary of State Marco Rubio to finish the deal.
"We'll take care of Cuba on our way back from Iran ... then we're going to send Marco Rubio in to finish up the deal," Trump told a rally in Florida.
Trump [USN:L1N45I044 TEXT:"predicted last month"] the US and Cuba would reach an agreement and that he did not think military action would be necessary.
The Trump administration [USN:L1N45L02I TEXT:"has previously stated"] its goal is to change Cuba's communist government.
A US-imposed oil blockade implemented earlier this year has put Cuba under severe strain as it contends with fuel shortages and [USN:L1N44002K TEXT:"blackouts"] exacerbated by failing infrastructure.
Washington has maintained an embargo on Cuba for more than 60 years and the Trump administration has been [USN:L1N4590T5 TEXT:"stepping up pressure"] on Havana after the US military in January seized then-Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro in a deadly raid.
Cuba's foreign minister told the UN General Assembly last month Cuba would always be open for dialogue with Washington.

items.title: Ravens list QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) as questionable vs. Bengals
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was listed as questionable for his team's home game Sunday against the Cincinnati Bengals because of a left ankle injury.
items.body:
Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was listed as questionable for his team's home game Sunday against the Cincinnati Bengals because of a left ankle injury.
Jackson was limited at practice for a third consecutive day on Friday because of an injury he picked up against the Tennessee Titans back on Oct. 4.
The two-time MVP quarterback missed the second half of the Titans game and the following two games -- a Baltimore win at Atlanta and last week's loss in Cleveland -- while recovering from the injury.
"He's still got a lot of work to do in order to be able to play on Sunday, but he's really working at it behind the scenes," Ravens offensive coordinator Declan Doyle said Thursday. "It's great having him in the meeting room. And it's another thing to be able to have him out there on the field with us and continuing to push and his teammates seeing him push and all that stuff."
Jackson has six TD passes and one interception plus a rushing touchdown in 14 total quarters played in 2026. In his stead, Baltimore turned to Tyler Huntley at quarterback the past two weeks.
Jackson is 11-2 as a starter against Cincinnati in his career with 3,699 total yards (2,868 passing) and 26 TDs (two rushing TDs).
The Ravens are one of three 4-2 teams in the AFC North and lead the division in points (156) while ranking last in points allowed (132). Baltimore has 116 points and 14 touchdowns with Jackson at quarterback this season, compared to 40 points and four touchdowns without him.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Detained migrants have no constitutional right to bond hearings, US court rules
items.author: Nate Raymond
items.creator: Nate Raymond
items.summary: A US appeals court ruled on Friday that President Donald Trump's administration is not required under the US Constitution to give detained immigrants a chance to seek release on bond.
items.body:
A US appeals court ruled on Friday that President Donald Trump 's administration is not required under the US Constitution to give detained immigrants a chance to seek release on bond.
In a 10-7 ruling powered by its conservative majority, the New Orleans-based 5th US Circuit Court of Appeals decided that the Constitution's Fifth Amendment due process protections do not require that immigration detainees receive bond hearings.
"To the extent petitioners seek to vindicate a liberty interest to be free from physical restraint in the most abstract sense, they can do so at any moment by agreeing to leave the country," US Circuit Judge Cory Wilson, a Trump appointee, wrote in the decision.
The ruling, if left to stand, would eliminate a key avenue for detained migrants in the three states under the 5th Circuit's jurisdiction — Texas, Louisiana and Mississippi — to argue for release, especially if the US Supreme Court decides the administration's detention practice complies with immigration law.
The Supreme Court this month [USN:L1N45N0KS TEXT:"agreed to consider"] the issue, which has divided lower courts. Numerous lawsuits by migrants arguing they were being unlawfully detained have flooded the courts as US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, or ICE, implemented Trump's mass deportation agenda.
The Supreme Court is considering only whether such hearings are required by statute, not by the Constitution, the issue the 5th Circuit addressed with Friday's decision.
While the 5th Circuit in February had adopted the administration's reading of immigration law as requiring mandatory detention, a 2-1 panel of the court in July held that ICE could not constitutionally detain people for more than 90 days without providing hearings to argue for release on bond.
The decision, which came in lawsuits by two Mexican citizens and one Honduran, carried particular importance because Texas and Louisiana, within the 5th Circuit's jurisdiction, house the nation's largest numbers of immigration detainees.
But the full 5th Circuit agreed to rehear the case, and on Friday reversed course, concluding that detained immigrants are not constitutionally entitled to proceedings in immigration court beyond what Congress provided by statute.
"This ruling opens the door to more people being locked up for no reason, with devastating consequences for them, their loved ones and their community," Ellie Norton, a lawyer for the non-US citizens in the case at the National Immigration Project, said in a statement.
James Percival, the general counsel for the US Department of Homeland Security, in a social media post hailed what he called a "big win in the 5th Circuit on mandatory detention for illegal aliens."
Among the dissenting judges was US Circuit Judge Dana Douglas, an appointee of Democratic President Joe Biden, who wrote that "unchecked, executive authority to arrest and detain, indefinitely, echoes fearfully from history."
items.raw_description: A US appeals court ruled on Friday that President Donald Trump's administration is not required under the US Constitution to give detained immigrants a chance to seek release on bond.

［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ - 米国時間の原油先物は３ドル超上昇し、約半年ぶりの高値で取引を終えた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビア攻撃を受け、中東からのエネルギー供給が一段と混乱するとの懸念が強まった。アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）当局も原油流出を報告した。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が３．５５ドル（３．１４％）高の１バレル＝１１６．７２ドルと、４月２９日以来の高値。米ＷＴＩ先物は３．８０ドル（３．８％）高の１０３．２７ドルだった。

週間では北海ブレントが６％、ＷＴＩが２．３％上昇した。

ＬＰＬファイナンシャルのチーフクロスアセットストラテジスト、アダム・ターンクイスト氏は「フーシ派が、エネルギーインフラを含むサウジ各地で一連の攻撃を実施し、供給混乱への懸念が相場を押し上げた」と述べた。

ＵＡＥの気候変動・環境省は、ウンムアルカイワイン沖でタンカーからの原油流出が確認されたと発表した。流出の原因は明らかにしておらず、当局は該当するタンカーを特定していない。
