items.title: Wall Street fecha em baixa, encerrando semana volátil
items.author: Lewis Krauskopf, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Ragini Mathur
items.creator: Lewis Krauskopf, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Ragini Mathur
items.summary: Os principais índices de Wall Street fecharam em baixa nesta sexta-feira, mesmo com as ações do setor de tecnologia se estabilizando um pouco, encerrando uma semana turbulenta para o setor de IA que impulsiona o mercado, com os investidores aguardando uma agenda repleta de divulgações de resultados corporativos e uma reunião do Federal Reserve sobre a política de taxas de juros.
items.body:
Os principais índices de Wall Street fecharam em baixa nesta sexta-feira, mesmo com as ações do setor de tecnologia se estabilizando um pouco, encerrando uma semana turbulenta para o setor de IA que impulsiona o mercado, com os investidores aguardando uma agenda repleta de divulgações de resultados corporativos e uma reunião do Federal Reserve sobre a política de taxas de juros.
O Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) registrou uma leve baixa um dia depois que o índice predominantemente tecnológico sofreu sua maior queda em um único dia desde junho, à medida que aumentavam as preocupações com os custos de financiamento para sustentar os pesados gastos com investimentos em IA. O setor de tecnologia do S&P 500 registrou um ganho de 0,35% nesta sexta-feira.
A maioria dos setores do S&P 500, no entanto, registrou quedas, incluindo recuos bem acima de 1% nos setores de bens de consumo básico e bens de consumo discricionário, bem como no setor financeiro.
Na próxima semana, cerca de um terço das empresas do S&P 500 divulgará seus resultados trimestrais, incluindo a Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , a Microsoft (MSFT.O) e a Amazon (AMZN.O) — três gigantes da IA cujas previsões de gastos de capital serão acompanhadas de perto em Wall Street.
“Ainda há repercussões do questionamento em torno do setor de IA”, disse Kristina Hooper, estrategista-chefe de mercado da Man Group. “Certamente existe a possibilidade de vermos menos investimentos na expansão de data centers de IA no próximo ano do que o projetado. Portanto, acredito que isso esteja causando uma pausa.”
O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 1,23%, para 52.215,16 pontos; o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 0,52%, para 7.623,68 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuou 0,21%, para 25.955,34 pontos.
Na semana, o S&P 500 recuou 0,5% e o Nasdaq caiu 0,7%. O Dow Jones, índice de blue chips, subiu 0,4%, registrando seu terceiro ganho semanal consecutivo.
As ações de telecomunicações caíram e pesaram sobre o setor de serviços de comunicação, após uma reportagem afirmar que a SpaceX buscava milhares de locais para antenas de telefonia celular para uma quarta operadora móvel.
As ações da AT&T (T.N) e da T-Mobile (TMUS.O) afundaram quase 8%, enquanto a Verizon (VZ.N) recuou 1,2%. As ações da SpaceX subiram 1,9%. As operadoras de torres de telefonia celular dos EUA registraram ganhos, com a Crown Castle (CCI.N) saltando 9% e a American Tower (AMT.N) subindo 4%.
O setor de energia (.SPNY) subiu 2,5%, atingindo uma máxima recorde. O petróleo Brent atingiu seu nível mais alto desde o final de abril, depois que ataques dos houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram preocupações com novas interrupções no fornecimento de energia do Oriente Médio.
As ações da American Express (AXP.N) caíram 3,7%, pesando sobre o Dow. A empresa elevou sua previsão de lucro ao mesmo tempo em que anunciou planos para eliminar 5% de sua força de trabalho.
As ações da SLB (SLB.N) saltaram 7% depois que a prestadora de serviços para campos petrolíferos superou as estimativas de Wall Street para o lucro do terceiro trimestre.
Dados da Universidade de Michigan mostraram que a confiança do consumidor nos EUA recuou ligeiramente em outubro, aproximando-se de uma mínima histórica, à medida que o aumento dos preços devido ao conflito no Oriente Médio prejudicou a percepção das famílias sobre a economia.
O foco do mercado continua voltado para a temporada de resultados, com o robusto crescimento dos lucros corporativos sustentando as altas dos principais índices de ações neste ano. As empresas do S&P 500 devem registrar um aumento nos lucros de mais de 32% no terceiro trimestre, de acordo com dados da LSEG IBES.
Espera-se que o Fed mantenha as taxas de juros inalteradas quando divulgar sua declaração de política monetária na quarta-feira, mas os investidores estarão ansiosos por indícios sobre se o banco central dos EUA aumentará as taxas em sua reunião de dezembro. Wall Street também está cada vez mais focada nas eleições de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro, que decidirão o controle do Congresso dos EUA.

items.title: Instacart in talks with DoorDash and Uber for sale, The Information reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Instacart is exploring a possible sale and has held preliminary discussions with potential buyers including Uber and DoorDash, The Information reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
items.body:
Instacart (CART.O) is exploring a possible sale and has held preliminary discussions with potential buyers including Uber and DoorDash, The Information reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Shares of Instacart closed about 9% higher on Friday. The company had a market value of about $12 billion as of Thursday's close.
A potential takeover by Uber or DoorDash could bolster the buyer's online grocery delivery ambitions by combining Instacart's established marketplace and retailer ties with its own vast delivery network and customer base.
But either deal could draw antitrust scrutiny, as it would bulk up two of the biggest food-delivery platforms in the US and add to a wave of consolidation. In July, Uber struck a nearly $15 billion deal to buy Germany's Delivery Hero.
Shares of Uber (UBER.N) closed down around 3% while DoorDash (DASH.O) were 4% lower. Instacart declined to comment when contacted by Reuters, while Uber and DoorDash did not immediately respond.
Discussions are ongoing with no guarantee of a deal, the report said, adding that a typical takeover premium of 30% to 40% would value Instacart at roughly $16 billion to $17 billion, based on recent public technology deals.
Last year, Instacart lowered its minimum order for free delivery for Instacart+ members to $10, as rivals DoorDash and Uber Eats expand grocery and convenience delivery. Amazon (AMZN.O) is also expanding its quick delivery service, Amazon Now, which delivers groceries and essentials in 30 minutes or less.
"Instacart risks getting squeezed between retailers building their own digital channels and larger platforms that can bundle grocery with other services, giving consumers more reasons to keep coming back," Emarketer analyst Zak Stambor said.
"For Instacart, a deal could provide the resources and reach to compete more effectively than it could on its own," he said.
In 2021, DoorDash had held talks to acquire Instacart, legally known as Maplebear, in a potential deal that would have valued it between $40 billion and $50 billion, [USN:L4N2PI4JF TEXT:"The Information"] had reported. The concerns about Biden administration's antitrust approval derailed the talks.
Stambor said the latest deal is plausible as the Trump administration has shown "greater willingness" to approve deals even as "it could come at the cost of selling off parts of the business."

items.summary: Sam Altman-led OpenAI said on Friday it had resumed reinforcement learning training and internal use of its most advanced AI solutions after it tightened security controls and barred internet access for frontier-model training.
items.body:
Sam Altman-led OpenAI said on Friday it had resumed reinforcement learning training and internal use of its most advanced AI solutions after it tightened security controls and barred internet access for frontier-model training.
Concerns are mounting over the ability of increasingly capable AI agents to identify and exploit software flaws, including in guardrails.
OpenAI had halted training and evaluation of its most capable models after an internal research model briefly exploited a misconfiguration to gain limited internet access on September 2, it said in a blog post
The ChatGPT maker resumed reinforcement learning training and internal inference of its frontier models on October 1 after implementing additional safeguards
It has launched a campaign to probe its research infrastructure for vulnerabilities that could allow models to escape isolated computing environments, OpenAI said

The company [USN:L4N45N1OZ TEXT:"has been conducting"] a broad review of its AI models' activity after the accidental [USN:L6N4580VP TEXT:"Hugging Face hacking"]

items.title: AI 'hallucinations' in court filings show signs of slowdown, but judges still sound alarms
items.author: Mike Scarcella, Sara Merken
items.creator: Mike Scarcella, Sara Merken
items.summary: New instances of "hallucinations" and other AI-generated errors in court filings fell in the second and third quarters of 2026, according to new research, indicating that lawyers and other users may be taking greater precautions or that newer generative AI models could be less prone to mistakes.
items.body:
New instances of "hallucinations" and other AI-generated errors in court filings fell in the second and third quarters of 2026, according to new research, indicating that lawyers and other users may be taking greater precautions or that newer generative AI models could be less prone to mistakes.
Court filings containing made-up, misquoted, misleading or incorrectly cited legal filing surged since 2022, when AI technology debuted on a mass scale.
But legal scholar Damien Charlotin, who created a highly-cited database of hallucination-related cases, said in a blog post on Friday that their number had declined since the spring.
Until then, the number of cases involving AI-related errors had been rapidly rising, according to Charlotin's database, which has tracked at least 1,500 such cases in US state and federal courts.
Charlotin, a senior researcher at the business school at HEC Paris, cautioned that a range of factors could be contributing to the decline, including the possibility that errors are just as frequent but are being reported less often when they are viewed as minor or unsurprising.
"Part of the reason lies in the progress on the model front: new LLMs hallucinate less," Charlotin wrote, citing a recent research experiment where various models were asked to create legal documents.
Charlotin told Reuters on Friday he expects instances of AI errors to continue to decrease but not disappear in the short or medium term.
"Tools get better, true, but not everyone is up to date on the latest tools," he said. He also said technological improvements could cause lawyers to lower their guard. "If AI does the job great in 99% of the cases, you'll eventually stop checking and rely on it – until it hallucinates again," he said.
In the meantime, US judges are [USN:L6N42308A TEXT:"continuing to warn"] about the prevalence of AI errors, especially in court filings by non-lawyers.
“It is this court’s experience that for every good AI-assisted filing there are ten more obstructive ones,” US District Judge John Tuchi in Arizona said in an order on Thursday dismissing a civil rights lawsuit. “And the obstructive ones are often like the head of Hydra, for each one dismissed, several more follow.”
Tuchi said the lawsuit filed by the plaintiff who was not represented by an attorney lacked factual specificity and appeared to be produced using AI. The judge allowed the plaintiff to file an amended case. He didn't bar the use of AI in the case but complained that AI-assisted submissions had gotten out of control.
“The court simply decries the overwhelming volume of filings, and sheer verbiage therein, which to date have pummeled courts," Tuchi wrote.
Lawyers are generally not prohibited from using AI, but they are bound by ethics and other court rules to verify the accuracy of their court submissions. Individuals without lawyers also have obligations to ensure the accuracy of court papers they file.

items.author: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
items.summary: US President Donald Trump said on Friday Washington may carry out another military operation against Iranat a time when the war is nearing its eight month mark and as rise in fuel prices weigh on the US midterm elections.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump said on Friday Washington may carry out another military operation against Iran at a time when the war is nearing its eight month mark and as rise in fuel prices weigh on the US midterm elections .
"We may do another little Epic Fury," Trump said in remarks at a rally in Florida as he spoke about the war. He did not elaborate.
"Operation Epic Fury" is the name used by the US military for its war against Iran.
Earlier on Friday, Trump said the US could end the war quickly but questioned whether Washington should seek a swift conclusion or allow the conflict to gradually wind down.
Trump, who has [USN:L4N4061X8 TEXT:"offered shifting goals and timelines"] for the war, said earlier this month that the US would not launch an attack on Iran before the midterm elections in which control of Congress is up for grab.
US-Israeli strikes on Iran and Israeli attacks on Lebanon have [USN:L1N3ZR14Q TEXT:"killed thousands"] and [USN:L6N3ZY0Q0 TEXT:"displaced millions"]

items.title: No hay evidencia de colocación de bandera palestina en la cima de la Torre Eiffel
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: No hay registro de que una bandera palestina haya ondeado en la cima de la Torre Eiffel en París, Francia, contrario a lo que muestra un clip compartido en redes sociales.
items.body:
No hay registro de que una bandera palestina haya ondeado en la cima de la Torre Eiffel en París, Francia, contrario a lo que muestra un clip compartido en redes sociales.
Estos son los detalles clave:
Una publicación en Facebook dice que activistas del grupo Extinction Rebellion colocaron la bandera sobre el monumento.
La publicación más antigua con el video fue compartida el 18 de octubre por el usuario de TikTok @jaranor.films, quien se describe como “creador de contenido Audiovisual & IA” y no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios.
La plataforma identificó el video como material con contenido multimedia generado por IA.
Déborah Thiney-Masselin, portavoz de la Dirección General de la Policía Nacional de Francia, dijo en un correo el 20 de octubre que el clip compartido en redes sociales es falso y fue generado íntegramente por IA.
Un análisis con la herramienta de verificación Meta Platforms determinó que la imagen probablemente fue editada o creada usando los modelos de IA de la empresa tecnológica. La herramienta detecta marcas de agua invisibles incrustadas en el medio generado.
En el video, la bandera sobre la estructura contiene una estrella en el costado izquierdo, lo que no corresponde con la bandera palestina, y tampoco es visible un puente debajo, como lo muestra una captura de Google Street View.
El 15 de mayo de 2026, miembros de Extinction Rebellion subieron a la Torre Eiffel para mostrar banderas palestinas en una planta inferior y no en la cima.
Francia registra una ola de [USN:L8N4670KY TEXT:"manifestaciones"] que ha dado lugar a [USN:L8N46401O TEXT:"enfrentamientos"] y daños materiales.
La sociedad que administra la Torre Eiffel no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios.
Veredicto: Sin evidencia. No hay registro de que un grupo de personas haya colocado una bandera palestina en la cima de la Torre Eiffel.

items.title: Video de senadora de Morena discutiendo es antiguo y no está relacionado con mensaje sobre aerolínea
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Un video grabado en 2023 en el que la senadora Martha Lucía Mícher, del partido oficialista Morena, renuncia al partido durante una discusión en el Senado se comparte erróneamente en publicaciones que dicen que ocurrió en octubre de 2026, después de que la funcionaria hiciera comentarios sobre beneficios para clientes de Aeroméxico.
items.body:
Un video grabado en 2023 en el que la senadora Martha Lucía Mícher, del partido oficialista Morena, renuncia al partido durante una discusión en el Senado se comparte erróneamente en publicaciones que dicen que ocurrió en octubre de 2026, después de que la funcionaria hiciera comentarios sobre beneficios para clientes de Aeroméxico.
Publicaciones en línea que incluyen el video dicen en parte: “La Senadora Malú Micher de MORENA hace berrinche y amenaza con irse del partido ya que no la defendieron en su postura contra las salas VIP de Aeroméxico”.
En el video, Mícher dice que iba a renunciar a Morena frente a integrantes de su bancada, entre ellas la entonces senadora Citlalli Hernández, hoy presidenta de la Comisión Nacional de Elecciones de Morena.
Sin embargo, la versión más antigua del video vista por Reuters fue publicada por Político MX el 26 de octubre del 2023.
Imágenes de la transmisión de la asamblea muestran el momento en que ocurrió el altercado, después de que la entonces presidenta de la Mesa Directiva, Ana Lilia Rivera, también de Morena, le negara la palabra a Mícher en la discusión de la Ley de Ingresos de 2024.
Imágenes de la transmisión de la asamblea de ese día muestran el momento en que ocurrió el altercado, después de que la entonces presidenta de la Mesa Directiva, Ana Lilia Rivera, también de Morena, le negara la palabra a Mícher en la discusión de la Ley de Ingresos de 2024.
La senadora Lilly Téllez compartió otro ángulo de la discusión.
Horas después, Mícher dijo en su cuenta de X que había dialogado con Rivera y “se aclararon ideas”.
La senadora no presentó una renuncia oficial en esa fecha y, al 23 de octubre de 2026, Mícher figura como integrante de Morena en el sitio web del Senado .
POLÍTICAS DE AEROMÉXICO El 16 de octubre, la senadora expresó en X su inconformidad por los cambios en el acceso a los salones de Aeroméxico y dijo que pediría una reunión con ejecutivos de la empresa para que explicaran sus nuevas políticas.
No hay información oficial a la fecha sobre negociaciones en el Senado con Aeroméxico.
Según el sitio web de Aeroméxico, a partir del 1 de septiembre actualizó las condiciones de acceso a sus Salones Premier para socios Aeroméxico Rewards y dijo que los vuelos nacionales en Clase Premier ya no incluirían acceso a Salón Premier.
El equipo de comunicación de Morena y Mícher no respondieron inmediatamente a una solicitud de comentarios.
VEREDICTO Falta contexto. El video fue grabado durante una sesión del Senado el 26 de octubre de 2023, no muestra un registro actual tras comentarios de Martha Lucía Mícher sobre las políticas para usuarios de Aeroméxico.

items.title: Kenya reports second death from Ebola
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kenya has recorded a second Ebola death, the health ministry said late on Friday, adding that the 65-year-old woman had developed symptoms during quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died of Ebola earlier this month.
items.body:
Kenya has recorded a second Ebola death, the health ministry said late on Friday, adding that the 65-year-old woman had developed symptoms during quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died of Ebola earlier this month.
The outbreak, which started in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has now been reported in four countries across eastern, central and western Africa, giving it the widest geographic spread of any Ebola outbreak on the continent to date.
Kenya's first Ebola case was identified this month in a man who travelled from Congo to Nairobi and died at a Nairobi hospital on October 5.
Since then, Kenyan authorities have traced 135 contacts, all of whom were placed in quarantine, with nine cases confirmed.
The Ebola victim who died on Friday evening was a direct contact of the index patient, the ministry said.
"This loss brings the number of deaths to two among the nine confirmed cases. The remaining seven patients continue to receive care in the two isolation facilities," the ministry said, adding there was no evidence of community spread in the country.
Late on Monday, the US State Department [USN:FWN4651IO TEXT:"advised"] Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya and raised its travel advisory level for the country because of health risks.
On Tuesday, Nigeria became the fourth African country to report an Ebola case, with officials scrambling to work out how and where the patient, who had not travelled to the Democratic Republic of Congo, contracted the disease.
Ebola has infected nearly 10,000 people and killed more than 4,600 in Congo. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. Only people with symptoms can transmit the virus.
The rare Ebola species behind the current outbreak has no approved treatment or vaccine.

items.title: Oncologists Cheer Melanoma Data
items.summary:
Leaked data from Moderna and Merck's highly anticipated melanoma vaccine trial has led to a rare disconnect between doctors, who celebrated the result, and Wall Street, which sold off the stocks.
Normally results of such pivotal drug studies are binary, with doctors, patients and investors all learning whether a novel medicine will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives and forming the same conclusion. Instead, as reports leaked out on social media about the findings of the melanoma shot — days before the carefully scripted presentation planned for thousands of oncologists gathered in Madrid for the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting — realities diverged.  Madison Muller, Bloomberg News Healthcare Reporter, reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: 仏、24日の抗議活動に警官７万人動員　先週末の暴動再発警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Makini Brice　Crispian Balmer

[パリ　２３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Makini Brice　Crispian Balmer

[パリ　２３日　ロイター] - フランスで生活費の高騰などに抗議するデモが大規模な暴動に発展してから１週間が経過する中、ニュネス内相は２３日、暴力行為や略奪の再発を防ぐため、２４日に全国で予定されている抗議活動に対応するため７万人の警察官を動員すると発表した。政府が治安維持能力を失ったとの懸念を払拭するため、精鋭治安部隊や重武装の機動隊を通常の警察部隊とともに配備し、厳戒態勢で臨む。

ニュネス氏は記者団に対し「暴徒や略奪者、あらゆる暴力行為を行う者に対し一切妥協しない」と述べた。「極左」団体がインターネット上で公共施設を標的にし、一段の無秩序状態を引き起こすよう呼びかけていると言及し「これは平穏で友好的なデモではない。最大限の警戒態勢を敷き、断固として対応する。一切の違法行為を容認しない」と語った。

警察当局は２４日に首都パリで予定されるデモについて、労働組合による１件のみを許可。フランス最大の学生組合ＵＮＥＦや、２０１８年に発足した反体制運動「黄色いベスト運動」が申請した集会は許可されなかった。パリ以外の多くの都市でも抗議活動が禁止されたが、第２の都市マルセイユでは禁止命令が撤回され、労組によるデモの実施が認められた。

当局は特に、中部オルレアンで週末に開かれる極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の年次党大会が新たな緊張の火種となる可能性を警戒。ニュネス氏によると、今週末に動員される警察官は前週末より１万人増員される。騎馬警官やヘリコプター、ドローン、対ドローン装備を全国に配備するほか、装甲車や放水車も待機。一部の要警戒地域で導入された夜間外出禁止令は継続されるという。

＜ルーブル美術館など休館、サッカー試合も延期＞

前週末の暴動再発への懸念から、パリの主要文化施設の一部は２４日、終日休館を決めた。対象にはルーブル美術館、オルセー美術館、オペラ座が含まれる。このほか、治安上の懸念から、サッカーフランス１部リーグのパリ・サンジェルマン（ＰＳＧ）対オリンピック・リヨン戦は開催日が２５日から２６日に変更された。一方、米ナショナル・フットボール・リーグ（ＮＦＬ）のピッツバーグ・スティーラーズ対ニューオーリンズ・セインツ戦は、トランプ米大統領が中止を求めたにもかかわらず、２５日にパリで予定通り開催されると見られている。

前週末の暴動で約３０００の店舗や事業所が略奪被害を受けていたため、経済団体も小売店に対し休業を呼びかけている。フランス商工会議所のアラン・ディ・クレセンゾ会頭は、一部の商店主は店舗を守るため野球バットや散弾銃などを準備しているとし、自警のために暴力に訴えないよう呼びかけた。

社会不安の拡大を受け、仏経済の先行き懸念が増大。政府が財政支出の抑制に十分取り組んでいないとの懸念が改めて意識される中、格付け会社ムーディーズが２３日にフランス国債格付けを引き下げるとの観測が市場で広がっている。

items.title: Midterms: Your questions, answered
items.author: Joseph Ax, Jason Lange, Nathan Layne, Rawan Yaghi
items.creator: Joseph Ax, Jason Lange, Nathan Layne, Rawan Yaghi
items.summary: Over the summer, we asked you to submit your most pressing questions about the US midterm elections. Here are the answers and insights from our reporters.
items.body:
Over the summer, we asked you to submit your most pressing questions about the US midterm elections . You asked about voter eligibility checks, threats to election officials or results, the effects of redistricting and which races are most likely to determine control of Congress.
Here are Reuters reporters’ answers to these questions, which were also published in the Politics US Newsletter . Similar questions have been combined and edited for clarity.
If you have more questions related to the midterms or other topics related to US politics, write to campaigntrail@thomsonreuters.com .
Q: Which national issues are having the greatest influence on competitive races? Answered by: Nathan Layne, Politics Reporter, and Jason Lange, Politics Data Reporter
Our [USN:L6N43U101 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos polling"] suggests that [USN:L6N46017L TEXT:"rising prices"], exacerbated by the war with Iran, are having an outsized impact on the midterm environment. About half of voters say the cost of living is the single most important issue in the congressional elections, compared with roughly 1 in 5 who cite democratic norms and about 1 in 10 who point to immigration.
That focus on inflation extends across the major expenses that dominate household budgets, from housing and healthcare to food and fuel. Gasoline prices, pushed higher by the conflict, and the elevated cost of grocery staples such as coffee and beef are particularly potent politically because voters encounter them regularly at the pump and checkout counter.
Starting this past summer, our polling has shown that, for the first time in a decade, voters view Democrats as better stewards of the economy than Republicans. Against that backdrop, Republican strategists and party officials say they are seeking to frame the midterms as a choice between two parties, casting Democrats as increasingly influenced by socialist ideas, rather than a referendum on current economic conditions.
Q: What are the most plausible paths for Democrats and Republicans to win control of the House and Senate in the 2026 midterm elections, and which races are most likely to determine the outcome? Answered by Jason Lange, Politics Data Reporter
Democrats face an uphill fight to win[USN:L6N45U0XV TEXT:" the Senate"], where they need to pick up four seats. They would have to hold Michigan and New Hampshire – both tight races – while flipping four of six Republican-held seats in play: Alaska, Maine, North Carolina, Ohio, Iowa and Texas – the last two of which haven't elected Democrats to the Senate in over a decade.
Republicans face more pressure in[USN:L6N45U0XS TEXT:" the House"], where their 218 members hold the smallest possible majority in the 435-seat chamber. About three dozen races nationwide are competitive. Democrats' best pickup chances include Republican-held seats in Nebraska's 2nd District, New Jersey's 7th and California's 48th, where district boundaries were redrawn to favor Democrats. Democrats must also defend Ohio's 9th and North Carolina's 1st, both redrawn to favor Republicans.
Q: What procedures do states use to verify voter eligibility and citizenship, and what does the available evidence show about the frequency and detection of ineligible voting or other election fraud? Answered by Joseph Ax, National Affairs Correspondent
Under federal law, every state must retain a statewide list of registered voters and perform regular maintenance on it to remove ineligible voters. In addition, US law requires first-time voters in federal elections who registered by mail to show some form of identification at the polls, such as a driver’s license, a paycheck or a utility bill.
Many states have imposed additional, more stringent procedures to verify eligibility, such as photo ID requirements, and those policies vary significantly among states. Votes cast by mail, which have come under frequent baseless attacks from Trump as unreliable, are typically checked by comparing the signature on the envelope with the one on file.
All available evidence indicates that ineligible voting, including noncitizen voting, is exceedingly rare. A Reuters investigation this year found just 129 cases in which noncitizens were federally charged with voting illegally; many appeared to stem from voter confusion or administrative errors, rather than intentional fraud.
The conservative Heritage Foundation think tank maintains a voter fraud database that includes just 1,619 cases from 1982 to 2025, or one for every 817,625 votes cast in a presidential election during that time.
Q: How are election officials preparing for threats to poll workers, misinformation, administrative disruptions or attempts to interfere with voting and vote counting? Answered by Peter Eisler , Ned Parker , Linda So and Mike Spector
Reuters interviewed more than 50 state and local election officials from both political parties, including a dozen secretaries of state, the top election officials in their states. Nearly all said they are adopting new strategies to prepare for political interference, misinformation, cyberattacks and even threats of violence ahead of the midterms. Their efforts span jurisdictions large and small, in areas controlled by Republicans and Democrats. In Michigan, for example, state officials are advising local clerks on the appropriate response if the federal government demands access to voting machines.
Preparations fall into three categories. Some election officials are hiring lawyers or seeking legal skills, as over a dozen interviewees said. Twice that many election officials said they are expanding public outreach and social media campaigns to counter misinformation around the reliability of mail-in voting or voting machines. Most of the interviewed officials said they are scrambling to fill gaps left by the Trump administration’s cuts to programs that help safeguard elections from cyberattacks and physical security threats. That includes ongoing work to fortify election offices with camera systems and bulletproof glass – a trend that began after Trump disputed his loss to Biden in the 2020 election, prompting violent threats by Trump supporters against election workers .
Read our reporting on more specific examples of what election officials are doing in preparation for such potential scenarios in Wisconsin, North Carolina, Georgia, Michigan, Colorado and Maine.
Q: How has redistricting affected the 2026 electoral map, and which maps or election practices are currently facing legal challenges? Answered by Joseph Ax, National Affairs Correspondent
Nine states have new US House maps in place after the redistricting war that unfolded over the last year. Republicans were the clear winners: the party gained an advantage in 15 districts across those states, while Democrats improved their chances in only 6 districts. However, Democrats remain favored to win the House, with Trump’s weak approval ratings[USN:L1N4660I0 TEXT:" dragging down his party’s candidates"].
There are about 40 seats in play in November out of 435 nationwide, meaning that a small fraction of voters will likely determine which party controls the House.
While some of the maps still face legal challenges, none of the litigation appears likely to alter any district lines ahead of November’s election.
Reuters reporters Bianca Flowers , David Hood-Nuño and Ally J. Levine mapped how redistricting has affected communities in Memphis, Tennessee.

Yields rose after the market’s best day in more than a year. Joe Weisenthal, Bloomberg ‘Odd Lots’ Podcast Co-Host, joins to wrap up the week in markets ahead of the next Fed decision and more tech earnings. Jayati Bharadwaj, Head of FX Strategy at TD Securities, weighs in on a rush to safe haven trades. Plus, Bloomberg News AI Infrastructure Reporter Dina Bass joins to discuss her reporting on Blackstone's bet on chips driving a debt boom. Finally, Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry on internet security in light of new PHP vulnerabilities across the web. (Source: Bloomberg)

TORONTO: US President Donald Trump said on Friday (Oct 23) that Canada is working hard to make a trade deal with the United States.
" Canada is working very hard to make a deal with us , and I hate to say this, but we have all the cards," Trump told reporters at the White Ho us e.
A spokesperson for Dominic LeBlanc, Canada 's minister responsible for trade with the US , declined to comment.
The US and Canada have been locked in a trade standoff since talks broke down in Aug us t, triggering new tariffs and retaliation on both sides of the border.
The breakdown has widened a rift between the longtime allies, who have blamed each other for the failed talks. The dispute has spurred Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney to urge a further shift away from Canada 's biggest trading partner and cast doubt on the viability of the US -Mexico- Canada Agreement.

items.title: Argentine judge clears President Milei of wrongdoing in meme coin scandal
items.author: Leila Miller
items.creator: Leila Miller
items.summary: An Argentine federal judge dropped a criminal investigation into President Javier Milei and his sister Karina Milei over a meme coin scandal on Friday, finding no evidence of fraud, according to court records.
items.body:
An Argentine federal judge dropped a criminal investigation into President Javier Milei and his sister Karina Milei over a meme coin scandal on Friday, finding no evidence of fraud, according to court records.
Federal judge Marcelo Martinez de Giorgi had been investigating Milei's role in promoting a cryptocurrency that crashed, looking into allegations of fraud in the coin's launch.
Milei had recommended the little-known crypto coin Libra in a post on X in February 2025, kicking off a brief rally. He later deleted his post and denied having any link to the cryptocurrency, which soon plunged.
Martinez de Giorgi wrote that, while Milei's institutional standing could have given the coin's launch "greater impact" when he posted about it on X, those things "do not, in themselves, amount to a fraudulent scheme."
At the time of the currency's crash, Milei said he had acted "in good faith" and accused his political rivals of trying to take advantage of the situation.
"I was not aware of the details of the project and once I found out, I decided to not continue giving it publicity," he said.
Around $99 million worth of cryptocurrency was withdrawn from the marketplace of the coin by eight digital wallets linked to the crypto token's creator, blockchain researchers said.
Argentina's fintech chamber at the time said the case could potentially be a "rug pull," in which the developers of a crypto token draw legitimate investments, pumping up the value, only to later dump their stake.
The federal judge on Friday also dismissed an investigation into US businessman Hayden Davis, who had described himself as a "launch adviser" for the token and has acknowledged that he held close to $100 million after the crash. Davis has denied any wrongdoing.

items.title: El venezolano de 28 años de Silicon Valley que logró adjudicarse un bloque petrolero de PDVSA
items.author: Raylí Luján
items.summary: Vinculada al cofundador de Coinbase Fred Ehrsam y al emprendedor venezolano Manuel Iribarren, la compañía obtuvo un contrato con PDVSA para desarrollar el bloque Budare-Elotes.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — “No, no estoy dando entrevistas, no estoy interesado, yo vine fue a trabajar”. Manuel Iribarren respondió así cuando, al término de un conversatorio sobre inversiones arriesgadas en el Startup Venezuela Summit, en Caracas, se le preguntó por Primavera Infinita, la empresa que cofundó y que acaba de entrar en el negocio petrolero venezolano. La pregunta apuntaba a cómo un emprendedor procedente del ecosistema tecnológico pretende desarrollar activos petroleros en un país donde recuperar la producción exige inversiones, infraestructura y conocimiento especializado. Iribarren prefirió no profundizar. Ver más: Estos son los ejecutivos que llevarán la nueva estrategia energética de Venezuela Durante el encuentro, sin embargo, había expresado una visión ambiciosa sobre el potencial de Venezuela. Según su intervención, considera que el país, que produce alrededor de 1,2 millones de barriles diarios, podría llegar a 10 millones. La cifra no constituye una meta contractual conocida de Primavera Infinita ni estuvo acompañada de un plan de desarrollo que permitiera evaluar cómo se alcanzaría. La compañía tiene una dimensión mucho más concreta por delante: desarrollar el bloque Budare-Elotes, después de firmar un Contrato de Participación Productiva (CPP) con Petróleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) el 2 de septiembre, durante un acto en el Palacio de Miraflores en el que participaron la presidenta encargada, Delcy Rodríguez, y el secretario de Energía de Estados Unidos, Chris Wright. La adjudicación destacó por el perfil de sus promotores. Primavera Infinita fue constituida en 2026 y está vinculada a Iribarren, un emprendedor venezolano de 28 años criado en Reino Unido y residente de Silicon Valley, y a Fred Ehrsam, cofundador de Coinbase, la plataforma de intercambio de criptomonedas, y de Paradigm, una firma de inversión especializada en criptoactivos. El tercer socio identificado públicamente es Dheeraj Verma, antiguo presidente de Quantum Energy Partners, una firma de inversión en petróleo y gas. El grupo combina experiencia en tecnología, finanzas y capital privado con una apuesta por una industria que exige capacidades operativas específicas. La oportunidad que identifica Ehrsam parte de una premisa: Venezuela dispone de enormes reservas de hidrocarburos y una industria cuya producción se encuentra muy por debajo de sus máximos históricos. En una entrevista con Bloomberg, Ehrsam describió la oportunidad venezolana como excepcional y la comparó con las apuestas empresariales que aparecen pocas veces en una generación. El inversor considera que la recuperación económica del país puede abrir espacio para desarrollar negocios capaces de impulsar la actividad y mejorar las condiciones de vida. Iribarren también ha defendido la apuesta. En declaraciones recogidas por Bloomberg, aseguró que la empresa tiene el compromiso de invertir una cantidad sustancial de capital para recuperar yacimientos e incorporar tecnología y eficiencia operativa. No obstante, evitó revelar cómo se financiarán las operaciones ni ofrecer detalles sobre todos los activos que pretende adquirir. Primavera busca producir 100.000 barriles diarios a corto plazo. La cifra es un objetivo empresarial, no una producción alcanzada. La compañía también ha mostrado interés en los bloques Boca, Guico y Guara, en la Faja Petrolífera del Orinoco, operados por la brasileña Alvorada Heavy Industries. Ver más: Estados Unidos y Venezuela formalizan en Caracas su histórico acuerdo petrolero Budare-Elotes no es un activo nuevo. Los campos que integran el bloque fueron descubiertos hace décadas y estuvieron bajo un contrato con LNGEG Growth I Corp, filial vinculada a la canadiense LNG Energy Group, hasta que las autoridades venezolanas rescindieron el acuerdo en febrero de 2026. Oil & Gas Journal situó en más de 70.000 barriles diarios el potencial de producción atribuido al proyecto. La información pública no permite determinar cómo se relaciona esa cifra con el objetivo de 100.000 barriles diarios de Primavera, qué activos se incluyen en cada cálculo ni en qué plazos se prevé alcanzarlos. La diferencia entre el potencial de un yacimiento y su producción efectiva es decisiva. Los campos maduros pueden requerir reparaciones de pozos, recuperación de presión, intervenciones para reducir la entrada de agua, mantenimiento de instalaciones y mejoras en los sistemas de transporte y procesamiento. A ello se suman las necesidades de electricidad, equipos y servicios para sostener la operación. Un análisis de Antonio Pérez, asesor de contratos petroleros, sobre el acuerdo entre Primavera y PDVSA plantea que la recuperación de Budare-Elotes podría apoyarse en técnicas de recuperación mejorada, rehabilitación de pozos y aprovechamiento del gas asociado. El texto también explora posibles aplicaciones de tokenización financiera y extracción de litio a partir del agua producida. Estas propuestas ilustran algunas de las vías tecnológicas que pueden estudiarse en campos maduros, pero el análisis no demuestra que Primavera haya incorporado esas iniciativas a su plan de desarrollo. No hay información pública suficiente para atribuirle un programa de tokenización de barriles, recuperación de litio o monetización del gas. La tecnología puede ayudar a optimizar la operación y mejorar la recuperación de crudo, pero no elimina las restricciones físicas ni la necesidad de capital. La apuesta de Primavera dependerá de las condiciones reales de los activos, de los recursos que comprometa y de su capacidad para ejecutar un programa de desarrollo. La falta de información sobre el financiamiento no es la única incógnita. Aunque PDVSA confirmó la firma del Contrato de Participación Productiva para Budare-Elotes, los anuncios públicos consultados no incluyen el texto íntegro del acuerdo ni un desglose de sus condiciones económicas. Ver más: Venezuela abre su economía a EE.UU., pero la transición política sigue sin fecha No se ha divulgado un monto específico de inversión comprometida, la duración del contrato, el reparto de los ingresos, las metas de producción exigibles o las condiciones para recuperar el capital invertido. La compañía ha incorporado profesionales con experiencia en la industria, entre ellos Óscar Quintero, antiguo responsable de recuperación mejorada de petróleo de Occidental Petroleum, a quien se le confundió con Iribarren en la firma de acuerdos en Miraflores, y tres exejecutivos de Chevron Venezuela: Mario Gandara, Jorge Castro e Ivette López, en funciones comerciales, financieras y jurídicas. Esa experiencia puede aportar capacidades relevantes, pero no responde por sí sola a las preguntas sobre el capital disponible, el calendario de inversión y las metas operativas.

NEW YORK, Oct 23 : Big AI stocks were mixed on Friday, a day after the biggest decline in the Nasdaq Composite Index in four months, giving investors a welcome respite as they look forward to more information on Anthropic's forthcoming IPO and a further wave of earnings over the next week.
Meta Platforms, the center of Thursday's storm, was fractionally lower following Thursday's 7 per cent decline. The operator of social media networks and major AI investor said in its earnings report this week that it would create a new class of shares in part to raise money for further capital spending, which was taken as evidence that the next leg of the AI buildout will be costly for shareholders.
Other major AI players were mixed on Friday, with SpaceX, Oracle and Dell Technologies up 1 per cent to 2 per cent and Nvidia, Alphabet and Amazon down less than 1 per cent. Big semiconductor stocks were mostly higher after their largest decline since the summer on Thursday.
Credit default swaps tracking the perceived risk of default at the biggest AI players were mostly modestly lower, with Meta's five-year CDS spread trading 0.3 per cent narrower at 123, according to LSEG data. The swaps enable investors to bet on a default using contracts typically with terms of five or 10 years, though contracts frequently change hands for the purposes of hedging positions and betting on near-term market moves.

Thursday's deluge and the day-after calm is the latest sign of indirection in a market that has hovered near record highs without breaking out, said Rick Meckler, partner at Cherry Lane Investments, a family investment office in New Vernon, New Jersey.
"To some extent, we're seeing the market tread water over a longer period of time because every sell-off has been met by buyers and every point upward has been met by sellers," Meckler said.
The Nasdaq was barely changed on Friday afternoon.
Credit-default swap premiums, reflecting the annual cost borne by the swap purchaser in thousands of dollars, have risen over the past year with concern about the risks being taken on by large AI spenders. The premiums rose on Thursday after Meta's decision to sell more stock, as much of the buildout to date has been financed through debt issuance.
The concerns around AI spending and investment returns have added to the market's volatility since Treasury yields rose sharply in August, which changed the economics of investing and bond issuance, given the increasing attractiveness of a higher risk-free rate.
It's been "a very volatile week," said Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B Riley Wealth in Boston. "There's no doubt at some point in time that the higher inflation moves, especially if driven by unsustainably higher energy prices ... would have to show up in corporate earnings. It hasn't yet, but that's the concern. And market participants are trying to position for that."
Shares of neoclouds, smaller companies tied to AI data centers and other infrastructure projects like CoreWeave, have dropped due to anxiety over their future. Their performance of late has also raised talk on Wall Street that capital is growing scarce - which stands to raise costs further and potentially raise funding issues down the road.
Even so, many investors remain positive on the sector, where giant AI lab Anthropic is expected to publish its IPO prospectus in coming days and Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft are expected to report earnings next week.
"In general, AI news in terms of revenues continues to be very strong, it's just at what cost and how long that growth is sustainable," Meckler said. "We really haven't gotten to the point of the market sort of focusing on winners and losers. It's been one big sector trade every day."

Other major AI players were mixed on Friday, with SpaceX, Oracle and Dell Technologies up 1 per cent to 2 per cent and Nvidia, Alphabet and Amazon down less than 1 per cent. Big semiconductor stocks were mostly higher after their largest decline since the summer on Thursday.
Credit default swaps tracking the perceived risk of default at the biggest AI players were mostly modestly lower, with Meta's five-year CDS spread trading 0.3 per cent narrower at 123, according to LSEG data. The swaps enable investors to bet on a default using contracts typically with terms of five or 10 years, though contracts frequently change hands for the purposes of hedging positions and betting on near-term market moves.

Thursday's deluge and the day-after calm is the latest sign of indirection in a market that has hovered near record highs without breaking out, said Rick Meckler, partner at Cherry Lane Investments, a family investment office in New Vernon, New Jersey.
"To some extent, we're seeing the market tread water over a longer period of time because every sell-off has been met by buyers and every point upward has been met by sellers," Meckler said.
The Nasdaq was barely changed on Friday afternoon.
Credit-default swap premiums, reflecting the annual cost borne by the swap purchaser in thousands of dollars, have risen over the past year with concern about the risks being taken on by large AI spenders. The premiums rose on Thursday after Meta's decision to sell more stock, as much of the buildout to date has been financed through debt issuance.
The concerns around AI spending and investment returns have added to the market's volatility since Treasury yields rose sharply in August, which changed the economics of investing and bond issuance, given the increasing attractiveness of a higher risk-free rate.
It's been "a very volatile week," said Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B Riley Wealth in Boston. "There's no doubt at some point in time that the higher inflation moves, especially if driven by unsustainably higher energy prices ... would have to show up in corporate earnings. It hasn't yet, but that's the concern. And market participants are trying to position for that."
Shares of neoclouds, smaller companies tied to AI data centers and other infrastructure projects like CoreWeave, have dropped due to anxiety over their future. Their performance of late has also raised talk on Wall Street that capital is growing scarce - which stands to raise costs further and potentially raise funding issues down the road.
Even so, many investors remain positive on the sector, where giant AI lab Anthropic is expected to publish its IPO prospectus in coming days and Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft are expected to report earnings next week.
"In general, AI news in terms of revenues continues to be very strong, it's just at what cost and how long that growth is sustainable," Meckler said. "We really haven't gotten to the point of the market sort of focusing on winners and losers. It's been one big sector trade every day."

items.title: Leclerc marca el mejor tiempo para Ferrari en las pruebas del GP de EEUU
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Charles Leclerc lideró el viernes con Ferrari los entrenamientos del Gran Premio de Estados Unidos, con Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes, muy cerca en segunda posición de cara a una carrera que podría convertirlo en el campeón del mundo más joven de la Fórmula 1.
items.body:
Charles Leclerc lideró el viernes con Ferrari los entrenamientos del Gran Premio de Estados Unidos, con Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes, muy cerca en segunda posición de cara a una carrera que podría convertirlo en el campeón del mundo más joven de la Fórmula 1.
Leclerc marcó el mejor tiempo, con un minuto y 35,291 segundos, en la segunda sesión en el Circuito de las Américas de Austin tras haber registrado la vuelta más rápida en la primera tanda con marca de 1:36,052 a bordo de su monoplaza mejorado en una pista llena de baches.
Antonelli, de 20 años y que debe ganar el domingo para tener una primera oportunidad de hacerse con el título, quedó quinto en la primera sesión, en la que Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, fue el más cercano a Leclerc, ganador de la carrera en 2024.
El italiano, que se quejó de que su asiento se movía, mejoró hasta el segundo puesto y terminó el día a 0,042 del mejor tiempo.
Verstappen, ganador en Austin el año pasado, busca su tercera victoria consecutiva tras las de Singapur y Malasia. Terminó la segunda sesión en el tercer escalón, a 0,189 de Leclerc, con Lewis Hamilton cuarto con Ferrari y George Russell quinto para Mercedes.
Russell recibió una bandera de advertencia por un incidente con Leclerc que provocó que el monegasco se saliera de la pista al principio de la segunda sesión, pero los comisarios decidieron no tomar ninguna medida adicional.
El vigente campeón de McLaren, Lando Norris, fue el tercero más rápido en la tanda inicial, a 0,245 del mejor tiempo, y luego quedó séptimo, por detrás de Liam Lawson, de Racing Bulls.
"Creo que Lando es, sin duda, mucho más rápido de lo que indica su tiempo de vuelta", declaró el jefe de McLaren, Zak Brown, a la cadena Sky Sports.
Gabriel Bortoleto, de Audi; Arvid Lindblad, de Racing Bulls; y Franco Colapinto, de Alpine, han recibido penalizaciones en la parrilla por cambios en sus unidades de potencia.
Lindblad bajará cinco puestos desde la posición en la que se clasifique el sábado, Colapinto 10 y Bortoleto, 20.
Williams pareció tener dificultades, con Carlos Sainz en el puesto 20 y Alex Albon en el 22 en la segunda sesión de entrenamientos.
"El coche es un desastre ahora mismo, un desastre. No tengo confianza en la parte trasera", dijo Sainz por la radio del equipo.
El circuito ha sido objeto de críticas por parte de algunos pilotos debido a lo accidentado que se ha vuelto.
"Probablemente sea el circuito más bacheado que hemos tenido en lo que va de año. Es complicado, pero estoy seguro de que sabremos adaptarnos", declaró Pierre Gasly, de Alpine, a la cadena Sky Sports.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル堅調、ユーロは仏情勢が重し　来週の中銀会合に注目
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。来週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀が金融政策決定会合を開く。いずれも政策金利の据え置きが予想されているが、今後の金融政策の方向性の手がかりを示すか注目されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．１％安の１５６．９円。ただ、週間ベースでは円は対ドルで約０．７％上昇。９月中旬以来の大幅な上昇となる。ＭＵＦＧのシニア通貨アナリスト、リー・ハードマン氏は「リスク回避姿勢が強まる中、円買いが続いている」と述べた。

ユーロに対してはフランスの債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に拡大したことなどが重しになっており、ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１９１ドル。週初からは０．４３％下落した。

ユーロは対円でより大きく下落し、一時１７５．０８円と、２０２５年１０月以来の安値を更新。週初からは約１．１％下落した。

フランスでは１７日の抗議デモが過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展してから１週間が経過し、ヌニェス内相は暴力行為や略奪の再発防止に向け、２４日に全国で予定される抗議活動に７万人の警察官を動員すると発表。パリのルーブル美術館、オルセー美術館、オペラ座などの主要文化施設の一部が臨時休館となるほか、治安上の懸念からパリで予定されているサッカーフランス１部リーグの試合が２５日から２６日に延期されるなどの影響が出ている。

バノックバーン・グローバル・フォレックスの主席市場ストラテジスト、マーク・チャンドラー氏は「マクロン政権は社会不安の鎮静化に向けて軍の投入も辞さない姿勢を示しているが、週末にかけて抗議活動が一段と活発化する可能性が高い」と指摘。「欧州債券市場への圧力はこの日は幾分和らいだが、２３日に予定されているムーディーズによるフランス国債格付けの見直しが注目されている」と述べた。

終盤の取引で、主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％高の１０１．８２。

ＦＲＢの金融政策を巡っては、前日の株式相場急落を受け、１２月の会合での利上げ観測がやや後退したことがＬＳＥＧのデータで示された。ただ、ＦＦ金利先物市場では１２月利上げの確率はなお８１％と見込まれている。

ＥＣＢについては、１２月の理事会で利上げが決定される確率は６６％と織り込まれている。ラガルドＥＣＢ総裁が９月下旬にインフレに対し穏健な政策対応が適切との認識を示していることから、今後の金利見通しについて新たな示唆があるか注目されている。

日銀については、１２月の利上げの確率が６１％と織り込まれている。

Oct 23 : US-based Indycar will race in Europe for the first time in 20 years with a July 2027 round at Barcelona's Circuit de Catalunya in a multi-year deal announced on Friday.
The race will be a return home for Spain's five-time Indycar champion Alex Palou, who was born near Barcelona.
• Indycar last raced in Europe at the Assen circuit in the Netherlands in 2007. The championship has not raced outside North America since 2013, when there was a race in Brazil.
• Palou, 29, has won the last four Indycar titles and also won the Indianapolis 500 in 2025.

• The Circuit de Catalunya hosted Formula One this year but drops off the calendar in 2027 and will alternate with Belgium until 2032.
• "We’ve been witnessing his (Palou's) extraordinary talent for years, and we know that his fans in Spain have been eager to see him compete live," said Mark Miles, CEO of Indycar owner Penske Entertainment Corp.
• "It is an amazing opportunity, and it means so much to me to have a race at home in Barcelona, it’s hard to put into words. I know the fans are going to love it, and I think we are going to put on a great show," said Palou.
• The 2027 race will be held on July 16-18.

items.title: Leclerc fastest for Ferrari in US GP Friday practice
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Ferrari's Charles Leclerc led the way in US Grand Prix practice on Friday, with Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli a close second ahead of a race that could make him Formula One's youngest champion.
items.body:
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc led the way in US Grand Prix practice on Friday, with Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli a close second ahead of a race that could make him Formula One's youngest champion.
Leclerc set the pace of one minute 35.291 seconds in a sunny second practice at Austin's Circuit of the Americas after also lapping fastest in the earlier session with a time of 1:36.052 in his upgraded car on a bumpy track.
Antonelli, the 20-year-old who must win on Sunday to have a first chance of taking the title, was fifth in session one when Red Bull's Max Verstappen was closest to 2024 winner Leclerc.
The Italian, who complained about his seat moving, then improved to second place and ended the day 0.042 off the pace.
Verstappen, winner in Austin last year, is chasing his third successive victory after Singapore and Malaysia. He ended second practice as the third fastest and 0.189 off Leclerc with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton fourth and Mercedes' George Russell fifth.
Russell had a black-and-white warning flag for an incident with Leclerc that led to the Monegasque going off track early in the second session, but stewards decided against any further action.
McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris was third fastest, 0.245 off the pace, in first practice and then seventh later on and behind Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson.
"I think Lando is definitely a lot quicker than his lap time," McLaren boss Zak Brown told Sky Sports television. "He didn't get his third sector in. His first two sectors were very strong.
"So I think we are much quicker than we looked. I think Ferrari's lap time, Mercedes' lap time, there or thereabouts."
Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto, Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad and Alpine's Franco Colapinto all collected grid drops for changes to their power units.
Lindblad will drop five places from wherever he qualifies on Saturday, Colapinto 10 places and Bortoleto 20.
Williams looked to be struggling, with Carlos Sainz 20th and Alex Albon 22nd in practice two.
"The car is a mess right now. It's a mess. I have no confidence in the rear," said Sainz over the team radio.

items.title: US Justice Dept sues to block possible Alaska election of Democrat to Senate
items.author: Jan Wolfe
items.creator: Jan Wolfe
items.summary: Control of the US Senate could come down to Alaska, where incumbent Republican Senator Dan S. Sullivan is running a closely contested race against Democrat Mary Peltola.
items.body:
The US Justice Department on Thursday sued to preemptively block Alaska from certifying the results of its US Senate race if the Republican incumbent candidate loses by a narrow margin, saying voters could be confused because two Republicans on the ballot have almost identical names.
The lawsuit signals the willingness of President Donald Trump's administration to contest the results of the November 3 midterm elections that will decide control of the US Congress.
Trump's administration has taken an increasingly aggressive approach to election oversight, pressing states for voter-registration data and arguing that stricter measures are needed to ensure public confidence in the vote. Critics, including both Democratic and some Republican election officials, view the moves as federal overreach.
Control of the US Senate could come down to Alaska, where incumbent Republican Senator Dan S. Sullivan is running a closely contested race against Democrat Mary Peltola.
The Justice Department's lawsuit , filed in federal court in Anchorage, takes issue with the presence of a third contender in the race, another Republican named Dan J. Sullivan Jr, alleging he is running "with the intention of misleading supporters of Senator Sullivan into voting for him."
The lawsuit asks a federal judge to block the certification of an outcome "that may be impacted by voter confusion," so that there can be "an investigation to determine whether votes cast for Daniel J. Sullivan were meant to be cast for Senator Sullivan."
Trump told reporters on Friday that he supported the lawsuit, saying "I'm the one that said do it."
A Justice Department spokesperson said in a statement that the agency is taking "necessary steps to ensure that this frivolous candidacy does not undermine the integrity of Alaska’s election or the will of its voters.”
Election officials around the country have told Reuters they are preparing for potential federal interference in November’s elections, including legal challenges and disputes over voting that could disrupt certification of the results.
Trump has a long history of challenging election outcomes and encouraging supporters to contest results he views as unfavorable.
Election law experts said the Justice Department's lawsuit has no merit and seeks relief not allowed under federal law.
"In short, like many Department letters over the last few years, it is designed to win the press release rather than the litigation," wrote Notre Dame law professor Derek Muller in a blog post , adding that "the legal argument is one of the worst ones I’ve ever seen."
Trump's administration "has absolutely no authority to tell Alaska when or how to certify the results of its Senate election," said David Becker of the Center for Election Innovation and Research, a nonpartisan group that advises election officials, adding that "this issue has already been fully litigated by Alaska's courts."
The unelected Sullivan, a former US Forest Service worker and elementary school teacher, filed to run as a candidate on May 29 seeking to unseat Senator Dan S. Sullivan and "put Alaska first," according to his campaign website, which advertised "Dan Sullivan Challenges Dan Sullivan for US Senate Seat."
Dan J. Sullivan has denied in interviews with US news outlets that his aim is to cause confusion or divert votes from Dan S. Sullivan.
The Alaska Supreme Court in June permitted the unelected Sullivan to appear on the ballot. He will appear without a party designation next to his name, while the senator will be listed as the Republican incumbent.
Trump's [USN:L6N465159 TEXT:"approval rating"] has fallen to a record low, hit by rising diesel and gasoline prices and a conflict in the Middle East that has proven deeply unpopular with voters.
Public opinion polls suggest Republicans may lose control of one or both houses of Congress, which would likely limit Trump's ability to enact his policies in the final two years of his presidency.

items.title: Bank of Canada to raise rates to 2.50% on October 28 and once again by end-March: Reuters poll
items.author: Nushaiba Iqbal
items.creator: Nushaiba Iqbal
items.summary: The Bank of Canada will raise its overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% on October 28 and follow with one more hike by the end of March to pre-empt any further rise in inflation expectations, according to a majority of economists polled by Reuters.
items.body:
The Bank of Canada will raise its overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% on October 28 and follow with one more hike by the end of March to pre-empt any further rise in inflation expectations, according to a majority of economists polled by Reuters.
Inflation rose to [USN:L6N4620VU TEXT:"3.1%"] in September, only barely overshooting the BoC's target range of 1% to 3%. But the central bank's latest [USN:BCLJLEM2I TEXT:"business outlook survey"] showed sharply rising inflation expectations in the run-up to a recent breakdown in trade talks with the United States, Canada's main export destination.
Quarterly inflation forecasts from the bank, also due next week, are likely to be [USN:L6N463037 TEXT:"revised higher"], BoC Governor Tiff Macklem told reporters in remarks Saturday that markets interpreted as a hint a rate rise is coming.
Interest rate futures have moved from pricing in a 30% chance of a rate hike in October to around a three-in-four likelihood. Many economists this week changed their view from a hold to a hike, citing those remarks from Macklem.
"What changed the tone in the governor's public comments on the weekend and what changed our view on Monday is the same source, and that is the responses from the BoC's business outlook and consumer surveys," said Royce Mendes, managing director and head of macro strategy at Desjardins.
"So presumably the governor had seen the results before they were published more broadly on Monday. And I would assume that informed his public commentary," Mendes said. "The survey responses...suggest there are more serious inflationary pressures coming."
Nineteen of 34 economists surveyed in the October 21-23 poll, or 56% of them, said the BoC will hike its overnight rate by a quarter percentage point to 2.50%, its first move in a year.
This is a clear reversal from the previous poll, when 80% of respondents forecast the bank would hold its rate at 2.25% until the end of 2026, and two-thirds of them forecast a hold until the end of March 2027.
Those economists who forecast no move next week mainly cited a weak economy and subdued inflation pressures despite soaring oil prices , which hit $117 a barrel for the first time since May on Friday.
Sixteen of 29 respondents, a 55% majority, also forecast one more rise before March 2027, after which policymakers would hold the overnight rate at 2.75%, poll medians showed. If correct, it will be the shortest BoC policy tightening campaign in 30 years.
But even a short series of hikes would bring the BoC into a widening group of central banks that have opted for tighter monetary policy in response to persistent inflation emerging as a result of the US-led [USN:L6N46718Z TEXT:"war"] with Iran that began in February.
Among major central banks, only the BoC and the Bank of England — which is [USN:L6N4610Q9 TEXT:"widely expected"] to raise rates at its early November meeting — have not yet begun to raise rates.
But many say the BoC will need to be measured with the pace of rate increases given other risks to the economy.
Benjamin Reitzes, Canadian rates and macro strategist at BMO, said: "They'd rather make the mistake of hiking a little bit too early, which means maybe they have to hike a little bit less at the end of the day than falling behind the curve, which is what happened in 2021-2022, and they don't want to repeat that mistake.”
Economic growth likely slowed to 1.9% last quarter from 3.3% [USN:L6N44O17F TEXT:"in Q2"] and is forecast at 1.3% in the current one before accelerating next year, poll medians showed. The economy will grow 1.0% in 2026 and 1.7% in 2027, the survey found.
Inflation will average 2.8% for 2026 as a whole, falling to 2.3% in 2027, poll medians showed.
([USN:L6N45N0UX TEXT:"Other stories"] from the Reuters global economic poll)

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞　続落して取引を終えた。フランスでの抗議活動や政局への不安のほか、原油高が相場の重荷となり、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは１．３９％安と３週ぶりに反落した。    ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は前日比３．５９％安。フランスの高級ブランド、ケリングは１６．６％下落。中東情勢や中国での需要低迷が響き、主力ブランド、グッチの７─９月期の販売が減少した。一方、直近四半期決算の売上高が市場予想を上回ったフランスの化粧品大手ロレアルは５．６％上昇した。    ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は３．７５％安。決算を発表したフランスの航空機エンジンメーカーのサフランは１０．０％下落した。    直近四半期が営業赤字となったスウェーデンの自動車メーカー、ボルボ・カーは２４．２％安。約２５００人の人員削減計画を発表した。    欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は来週、理事会を開く。市場では政策金利を据え置くとの観測が強い。 

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　フランス国債利回り上昇が一服した。この日は、仏１０年国債利回りは５ｂｐ低下の５．０４％となった。    週間ベースでは２７ｂｐ近く上昇しており、２０２６年５月下旬以来の大幅な上昇を記録した。ベルギー国債利回りは１９ｂｐ近く、イタリア国債利回りも１１ｂｐ、それぞれ上昇した。これに対し、ドイツとオランダの１０年債利回りはそれぞれ７ｂｐ、６ｂｐ低下した。    ２３日は今週の流れが一部反転し、ドイツとオランダの利回りはともに２ｂｐ上昇し、それぞれ３．３５％、３．４６％となった。    来週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、日銀、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）など主要中銀の金融政策決定が相次ぐ。    ＥＣＢは他の２中銀と同様、政策金利を据え置くと予想されている。このため投資家は、ラガルド総裁が見通しについて何を語るかに加え、フランス国債の緊張が市場の火種になり得るかどうかについての発言に注目することになる。    ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、短期金融市場は２３日、１２月までに利上げが行われる確率を再び約８０％に織り込んでいた。

items.title: イラン、海底ケーブル攻撃準備　米・イスラエル再攻撃なら＝治安高官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ドバイ　２３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ドバイ　２３日　ロイター] - 米国とイスラエルがイランを再び攻撃した場合、イランがペルシャ湾の海底通信ケーブルを標的とする攻撃の詳細な計画を策定していることがイラン治安当局高官２人の話で分かった。

イラン当局者はこれまでも、米国との外交交渉が決裂し新たな戦闘が発生すれば、海底ケーブルが攻撃対象になり得ると警告。匿名を条件に取材に応じた２人の高官は、攻撃の具体的な手法や実施場所について明らかにしなかったが、このうち１人は、インターネット接続を含む通信の混乱を長期化させるため、攻撃後の修復作業を妨害することを目指す考えを示した。

同高官はロイターに対し「イランが攻撃されれば、もはやレッドライン（越えてはならない一線）は存在しない。海底ケーブルから軍事基地まで、秘密基地も含めて標的になり得る」と指摘。米国は「火遊びをしてはならない」とし、イランは海底ケーブルの位置を完全に把握しており、容易に破壊できると主張した。

海底ケーブルを巡っては、イランのイスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）のジャバニ政治担当副司令官が２１日、イランのインフラが攻撃を受けた場合、ホルムズ海峡の海底に敷設された主要なインターネット通信ケーブル７本を標的にする可能性があると述べている。

国連機関の国際電気通信連合（ＩＴＵ）によると、海底ケーブルは世界のインターネット通信量の約９９％を担っている。ただ、通信調査会社テレジオグラフィーの調査責任者アラン・モールディン氏は、ホルムズ海峡を通過する国際通信帯域は全体の１％未満にとどまるため、イランによる攻撃があっても世界全体に及ぶ影響は限定される可能性があると指摘している。

イラン治安当局高官の発言について、米国務省とイラン外務省からコメントは得られていない。湾岸諸国も現時点でコメントしていない。

items.title: Mark Cuban says AI hack agents are like cockroaches, but can be controlled
items.author: Caroline Humer
items.creator: Caroline Humer
items.summary: Billionaire entrepreneur Mark Cuban said on Friday that he is "not a doomer" about artificial intelligence and that companies should be able to use the technology to protect themselves from AI-driven hacks by agents that he compared to cockroaches.
items.body:
Billionaire entrepreneur Mark Cuban said on Friday that he is "not a doomer" about artificial intelligence and that companies should be able to use the technology to protect themselves from AI-driven hacks by agents that he compared to cockroaches.
"It's like the cockroach thing, right? You build a new house, you get the guys to come out and spray... the one thing I don't want is cockroaches in my house ever. But the cockroaches find a way to get in because there's zillions of them, right? And then if there's one gets in, there's more that are going to get in, and that's kind of the way AI works," Cuban said, speaking at Reuters Total Health.
"It's all brute force acts, and if it's brute force on that side with the bad guys, you can also use brute force with the good guys," he said.
Cuban, famous for his role on business reality show "Shark Tank" and his involvement in the Dallas Mavericks NBA team, ventured into healthcare when he started the online pharmacy Cost Plus Drug Company in 2022 with a standard pricing scheme: the cost it pays for the drug, plus 15%.
In May, Cost Plus signed on with TrumpRx.gov, a website created by the Trump administration selling discounted weight-loss drugs.
But the company has also moved into manufacturing. In 2025, it began making sterile injectable drugs typically used in hospitals in its own compounding manufacturing facility.
Cuban said the company has built smaller, tractor-trailer-sized manufacturing facilities he calls "pods" that can be used separately or together to manufacture many kinds of drugs, including generics and treatments for rare diseases.
He said the pods would eventually be Cost Plus Drugs' biggest business and would allow medicines to be manufactured closer to where they are needed in the event of a disaster, because they're portable.
One holdup, Cuban said, has been getting regulators from the US Food and Drug Administration to sign off on the pods.
"We're talking to the FDA to try to get approval," he said without outlining the complications. "They're working hard to try to figure it out."
Cuban campaigned for Democratic presidential nominee Kamala Harris in 2024 and has supported Democratic candidate James Talarico for US Senate this year in Texas.
He said two items he believes the US government should immediately put in place to help lower healthcare costs would be that all payments made out of pocket should count towards patients' deductibles and that taxpayer-funded health contracts should be public without redactions.
Still, Cuban said he did not believe Democrats were necessarily better than Republicans on healthcare.
"None of them know what they're doing," he said.

items.title: NFL closes Paris pop-up shop ahead of planned protests
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The NFL will close its Paris pop-up shop on Saturday because of planned demonstrations in the French capital ahead of this weekend's regular-season game between the Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints, the league said on Friday.
items.body:
The NFL will close its Paris pop-up shop on Saturday because of planned demonstrations in the French capital ahead of [USN:L1N4690K8 TEXT:"this weekend's regular-season game"] between the Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints, the league said on Friday.
The store on Rue Saint-Merri had been operating as part of events surrounding Sunday's game at the Stade de France, the first NFL regular-season contest to be held in France.
"The NFL Shop on Rue Saint-Merri will be closed tomorrow Saturday 24 October, due to potential accessibility issues," the league said in a statement.
The street is located in Paris' fourth arrondissement, in the city centre.
The league said the shop would remain open until 8 p.m. local time on Friday and that an alternative NFL pop-up store would operate at the Stade de France on Saturday.
The Steelers had already cancelled a fan event scheduled for the weekend at a bar on Place de la Bastille amid concerns over the demonstrations.
France experienced some of its worst urban unrest in recent years last weekend, prompting President Emmanuel Macron's government to tighten restrictions on protests as authorities prepared for the possibility of further violence on Saturday.
Sunday's game will take place in Saint-Denis, about 10 km north of Paris centre, with organisers continuing preparations despite disruption elsewhere in the city.
Concerns over renewed unrest have also led several major cultural venues, including the Louvre, to close on Saturday, while the Art Basel Paris fair will remain shut throughout the weekend.

items.title: トランプ氏、カナダ産農林業製品の一部関税撤廃　中間選挙控え国境州に配慮
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　２３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　２３日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２３日、一部のカナダ産農林業製品に対する５０％関税を撤廃する大統領令に署名した。中間選挙を前にメイン州選出の共和党議員の要請を受けたもので、米農業関連企業の負担軽減につながる可能性がある。

今回の措置は、厳しい再選戦を戦っているメイン州選出のスーザン・コリンズ上院議員（共和党）が同州の企業や農家に影響を及ぼしている関税問題への対応をホワイトハウスに求めたことを受けたもの。ホワイトハウスによると、合板、一部の紙製品、特定の機械や冷却設備、梱包用の木箱や容器などが関税撤廃の対象になる。

トランプ氏は８月、カナダとの関税協議が決裂したことを受け、カナダからの２００億ドル相当の輸入品に対し５０％の関税を課すと発表していた。

コリンズ議員は、今回の措置でメイン州のブルーベリー、ジャガイモ、リンゴ、海藻の生産者が恩恵を受けると指摘。声明で「これらの生産者は州経済にとって不可欠な存在で、地方や沿岸部の地域社会を支えている」とし、「多くの農家や生産業者はカナダから調達する特殊な機械や包装資材などに依存している。こうした製品は米国内では入手できない場合があるほか、代替には多額の費用がかかる」とした。

カナダとの国境に近い米北部のメイン州やミシガン州などは関税措置の影響を大きく受けており、１１月３日の中間選挙に向け一部の共和党候補は難しい対応を迫られている。特にメイン州とミシガン州の経済は自動車部品や木材、果実収穫用機器など幅広い分野でカナダ経済と深く結び付いており、関税政策を巡る政治的な重要性が一段と高まっている。

WASHINGTON, Oct 23 : US Senator Marsha Blackburn, a Tennessee Republican, on Friday raised concerns about Facebook parent Meta Platforms' plan to update its commercial terms, saying it could harm businesses and creators.
Blackburn, who is chair of the Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Privacy, Technology and the Law, said the updated terms "indicate Meta is attempting to exploit American creators and businesses by granting itself sweeping authority to scrape content from any website associated with Facebook and Instagram business accounts." 
Earlier on Friday, Meta said it would delay the implementation of updated commercial terms from October 30 until November 20, so it can address concerns from publishers and digital advertisers.
EU and UK antitrust authorities have received complaints about the new commercial terms, which publishers and digital advertisers said would give Meta unlimited rights to use their content for its AI services. Meta has rejected the claims.

Blackburn said that Meta previously revised its terms to remove an explicit reference to AI training but said the changes did not go far enough. She added that the revised language authorizes extensive scraping of external websites and permits Meta to “develop” its business products with collected content.
"Without clear restrictions on how that information may be used, including whether it may be incorporated into AI systems, Meta’s revisions offer little assurance that creators’ intellectual property will be protected," Blackburn said. She added: "This is particularly troubling for American news publishers, creators, and small businesses that rely on Meta’s platforms to reach their audiences and customers."
Asked for comment on Blackburn's letter, Meta on Friday noted it had delayed the change and said the revised terms apply only to its ads and business products and that it is not changing how it uses web crawlers.
"These updates don't give us new rights to supersede such preferences and this isn’t about scraping news sites," the company said, noting that "content owners will still be able to use robots.txt to signal preferences."
Publishers worldwide are ramping up fights with AI companies using their content without permission to train large language models, underscoring the clash between copyright owners and those citing fair-use arguments.
"Meta must withdraw the updated Commercial Terms and come to the table to protect the content of creators and publishers across the country," Blackburn said. "American creators and small businesses are not a free source of content for Meta to exploit."

Source: Reuters

items.title: Top LNG exporter QatarEnergy in talks to buy US LNG from Woodside's Louisiana plant
items.author: Curtis Williams, Marwa Rashad
items.creator: Curtis Williams, Marwa Rashad
items.summary: QatarEnergy is in talks with Woodside Energy to buy up to 3 million metric tons of liquefied natural gas per annum (mtpa) from its Louisiana LNG plant under construction, three people with knowledge of the negotiations told Reuters.
items.body:
QatarEnergy is in talks with Woodside Energy (WDS.AX) to buy up to 3 million metric tons of liquefied natural gas per annum (mtpa) from its Louisiana LNG plant under construction, three people with knowledge of the negotiations told Reuters.
If a final agreement is reached, the long-term deal could see QatarEnergy buying LNG from the 16.5 mtpa export facility for between 15 and 20 years, one of the people said.
Woodside Energy said on Friday it does not respond to market speculation, while QatarEnergy did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
QatarEnergy has been buying LNG on the spot market from US exporters to supply some of its customers due to the ongoing blockage of the Strait of Hormuz as the US-Israeli war on Iran and Tehran’s strikes this year have sharply curtailed shipping.
The company is also a 70% owner of the Golden Pass LNG facility being developed in Louisiana, which when complete will have the capacity to export up to 18 mtpa of LNG.
On Thursday, Cheniere Energy (LNG.N) reported it had reached a long-term agreement to supply QatarEnergy with 4 mtpa of LNG. Two million metric tons per year will be sourced from Cheniere’s Sabine Pass facility in Louisiana, and another 2 mpta will come from its Corpus Christi terminal in Texas.
Reuters also [USN:L1N468185 TEXT:"reported"] on Thursday that QatarEnergy is in advanced talks with Venture Global (VG.N) for a long-term supply deal to buy at least 3 million metric tons of LNG per year.
Venture Global and Woodside's Louisiana LNG are the US suppliers with the most uncommitted LNG capacity.
Louisiana LNG is said to be asking for a premium for liquefaction fees that exceed $2.50 per mmBtu and are above the average US market prices because of contract flexibility, offering potential buyers shorter contracts in return for higher prices, two people told Reuters.
